Title: Full-Time
Description:
We are the consultant company that travels beyond the speed of light to turn your data into possibilities. We know that the only way of discovering the limits of the possible, is to venture a little way past them into the impossible. That’s why we are leaders in Business Intelligence and Advanced Analytics. By always hunting down new knowledge and skills, we can pinpoint current competition in the always-evolving world of IT. We are driven by learning new technologies. That's how we help businesses, together with our fluency in complex IT technologies. A winning concept? Yes, if you want to communicate with both business and IT. Right now, we are looking for a Business Intelligence consultant who wants to use Qlik och Power BI as your right hand. Read more and apply today!

About The Role

Advanced data solutions are at the core of everything we do at SpaceBase. Our main goal is to find smart ways of using technology that will help build a better tomorrow for everyone, everywhere. As a consultant, you will open new galaxies for our clients. With Azure as your sidekick, you make sure that our customers understand their overall cloud readiness and support them through a structured learning plan to ensure state-of-the-art delivery.

We want all our clients to be more data-driven. You will help them do just that by developing deep relationships with our clients and voicing your knowledge by sharing insights and best practices. To help them reach their full potential, you will apply your technical expertise to architect solutions that meet business – and IT needs. This means creating a Data Platform, AA/AI roadmaps, and ensuring the long-term technical viability of new deployments. You will also infuse key analytics technologies (e.g. Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Databricks, Azure Data Explorer, Power BI, etc.) At Spacebase, the clients may vary, but they are equally important. That’s why you will pursue solutions in collaboration with different types of customers – in different industries – to reach set goals.

We are looking for you...


who would move mountains to learn something new. It may sound a little bit quirky, but you are a person who wants to stay up to date with new technologies and best practices. You're highly motivated, outgoing, flexible, and a fast learner who advocates for agile methodologies, data transparency, and collaboration. You are a high achiever and would work around the clock to achieve deadlines – if that means delivering solutions that would exceed our client's expectations.


As a Business Intelligence Consultant, you will be responsible for transforming raw data into valuable insights that guide business decisions. You’ll create dynamic dashboards and detailed reports, providing stakeholders with the information they need to make informed choices. Your expertise in data visualization will allow you to present complex data in a clear, intuitive way, helping clients understand key metrics and trends. You’ll work closely with clients to tailor your analyses to their specific needs, ensuring that they have the actionable intelligence required to drive their business forward.

Requirements


Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and detailed reports that provide actionable insights.
Collaborate with clients to understand their business objectives and reporting needs.
Utilize advanced data visualization techniques to present data in a clear and engaging way.
Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
Continuously optimize reporting processes to enhance data accuracy and efficiency.


Important To Have


Strong skills in SQL, Qlik and Power BI.
Proven experience in data visualization and report development.
Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.
Excellent communication skills to convey data-driven insights to non-technical stakeholders.


Why Spacebase?

With our creative minds and innovative veins, you will partner up with our clients in every step of their project. Do you want to plan a new data and analytics enterprise environment, present disruptive ideas, or fine-tune the last part of a project? Here, you can do it all – if you can do it with data. Let's make the world a better place by building a complex back-end and smooth, user-friendly front-end. Together we will use data as our new sunshine.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
TL;DR - We are looking for analytics engineers to own the semantic and modeling layer of our warehouse by transforming raw data into well-defined, trustworthy datasets and metrics. You are obsessed with analytical consistency, designing impactful metrics, and building strong foundations for self-service analytics.

Why Lovable?

Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with any language. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products - fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Lovable-built applications and websites are visited hundreds of millions of times a month, and our enterprise footprint is compounding fast. And we’re just getting started.

We’re a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

What we are looking for:


Expertise with SQL, dbt, SQLMesh or similar tools (data modeling, testing, macros, docs)
Experience with data warehousing concepts, cloud warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks) and BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Hex, Metabase, etc)
Understanding of dimensional modeling, data contracts, and metrics/semantical layers
Familiarity with modern ELT and orchestration workflows (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, etc)
Strong business acumen and ability to translate domain logic into scalable data structures


What you will do:


Build and maintain data models, following modular, tested, and version-controlled practices
Partner with domain teams to understand business logic and codify it into reusable models and metrics
Define and document key metrics and data contracts across domains
Collaborate with Data Platform Engineers to optimize query performance and warehouse cost
Automate and maintain data documentation, lineage, and governance standards
Develop guidelines for analytics development, data modeling and structure conventions


Our tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:


Frontend: React
Backend: Golang and Rust
Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers
DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)


And always on the lookout for what's next!

How We Hire


Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with recruiter.
Complete the general programming exercise.
Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews.
Tell us about your most impressive project.


About Your Application


Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal

Title: Data Scientist till Savings Performance
Description:
Har du en passion för att omvandla data till insikter som påverkar riktiga affärsbeslut? Vill du arbeta nära affären och bidra till att utveckla våra sparaprodukter och kundupplevelser genom datadriven analys?

Vi söker nu en Data Scientist till vårt Savings Performance-team inom Investment Center. Här får du en central roll i att analysera och utveckla Sparaaffären genom att kombinera datamodellering, analys och tydlig kommunikation av insikter.

Hos oss på Swedbank har du en möjlighet att:


Arbeta end-to-end med data – från behovsidentifiering och datainsamling till modellering, analys och visualisering.
Analysera och följa upp Sparaaffären ur ett produkt-, kund- och organisationsperspektiv.
Identifiera mönster i data och omsätta dessa till konkreta, affärsnära rekommendationer.
Ta fram beslutsunderlag och presentera insikter till management och andra seniora stakeholders.

Help shape the future of data, analytics & AI
An established Nordic organisation is investing heavily in its modern data platform and is looking for an Analytics Engineer to play a key role in that journey.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.

We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.

The Role

As an Analytics Engineer in the Analytics Foundation team, you help the whole company use data with confidence. You sit in a small team with real ownership: we shape how analytics engineering is done here, not only what gets built. You will make architectural decisions for data modelling and set the bar for quality, maintainability, and how we work. This is not a role where you only implement models from a backlog of “orders”; you partner with the business and with technical teams, surface trade-offs when needed, and help prioritise work that compounds.

We spend most of our time on larger initiatives that improve the platform and how people use data, rather than reacting to a constant stream of ad-hoc questions. The team has a high degree of autonomy over its agenda, little firefighting, and we have invested for years in automating repetitive work so we can focus on impact. You will work hands-on with modern data tooling and with AI-assisted workflows, including coding agents and agent-style automation where they genuinely speed up design, review, and deliver, while staying responsible for correctness, governance, and clarity for stakeholders.

You will develop and maintain core models, quality practices, and governance; support the warehouse and pipelines; and help teams get the most from BI and GTM tooling. Tools in our stack include Snowflake, dbt core, Hex, Prefect, Fivetran, and Hightouch (among others).

Key Responsibilities


Design, own, and evolve core data models and the modelling architecture; including how they connect to pipelines, freshness, and operational reliability in the warehouse.
Empower the organization to use and interpret data.
Partner with business and technical stakeholders from problem framing to shipped artefacts: clarify requirements, suggest better approaches when a request would not scale, and drive or co-drive cross-team initiatives that improve how data is used.
Collaborate closely with other data professionals; this includes giving actionable feedback in code reviews as well as actively supporting with data modeling
Combine subject matter expertise and a high level business understanding to contribute to the direction and strategy for Mentimeter in the realm of data modeling, AI-Analysis, BI-tooling and data activation in GTM-Tooling.
Develop, own and maintain data modeling standards and the data development experience
Improve how we work at scale: thoughtful automation and AI-assisted engineering (e.g. coding agents and repeatable workflows) with human accountability for correctness and compliance.
Maintain and grow how knowledge is surfaced, e.g in semantic models, a data catalog, or documentation



We Believe You Have


Roughly 4-7 years of relevant hands-on experience as an Analytics Engineer, Data Analyst, Data Scientist, BI Analyst, or similar (or equivalent depth if your path is non-linear).
Strong SQL and sound judgment in data modelling (grain, reusability, naming, and how metrics should behave).
Experience partnering across departments, including leading or co-leading cross-functional work that shipped something others use.
Strong business acumen with an understanding of sales, marketing, and product analytics.
Ability to map ambiguous stakeholder needs to clear, maintainable models and artefacts.
Experience with BI-tools and development of BI features
Knowledge of software collaboration using git.
Communication in English with both technical and non-technical audiences; interest in helping others grow their data skills.
Experience working with GDPR-sensitive data and collaborating with legal experts on compliance assessments.



It Is Beneficial If You Have


Hands-on experience with dbt (or similar)
Experience with a semantic or metrics layer
Experience using AI-assisted coding or coding agents in a disciplined way (reviews, tests, documentation), with clear judgment about automation vs verification for production data work.
Professional experience working in an agile environment



Not Required


Swedish is not required (daily work is carried out in English and the Mentimeter team currently boasts 50+ different nationalities).
A cover letter is not required as part of your application



📍 Location:

This is primarily an onsite role located at Mentimeter HQ in Stockholm, with a hybrid approach and ability to work from home up to twice per week.

Please note that we do not offer visa relocation sponsorship for this position.

💡Our Recruitment Process


Introduction interview
Competence interview, including a live case.
Culture interview
References & Offer



Compensation

At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you.

The salary range for this role is SEK 50,000–SEK 68,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact.

Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.

In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm.

What Mentimeter Can Offer

At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.

All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page

AI and Hiring at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.


AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.



AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.

Culture at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.

Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.

Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

Title: Data Analytics Engineer
Description:
Are you ready to be a key contributor within the Data & Analytics Engineering department at NOBA Bank Group? Your focus will be on advancing analytics capabilities, optimizing data workflows, driving innovation in the cloud, and unlocking the full potential of the organization’s most valuable asset – data.

About The Role

The Data & Analytics Engineering department comprises specialized teams focused on Data Infrastructure Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Data Management.

As a Data Analytics Engineer, you'll play a central role in building and optimizing the organization's supporting analytics layer, collaborating across the bank. This role offers broad opportunities to grow and make a tangible impact!

We offer a hybrid working model with two common in-office days. While we value flexibility, we also prioritize collaboration, team-building, and enjoying fikas and after-work gatherings together!

Main Tasks


Design and implement efficient data models, focusing on analytics workflows and end-user usability.
Build robust and scalable data pipelines to support business intelligence and analytics needs.
Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, such as Risk, Finance, and IT, to ensure data solutions align with business needs.
Ensure data quality, security, and compliance throughout the analytics lifecycle.
Drive technical improvements, introducing modern tools and processes to enhance analytics capabilities.
Partner with other engineers to align transformation processes for analytics purposes.


We Are Looking For Someone Who

Enjoys working with data & analytics engineering, modern data practices, and creating insights that drive decisions. We believe you are a detail-oriented and proactive person who thrives in a high pace enviroment and enjoy learning new technologies. You approach challenges with a “can-do” attitude and excel in analytical thinking and problem-solving.

For This Role You’ll Need


Work experience in a similar role within data engineering or analytics engineering
An academic degree related to analytics engineering, data engineering, or similar fields.
Proficiency in ETL processes, designing analytics-ready datasets, and ensuring clean and usable data for stakeholders.
Proficiency in Databricks, dbt (SQL), python and related reporting tools and languages.
Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools.
Fluency in English is required, along with fluency in either Swedish or Norwegian.


It’s a Plus If You Have


Experience with Microsoft’s data stack (Azure, SQL, and other cloud services).
Experience working with on-prem solutions.
A background in data roles within the financial sector.
Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.


Our Offer To You


Freedom with Responsibility: Flexible working arrangements to suit your work style.
Career Development: Opportunities to grow and develop in your role.
Feedback Culture: A supportive environment that encourages open communication.
Coaching Leadership: Managers who guide and support your career journey.
A Caring Company Culture: We genuinely care about each other!


In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

Have you heard of NOBAVERSE?

In our NOBAVERSE, we value openness, trust, and diversity. Here, you can influence your own development and have fun along the way to achieving our goals – all in a workplace that’s a little extra bubbly! ✨

Read more about our employee value proposition on our careers page.

Read more about how our recruitment process works in the FAQ.

We care for your privacy and, with reference to the GDPR, would like to ask you not to include any sensitive personal data in your application, for examples information about ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs or information about your health.

Read more about how we handle your personal data here.

If you have any questions or concerns about the position, please contact the responsible recruiter.

We look forward to receiving your application! 🙏✨

Coherent Corp is the global leader in photonics, designing and manufacturing advanced laser, optical, and materials technologies. In Sweden, our teams operate Sweden’s only full-scale indium phosphide wafer fabrication facility, where we design, manufacture, and test some of the world’s fastest optical chips under one roof, supporting AI infrastructure, data centres, and global communications networks worldwide.

The Role

We are seeking a Data Analysis Engineer to join our Product Verification Group in Järfälla. In this role, you will be responsible for analysing complex device characterization data to support product development, process optimisation and technical decision-making across our advanced optoelectronic technologies.

You Will Be Responsible For


Analysing device characterization data across multiple design, process and operating factors to support design optimisation and process understanding.
Performing statistical analysis of device performance, including the impact of process variation, measurement uncertainty and test noise.
Identifying trends and relationships within complex datasets and providing clear, actionable insights to engineering and design teams.
Developing and improving automated data processing and analysis workflows to enhance efficiency and scalability.
Presenting technical findings through graphical visualisations, reports and technical documentation to support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, including Chip Design, Wafer Fabrication Process Engineering, Operations, Quality & Reliability and Project Management.


About You

You are an analytical and curious problem solver who enjoys working with complex datasets and transforming information into meaningful insights. You are comfortable working across technical disciplines and communicating findings to a range of stakeholders.

You Will Also Have


A Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics or a related technical discipline.
Experience in data analysis, statistics, engineering data processing or a related field.
Strong knowledge of statistical analysis, data processing, automation and database technologies.
Experience analysing complex datasets and applying appropriate statistical and analytical methods.
An understanding of measurement variation, test uncertainty and noise analysis.
Experience with programming, scripting, databases or engineering analysis tools.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate assumptions, limitations and conclusions.
A structured approach to problem-solving, a strong sense of ownership and a continuous learning mindset.
Fluent English language skills; Swedish is considered a strong advantage.


We Offer


A dynamic and international working environment.
An appreciative and collaborative company culture.
Unique technical challenges supporting the products of tomorrow.
Competitive benefits and social programmes.

Coherent is a global leader in lasers, engineered materials and networking components. We are a vertically integrated manufacturing company that develops innovative products for diversified applications in the industrial, optical communications, military, life sciences, semiconductor equipment, and consumer markets. Title: Data and AI Analytics Coordinator
Description:
Overview

Arkion is looking for an analytical and customer-oriented Data and AI Analytics Coordinator / Product Owner to bridge the gap between customers and the internal Data Science, Customer Delivery, and Commercial teams. This role sits at the intersection of business, analytics, and AI operations, coordinating stakeholder requirement gathering, translating needs into clear analytics specifications, and delivering hands-on analysis and dashboards that help customers scale their use of Arkion’s platform.

As Arkion expands into new markets, geographies, and use cases, selecting and configuring the right AI models is becoming increasingly complex. The role combines customer interaction, analytics, and coordination. It requires someone who can move seamlessly between customer discussions, technical problem-solving, data analysis, and internal collaboration.

The position will sit within the Data Science team and report directly to Arkion’s CTO.


Responsibilities
Requirements Coordination & Specification
Coordinate requirement gathering across customer stakeholders (Data Science, Analytics, Operations) and Arkion internal teams (Data Science, Delivery, Product, Commercial).
Support customers in scaling their use of Arkion’s platform and AI capabilities.
Translate requirements into clear specifications (metric definitions, business logic, data requirements, dashboard outlines, and acceptance criteria).
Align stakeholders on definitions (e.g., what counts as a false positive/false negative, severity levels, defects per kilometer) and document decisions.

AI Model & Template Management
Support AI model selection for new customers and new customer projects.
Maintain an understanding of Arkion’s growing portfolio of AI models, including their dependencies, strengths, limitations, and best-fit use cases.
Own or coordinate AI template selection, editing and creation.
Internal coordination regarding model applicability and deployment recommendations.

Analytics & Data Quality
Own and support analytics related to AI model quality, both internally and externally.
Deliver data analysis and insights using tools such as Python, Metabase, Excel, and statistical analysis techniques.
Challenge, validate, and explain metrics and performance metrics.
Provide recommendations based on data quality and operational outcomes.

Customer Education & Enablement
Educate customers on AI performance metrics and analytics concepts, including precision and recall, false positives and false negatives, defects per kilometer etc.
Together with the Customer Delivery Manager, support customers in establishing effective QA (human-in-the-loop) workflows.

Cross-functional Coordination & Feedback Loops
Gather and funnel customer feedback and the Arkion internal annotation team feedback into the Data Science and Product teams.
Provide recommendations on when AI models should be improved based on data from real projects.
Work closely with Product teams to continuously improve the platform, particularly analytics and reporting capabilities.
Support the Commercial team with customer RFPs and technical responses.

Profile

We are looking for a curious and adaptable person who enjoys solving complex problems and thrives at the intersection of analytics, business, and technology.

You are comfortable discussing technical details with Data Scientists while also simplifying complex concepts for customers and stakeholders.


Preferred experience and skills
Background in Data Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related field.
Hands-on experience with Python, Excel, statistical analysis, and data visualization tools.
Strong analytical mindset and ability to use data to solve problems.
Experience in project manager, product owner, analytical and/or customer-facing technical roles.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Personal attributes
Highly structured with strong coordination skills.
Curious and eager to continuously learn and develop.
Flexible and pragmatic in solving problems.
Confident in challenging assumptions and asking the right questions.
Collaborative and relationship-oriented.
Comfortable handling ambiguity and complexity.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability.




This is a role for someone who enjoys creating order in complexity and helping both customers and internal teams succeed as Arkion continues to scale.

Title: Market Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.

If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.

At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.

Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.

What You'll Do

Right now, we are looking for a Commercial Analyst for our Commercial team. The team is responsible for providing market intelligence, commercial insights, pricing analysis, and strategic support to strengthen Stegra's commercial competitiveness and long-term growth.

Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following, but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.


Develop, maintain, and continuously improve Stegra's green steel pricing model to support commercial decision-making.
Prepare market intelligence reports and provide data-driven insights to support pricing, commercial strategy, and business planning.
Develop and maintain competitor profiles, including market positioning, strategic developments, and green transformation initiatives.
Maintain and continuously improve the green steel demand model using market data and industry trends.
Perform commercial and market analyses to support strategic projects, business development initiatives, and potential M&A activities.
Collaborate closely with Commercial, Strategy, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to provide analytical recommendations and commercial insights.
Participate in selected customer meetings, industry conferences, and networking events to strengthen market understanding and stay up to date with industry developments.
Manage relationships with external market data providers and support negotiations within approved authority levels.


What You'll Bring

You're curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You're not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking – and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.

Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below.


Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Finance, or another relevant field.
Experience in a Commercial Analyst, Business Analyst, Market Analyst, Data Analyst, or a similar analytical role.
Experience with market analysis, pricing, forecasting, commercial modelling, or business intelligence.
Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large datasets, data analysis, and visualization tools.
Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.
Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to present insights to both technical and commercial stakeholders.
A structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach, with strong planning and problem-solving skills.
Experience from manufacturing, steel, metals, or another industrial environment is an advantage, as is the ability to work in a fast-paced environment and travel occasionally when required.


Benefits At Stegra

At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.

You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.

Read More About Benefits At Stegra Here.

This is Stegra

Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.

By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

Our Stockholm Office

Our modern Stockholm office is located on Norra Stationsgatan, close to Karolinska University Hospital in central Stockholm. Here, you’ll find a bright, collaborative workspace where cross-functional teams connect, share ideas, and drive progress. Whether you're visiting regularly or working hybrid, you'll be part of a vibrant office culture with easy access to the city’s energy and amenities.

Founded in 2020, Stegra (formerly H2 Green Steel) was created with the purpose to decarbonize hard-to-abate industry. Construction of our first project – an integrated plant producing green hydrogen, green iron and green steel – is well underway in Boden, Sweden. Slashing emissions using green hydrogen and renewable electricity, we’re starting a clean industrial revolution. Steel is just the beginning. Together, we focus on delivering green impact – for our people, customers, investors, society and planet.

Title: Management Consultant - Data & Analytics
Description:
Your role




Our Data & Analytics (D&A) team combine broad business understanding with technical expertise to help our clients make better data-driven decisions.




Expect to participate in projects ranging from advisory services to hands-on development of D&A solutions. We help our clients define a strategy, organize their D&A capabilities, and implement data platforms and analytical solutions. The analytical work ranges from business intelligence to Machine Learning and Generative AI.




Together with an ambitious and multidisciplinary team of colleagues, you will help our clients understand their current situation, risks, and opportunities and advise how they can use technology to solve their business needs. The type of projects will be varied, and you will have access to experts throughout our international community of consultants.




Your professional and personal growth will be supported by a Development Manager. As you deepen your expertise and grow as a consultant, you will take on greater responsibilities in our client engagements and our internal business activities. Such as team development, employer branding, developing new offerings, pitching to clients, and other activities.




What We Are Looking For In Our New Colleagues




You may have a background as a developer and now want to combine technical work with more business‑focused and strategic responsibilities. Alternatively, you may work in Consulting, have a strong technical interest, and want to deepen your expertise within data and AI.




We Expect Candidates To Have




Experience in data collection and analysis, along with a general understanding of business processes.
Familiarity with Business Intelligence solutions and Generative AI development, as well as programming proficiency in Python and SQL.
Some experience with Database design, ETL, and Data Visualization is also desirable.
Experience with Microsoft´s Data & Analytics tools is a plus (Fabric, PowerBI, SQL Server, Data Factory, etc.)
Ability to balance analytical rigor with practical, implementable recommendations.
Structured communication, adapting style to managers and operational teams and an ability to establish credibility quickly in new environments.
A master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other relevant field.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint to support daily business activities.
Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, spoken and written.




What We Offer




BearingPoint is a great place to work. We can offer you the opportunity to work for a company with a global reach and a unique culture that allows everyone to reach their highest potential. We also offer team-specific competency development opportunities and employee benefits such as:

Professional and personal growth, supported by your Development Manager.
An international, dynamic, and inspiring work environment.
A steep learning curve in client-facing roles with a high impact on the business performance of our clients.
Competitive compensation and benefits package, including but not limited to an occupational pension, health insurance, wellness grants, expanded parental benefits, and more.
Competency development opportunities include our First 1000-day program and other Nordic & Firm-wide training and boot camps (Grow with BearingPoint).
An annual curriculum of various social events and sports activities.




What Now?




Send us your resume in either Swedish or English, and we´ll get back to you shortly. A cover letter is optional, and Interviews will be held continuously.




During the interview process, you will meet various colleagues from the team and conduct case interviews.




Want to find out more about the team? Meet some of our colleagues here (Meet our Sweden team), or read an article with our D&A team lead Marcus Ehrndal here.




As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be subject to background checks. These checks help us ensure a safe and trustworthy workplace and may include verification of identity, employment history, education, and any relevant criminal records, in accordance with applicable laws.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Analytics Engineer, Stockholm

Bravida is one of the Nordic region's leading installation and service companies covering electrical, HVAC, plumbing, sprinkler, security & fire, and automation across Sweden, Norway, Denmark and Finland with over 12,000 employees and around 300 local branches. Behind that scale sits serious operational complexity: projects, procurement, and finance functions that run on data. We're hiring an experienced Analytics Engineer to own the data models that ties it all together.

The Role

Data modelling is the core of this job. You'll design and own the semantic layer that makes Bravida's operational and financial data trustworthy, consistent, and accessible for reports today and generative BI tomorrow. AI isn't a side interest here; it's central to how we expect this role to operate and where we're taking our analytics capability.


Architect and own data models in dbt on Snowflake as the primary deliverable
Define and enforce modelling standards, documentation, and data contracts across domains
Build and manage pipelines in Dagster
Work with AI tooling actively to accelerate your own output and enable smarter self-service for the business
Drive our move toward generative analytics, shaping how business users query and interpret data through natural language
Work directly with operations, procurement, and finance to model their domains properly
Lead analytics data quality and reliability improvements across the stack



The Team

The Data & Analytics team sits inside Operational Excellence, a fast-moving function with a mandate to improve how Bravida runs at every level. That means getting out into the business, building relationships with branch managers and project leads across the Nordics, and making data something people actually pull toward rather than have pushed at them. We move quickly, we're visible, and we don't accept "this is how we've always done it." If you need a perfectly quiet environment to do your best work, this probably isn't the right fit. If you thrive on direct feedback, short cycles, and seeing your work land in the real world fast, it is.

What You Bring


3+ years as an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, or Data Analyst
Deep dbt experience; you've built and maintained production-grade models others depend on
Strong Snowflake or comparable modern platform experience
Solid grasp of dimensional modelling, data contracts, and semantic layer design
Active user of AI tools in your workflow and a view on how they change the job
Genuine interest in generative BI and what it means for how businesses consume data beyond today
Strong stakeholder management; you can hold a room, push back constructively, and get buy-in from people who weren't looking for it
You spot problems before they're reported and propose solutions before they're requested
You make good calls with incomplete information and don't wait to be told what to build next
English required; Nordic languages a bonus



What We Offer


Ownership of a decision engine that matters at real scale
A modern stack (Snowflake, dbt, Dagster) with active investment in AI and generative BI
Direct access to senior stakeholders across operations, procurement, and finance
A fast team with a real mandate, not a support function waiting for tasks
Autonomy on your own career and continuous development



The construction and installation industry is going through fundamental change in how projects are run, how decisions get made, and how value gets measured. The civic projects Bravida works on: the hospitals, schools, infrastructure, and buildings that society depends on, they deserve to be built and then operated on better data. We take that responsibility seriously. That's what this role is part of.

Process: Intro call with hiring manager, then a practical technical case study followed by meeting the team and discussing the solution. Final step is meeting some of the Operations team and key stakeholders.

You must be eligible to work in Sweden and the EU.

Bygg något från grunden – inte legacy

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Har du erfarenhet av att designa, utveckla och testa lösningar inom avancerad analys? Är du redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär med möjligheter och utveckling som ledord? Vill du, precis som vi, skapa affärsdrivna end-to-end lösningar som gör verklig skillnad? Då ser vi fram emot att höra ifrån dig!

Vem är du?

Du har ett genuint teknikintresse och drivs av att utvecklas tillsammans med ditt team. Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och är nyfiken på att lära dig av andra. Du är trygg i att ta ansvar för uppgifter där du får strukturera och identifiera affärsmässiga samt tekniska mål, och driva arbetet framåt. Du har lätt för att kommunicera resultat till olika målgrupper, oavsett teknisk nivå och du tar gärna ansvar för leveranser från start till mål.

Du är lösningsorienterad och ser alltid till att kunden får den bästa möjliga lösningen. Eftersom tjänsten även innehåller en och annan fika, tror vi att du gillar att nätverka med kollegor och tillsammans utforska nya idéer, erbjudanden och tjänster. Du är en lagspelare som gärna stöttar dina kollegor när behov uppstår.

Du brinner för att designa, implementera och agera rådgivare inom datalösningar för avancerad analys. Med en operativ inställning omfamnar du DevOps/MLOps och har ett starkt fokus på automation och end-to-end ägarskap.

Vi vill jobba med dig som


har 3+ års erfarenhet av design, utveckling och testning av avancerade BI-lösningar.
har erfarenhet av att implementera lösningar i exempelvis Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake & Snowflake.
har hands-on erfarenhet av programmering inom SQL och Python.
har erfarenhet av att hantera stora datamängder med hjälp av distribuerade ramverk, såsom Apache Spark, för att möjliggöra skalbar och effektiv databehandling.
behärskar svenska och engelska.
har erfarenhet av att utveckla Power BI-rapporter.


Ett plus om du har erfarenhet av


Data Vault
DBT (Data Build Tool)
Machine Learning och AI lösningar


Vårt team

I teamet Data-Driven Transformation samarbetar vi nära med våra kunder för att omvandla data till konkret värde vilket leder till tryggare beslut, effektivare arbetssätt och framgångsrika organisationer.

Vår ambition är att kombinera professionalism och entreprenörsanda och därigenom bidra med både kompetens och kreativitet. Vi strävar efter att vara en partner som inte bara levererar lösningar, utan också inspirerar till utveckling.

Vi är både rådgivare och teknisk partner inom data-drivna system, från design till implementation av lösningar för såväl avancerad analys som machine learning. Det kan handla om att samla in, strukturera och kvalitetssäkra data, skapa visuella rapporter eller möjliggöra mer proaktivt beslutsfattande.

Vårt team innehåller en dynamisk mix av erfarna experter och nya talanger, vilket skapar både energi och arbetsglädje i våra leveranser och interna initiativ. Vi tror på att växa tillsammans genom kompetensutveckling, kunskapsdelning och sociala aktiviteter som stärker både teamkänsla och konsultrollen.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Nyfiken? Vi svarar gärna på frågor, eller berättar mer om oss över en kaffe - du kan enkelt komma i kontakt med oss: tyra.drakenberg@accigo.se

Läs gärna mer om oss och träffa våra medarbetare på vår karriärsida: https://karriar.accigo.se/

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

Du är trygg i att ta ansvar för uppgifter där du får strukturera och identifiera affärsmässiga samt tekniska mål, och driva arbetet framåt. Du har lätt för att kommunicera resultat till olika målgrupper, oavsett teknisk nivå och du tar gärna ansvar för leveranser från start till mål.

Du är lösningsorienterad och ser alltid till att kunden får den bästa möjliga lösningen. Eftersom tjänsten även innehåller en och annan fika, tror vi att du gillar att nätverka med kollegor och tillsammans utforska nya idéer, erbjudanden och tjänster. Du är en lagspelare som gärna stöttar dina kollegor när behov uppstår.

Du brinner för att designa, implementera och agera rådgivare inom datalösningar för avancerad analys. Med en operativ inställning omfamnar du DevOps/MLOps och har ett starkt fokus på automation och end-to-end ägarskap.

Vi vill jobba med dig som

  • har 3+ års erfarenhet av design, utveckling och testning av avancerade BI-lösningar.
  • har erfarenhet av att implementera lösningar i exempelvis Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake & Snowflake.
  • har hands-on erfarenhet av programmering inom SQL och Python.
  • har erfarenhet av att hantera stora datamängder med hjälp av distribuerade ramverk, såsom Apache Spark, för att möjliggöra skalbar och effektiv databehandling.
  • behärskar svenska och engelska.
  • har erfarenhet av att utveckla Power BI-rapporter.

Ett plus om du har erfarenhet av

  • Data Vault
  • DBT (Data Build Tool)
  • Machine Learning och AI lösningar

Vårt team

I teamet Data-Driven Transformation samarbetar vi nära med våra kunder för att omvandla data till konkret värde vilket leder till tryggare beslut, effektivare arbetssätt och framgångsrika organisationer.

Vår ambition är att kombinera professionalism och entreprenörsanda och därigenom bidra med både kompetens och kreativitet. Vi strävar efter att vara en partner som inte bara levererar lösningar, utan också inspirerar till utveckling.

Vi är både rådgivare och teknisk partner inom data-drivna system, från design till implementation av lösningar för såväl avancerad analys som machine learning. Det kan handla om att samla in, strukturera och kvalitetssäkra data, skapa visuella rapporter eller möjliggöra mer proaktivt beslutsfattande.

Vårt team innehåller en dynamisk mix av erfarna experter och nya talanger, vilket skapar både energi och arbetsglädje i våra leveranser och interna initiativ. Vi tror på att växa tillsammans genom kompetensutveckling, kunskapsdelning och sociala aktiviteter som stärker både teamkänsla och konsultrollen.

Kompensation och förmåner

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.

Nyfiken? Vi svarar gärna på frågor, eller berättar mer om oss över en kaffe - du kan enkelt komma i kontakt med oss: tyra.drakenberg@accigo.se

Läs gärna mer om oss och träffa våra medarbetare på vår karriärsida: https://karriar.accigo.se/

Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.

För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!




Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:

We are trusted by over 450 million active users every month across 190+ countries
We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
We are powered by a team of 450+ employees from 45+ nationalities




We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.




The role:

As a Senior Data analyst, you’ll be responsible for the team's quantitative insights. From understanding our data, identifying problems, to working with product, tech, and design on hypothesizing solutions. You’ll be the driver of our experimentation and learning efforts and will collaborate with different teams.




What you will do

Understanding Truecaller's data.
Taking ownership of quantitative insights for your team, playing a crucial role in product development.
Defining experiments, overseeing their setup, and analyzing their results to drive decision-making.
Developing and maintaining key performance indicators (KPIs) for the team, ensuring their tracking, reliability, and reporting.
Creating data pipelines and dashboards to measure the team's KPIs and effectively communicate insights to both the team and leadership.
Coaching and mentoring the team on experimentation and data-driven product development processes, fostering a culture of data-driven decision-making.




What you bring in

4+ years of experience in Data Analytics
Experience in using SQL to extract, transform, and analyse data
Experience in data visualisation tools like Looker (preferred), QlikSense, Tableau, or Power BI
Experience in mentoring, coaching, and evangelizing about data in product development
Experience in digging into different data sources to understand why specific customer behaviours happen
Fluent in spoken and written English




It would be great if you also have

Big data query tools (we use BigQuery).
Experience with data from mobile applications.




What we offer:

We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:




A comprehensive compensation package: We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top-up, pension, and wellness contributions.
Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
A people-focused office culture: We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
Truecaller’s “Lab Days” offer a space for imagination: 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to. It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.




Come as you are:

Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.




Check out Life at Truecaller - Behind the code: https://www.instagram.com/lifeattruecaller/




Sounds like a great opportunity?




We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.




We only accept applications in English.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Till Trygg-Hansa Företagsmarknad söker vi nu en Senior Data Analyst som vill vara med och ta organisationens BI- och analysfunktion till nästa nivå.

Om jobbet | Ta data till insikter som gör skillnad för affären

Som Senior Data Analyst får du en nyckelroll i att driva utvecklingen av BI, analys och datadrivet beslutsfattande inom Företagsmarknad. Du utvecklar moderna rapporterings- och analyslösningar i Power BI och gör data tillgänglig på ett sätt som skapar verkligt affärsvärde. Du arbetar nära beslutsfattare och specialister i verksamheten och omvandlar komplexa affärsfrågeställningar till värdeskapande rapporter, dashboards och dataleveranser som används i det dagliga beslutsfattandet.

Du blir en del av ett erfaret team av analytiker och data scientists som delar kunskap, utmanar varandra konstruktivt och samarbetar tvärfunktionellt med många delar av organisationen. Teamet har ett övergripande ansvar för Företagsmarknads rapportering och analys. Vi utvecklar och förvaltar rapporter och dashboards end-to-end, exempelvis inom försäljning och portföljutveckling. Teamet supporterar också organisationen med data och analys.

Exempel På Ansvarsområden


Identifiera möjligheter att öka användningen av data och BI i verksamheten samt driva förbättringsinitiativ
Omsätta affärsbehov till skalbara analysprodukter, KPI:er och dashboards
Utveckla och vidareutveckla rapporterings- och analyslösningar i Power BI end-to-end
Bygga och förbättra dataflöden samt ETL-processer med moderna tekniker och verktyg
Säkerställa hög användarvänlighet och rätt design i våra rapporter och dashboards
Utveckla ett nära samarbete med stakeholders för att förstå organisationens behov
Ta ägarskap och aktivt bidra i planering av både kort- och långsiktig utveckling
Agera rådgivare till verksamheten i frågor kopplade till analys, rapportering och datadrivet beslutsfattande
Planera och genomföra demo av nya rapporter


Placeringsort är Stockholm och du rapporterar till Chef för Data, Analys & Rapportering.

Om dig | Senior analytiker som skapar insikter och förändring

Det här är en roll för dig som har gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av analys och BI, trivs med stort eget ansvar och vill utveckla lösningar som påverkar både affären, kundvärdet och hur organisationen arbetar med data.

För att kvalificera dig för rollen har du:


Relevant akademisk utbildning inom exempelvis Statistik, Matematik, Datavetenskap, Industriell ekonomi eller annat närliggande område
Minst fem års relevant erfarenhet inom dataanalys/BI i affärsnära roll
Mycket goda kunskaper i Power BI, från datamodellering till dashboard-design
Mycket goda kunskaper i statistisk analys och metoder
Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL.
Erfarenhet av Python, dbt, samt Azure, Databricks eller andra moderna data- och analysplattformar är meriterande
Erfarenhet av att omvandla affärsbehov till datadrivna lösningar som skapar konkret affärsnytta
Förmåga att uttrycka dig väl på svenska och engelska både i tal och skrift


Vi söker dig som har hög kapacitet, stark analytisk förmåga och vilja att bidra till ett team där ansvar, lärande och gemensam utveckling är viktiga delar av vardagen.

För att lyckas i rollen kombinerar du stark analytisk och teknisk kompetens med ett stort intresse för kund- och affärsnära frågor. Du uppskattar att själv arbeta hands-on med data, analys och visualisering samtidigt som du kan lyfta blicken, förstå verksamhetens behov och bidra till att sätta riktning och prioriteringar.

Om oss | Skapa värde med data i stark gemenskap

Trygg-Hansa är en av Sveriges mest välkända försäkringsaktörer och en del av Tryg-koncernen, en av Nordens största försäkringsgrupper. Hos oss får du arbeta i en verksamhet där data, analys och kundinsikter spelar en allt viktigare roll för hur vi utvecklar affären och skapar värde för våra kunder. Vår kultur bygger på tillit, ansvarstagande och att skapa utveckling tillsammans, och vi tror att de bästa resultaten skapas när olika kompetenser och perspektiv får bidra – vi vet att olika erfarenheter och arbetssätt stärker vår förmåga att fatta bättre beslut. Därför arbetar vi aktivt för en inkluderande kultur där fler kan komma till sin rätt och göra ett hållbart och meningsfullt arbete.

Här kan du läsa mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss, möta några av dina framtida kollegor och ta del av mer information om våra medarbetarförmåner.

Ansökan | Vi ser fram emot att höra av dig

Välkommen med din ansökan via länken nedan. Då urvalet sker löpande ser vi gärna att du inkommer med din ansökan snarast möjligt, dock senast 2026-08-23.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Brinner du för att arbeta med data och dataprodukter och vill samtidigt arbeta i samhällets tjänst för en stark och säker ekonomi? Då är denna tjänst för dig! Vi söker dig som vill använda din tekniska kompetens för att fortsätta utveckla hur Riksbanken arbetar med data och analys med fokus på tillgångsförvaltning och betalningar.

VI ERBJUDER DIG

Du får möjlighet att vidareutveckla din tekniska kompetens samtidigt som du fördjupar din kunskap inom Riksbankens verksamhetsområden så att vi utvecklar lösningar som är enkla att ta till sig och som gör nytta i verksamheten. Du möter utmaningar och blir en viktig del i vår förändringsresa - från att utveckla AI och automatisera dataflöden till att bygga robusta IT-lösningar, förstärka cybersäkerhet och bygga framtidens betalningssystem. Här löser du komplexa problem och utvecklas i en prestigelös miljö som präglas av samarbete, nyfikenhet, lärande och mod.

DET HÄR GÖR DU HOS OSS

Riksbankens Data Och Statistik Över Tillgångsförvaltning Och Betalningar Består Till Stor Del Av Mikro- Och Transaktionsdata. Betalningsstatistiken Från Finansiella Institut Är i En Uppbyggnadsfas Och Det Innebär Att Du Är Med Och Utformar Dataflöden Från Grunden. Du Arbetar i Ett Agilt Team Med Helhetsansvar För Sin Data Och Sina Dataprodukter. Konkret Innebär Rollen Att Du


ansvarar för design och utveckling av dataflöden för bearbetning av stora och detaljerade datamängder
skriver automatiska tester för att kvalitetssäkra din kod och underhåller CI/CD-pipelines
utvecklar API:er för att tillgängliggöra data
använder marimo notebooks för att visualisera och tillgängliggöra resultat
bidrar till att utveckla hur Riksbanken använder AI i sin verksamhet


DITT TEAM

Dina närmaste teammedlemmar utgörs av två av Riksbankens datateam där olika kompetenser arbetar sida vid sida och lär av varandra. Datateamen är en del av Riksbankens tvärfunktionella verksamhetsområde Data och Statistik och består av ett femtital medarbetare. Tillsammans med datateamen för du en nära dialog med relevanta policyavdelningar för att leverera data och dataprodukter som är användarvänliga, robusta och värdeskapande. Organisatoriskt kommer du att tillhöra avdelningen för marknader. Här kan du läsa mer om Riksbankens organisation.

MER OM DIG

Vi Ser Att Du Har


en relevant akademisk examen (exempelvis inom data science, matematik, programmering eller liknande)
erfarenhet av att utveckla dataflöden i orkestreringsverktyg som Dagster eller liknande (Airflow, dbt, etc.)
minst 2 års erfarenhet av att koda i Python eller motsvarande programmeringsspråk
erfarenhet av att hantera och bearbeta stora datamängder
goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både skriftligt och muntligt.

Title: Power BI Consultant
Description:
På B3 Indes förvandlar vi data till värdefulla insikter som driver förändring och innovation. Vi skapar lösningar inom AI, Business Intelligence, Data Science och Automation för att maximera värdet av data och stärka företags konkurrenskraft. Vår styrka ligger i att kombinera passion för AI och data med en stark laganda, där vi stöttar varandra och löser utmaningar tillsammans.

Rollen som konsult inom Power BI på B3:

Hos oss får du chansen att jobba med några av Sveriges mest spännande kunder och projekt. Vad innebär det? Jo, att du får:


Gräva i data och hitta insikter som inte bara hjälper våra kunder – utan kanske till och med gör världen lite bättre.
Göra företag mer datadrivna och smartare genom att guida dem i rätt riktning.
Utforma effektiva visualiseringar som våra kunder kan agera på.
Bygga och implementera avancerade lösningar – och faktiskt se dem göra skillnad!


Här handlar det inte bara om teknik – det handlar om att modellera, tillgängliggöra och visualisera data som kan skapa verklig förändring. Vi gillar att tänka stort, experimentera och lösa kluriga problem tillsammans. Och det bästa? Du får ett team av grymma kollegor att bolla idéer med, lära dig av och ha kul ihop med!

Det är din passion för data och analys som gör skillnaden. Utöver det ser vi gärna:


Har du en relevant universitetsutbildning? Toppen! Har du kanske skaffat motsvarande kunskaper genom arbetslivserfarenhet? Det funkar lika bra!
Minst 4 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet – vi letar efter någon som har hunnit samla på sig en del erfarenhet inom området.
Flytande svenska och engelska – eftersom båda språken används dagligen i arbetet.
Tidigare konsultroller är ett plus! Har du jobbat som konsult tidigare? Då är det en extra merit, men inget krav.


Men framför allt...

Har du djup erfarenhet av Power BI och DAX? Grymt – det är viktigt! Men vi lägger också stor vikt vid din förmåga att se helheten, skapa användbara lösningar men framför allt att du är nyfiken. Om du dessutom har koll på:


Någon av de vanligaste databaserna och molntjänsterna
Kanske har du också koll på någon av de andra vanligaste BI-verktygQen (ex; Qlik eller Tableau)
Snowflake och/eller Databricks
Informationsmodellering och Dimensionsmodellering
DevOps och Visual Studio.


Är det här ett stort plus!

Varför välja B3 Indes?

💡 Utveckling & karriär – Väx i en entreprenörsdriven miljö där din kompetens får ta plats.

🌿 Balans & välmående – Vi värnar om ditt välbefinnande med stöd för wellness och en flexibel vardag.

🚀 Energi & gemenskap – Här präglas kulturen av öppenhet, nyfikenhet och en passion för att skapa något större – tillsammans.

❤️ Vi bryr oss – på riktigt – Vi engagerar oss i samhällsfrågor och samarbetar med initiativ som Suicide Zero, My Dream Now och Pink Programming för att göra skillnad även utanför arbetslivet.

En arbetsplats som gör skillnad:

Vi är stolta över att ha utsetts till ett av Sveriges fem främsta karriärföretag 2025 – en utmärkelse som speglar vår energi, nyfikenhet och vårt engagemang för att skapa en inkluderande och inspirerande arbetsplats. Här värdesätts olika perspektiv och idéer, och vi tror att det är just det som gör oss starkare.

Hos oss får du friheten att styra över dina uppdrag, din arbetstid och din utveckling. Vi erbjuder konkurrenskraftiga löner, flexibilitet att forma din vardag och en sund balans mellan jobb och fritid. Och vi vet att gemenskap är minst lika viktigt som teknik – därför satsar vi på allt från konferensresor och sommarfester till sköna AW:s där vi kan släppa jobbet för en stund.

Om B3 Consulting Group

B3 Consulting Group är ett expansivt konsultbolag med cirka 1000 medarbetare. Vi brinner för innovation och hjälper Sveriges ledande företag och organisationer att skapa framtidens möjligheter genom digital transformation. B3 finns på tolv orter i Sverige samt i Polen, med huvudkontor i Stockholm. Bolaget grundades 2003, är noterat på Nasdaq Stockholm Small Cap och omsatte 1 141 MSEK 2023.

Vi är stolta över vår prisbelönta företagskultur, där olikheter, erfarenheter och gemensam energi värdesätts. Som ett etiskt och transparent bolag strävar vi efter att ha en positiv påverkan på samhället, människor och miljön. Vi är även engagerade i Women in Tech och initiativ för att stärka AI-utbildning för kvinnor. 2024 utsågs vi till Årets Employer Branding-företag, och vår HR-chef vann titeln Årets HR-chef.

Är du redo att bli en del av ett företag där din passion för AI och data kan göra skillnad? Läs mer om oss och våra möjligheter här!

Job Description:

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Product Analyst to join the Player Value team on Candy Crush Saga. You will own the analytics and operational support that helps the team understand player behaviour, run better experiments, and make faster, sharper decisions. Your primary focus will most likely be the In-App Purchases (IAP) area, though the role may span other parts of the player journey — early funnel, communication systems, or the in-game economy — as priorities evolve.

This is a role for someone who is genuinely independent and analytically driven: comfortable owning the experimentation lifecycle end to end, partnering closely with Product Managers, translating messy data into clear recommendations, and rolling up their sleeves on operational work at Candy scale without balking at it. You will work cross-functionally every day and gain hands-on exposure to AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Codex, which the team actively uses to accelerate analysis, reporting and communication.

Your Role Within Our Kingdom


Own the experimentation lifecycle end to end for your area — from problem formulation and hypothesis design through analysis, readout, recommendation and follow-up.
Perform quantitative (and, where useful, qualitative) analysis of player behaviour to identify opportunities to improve monetisation, retention and player experience.
Turn complex data into clear insights, recommendations and narratives that Product Managers, Designers and leadership can quickly act upon.
Support pricing decisions by analysing price points, offers and promotions, measuring their impact on conversion, revenue and long-term player value.
Help manage the in-game economy by monitoring balance, sinks and sources, and the health of currency and reward systems while proactively identifying risks and opportunities.
Own tracking specifications by defining the events and metrics needed for new features, writing clear tracking documentation and ensuring instrumentation is implemented correctly so data is trustworthy from day one.
Take ownership of operational work at scale, including reporting, observability, data quality, event integrity and coordination, recognising these as essential parts of delivering value in a live game.
Build and maintain Looker dashboards and reporting frameworks that enable self-service analytics and faster decision-making.
Write robust, performant SQL in BigQuery to answer product questions and power analysis and reporting.
Partner closely with Developers, Product Managers and Data Scientists on end-to-end solution delivery, observability, experimentation and data model improvements.
Use segmentation, funnel analysis and journey mapping to explore complex product questions and uncover meaningful insights.
Use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Codex to accelerate analysis, prototyping and communication.
Support the Analytics craft through knowledge sharing, strong data definitions, shared standards and mentoring more junior analysts.


What Success Looks Like


You become a trusted analytical partner to your Product Manager, helping shape product decisions through data, experimentation and commercial insight.
You provide reliable, actionable insights that improve product decisions and deepen the team's understanding of players.
You help the team move quickly by surfacing the right facts, reducing ambiguity and connecting data to product outcomes.
You operate effectively in a fast-paced live-game environment, solving problems that rarely come with predefined solutions or established playbooks.
You build strong, trusted relationships with Product, Design, Engineering and Analytics partners, contributing to high-quality end-to-end delivery.
Operational work at scale is executed reliably and efficiently because you treat it as a core part of delivering value rather than a maintenance task.


Skills to Create Thrills Core


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of deriving meaningful insights from behavioural or product data.
Strong SQL skills (BigQuery preferred) and confidence working independently with large datasets.
Experience owning or contributing to experimentation and A/B testing, including helping design experiments, interpreting results and translating findings into product recommendations.
Dashboarding experience in Looker (or a comparable BI tool) to build reporting and self-service analytics.
Experience using data to support product, business or operational decisions.
Ability to communicate analysis clearly and concisely through strong data visualisation and evidence-based recommendations.
Comfort working cross-functionally with Product, Design, Engineering and Data Science.
Genuine independence and initiative — comfortable taking ambiguous product problems and driving them through to actionable outcomes.
Willingness to take ownership of operational work at scale, including tracking, observability and data quality, recognising these as essential parts of delivering product value.


Highly Appreciated


Good understanding of statistics, with confidence interpreting experiment results and supporting A/B test analysis.
Python or R for analysis, automation or modelling.
Curiosity about using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Codex to accelerate analysis, reporting and communication. Previous experience is welcome but not required.
Experience in games, live-service products or another fast-moving consumer product.


Role Scope

As a Senior Product Analyst, you will typically operate at the product-theme or feature level, providing analytical leadership across end-to-end solution delivery. You will identify data-driven opportunities, support cross-functional teams through analysis and coordination, and tackle problems that rarely have predefined solutions.

The role complements Product Management and Data Science rather than replacing either. The Analytics craft's core contribution is data-driven discovery, experimentation, exploration and recommendation, with a strong emphasis on product understanding, operational excellence, technical independence, stakeholder partnership and the ability to translate data into better product decisions.

About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. King games are played by more than 200 million monthly active users. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

  • You build strong, trusted relationships with Product, Design, Engineering and Analytics partners, contributing to high-quality end-to-end delivery.
  • Operational work at scale is executed reliably and efficiently because you treat it as a core part of delivering value rather than a maintenance task.

Skills to Create Thrills Core

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of deriving meaningful insights from behavioural or product data.
  • Strong SQL skills (BigQuery preferred) and confidence working independently with large datasets.
  • Experience owning or contributing to experimentation and A/B testing, including helping design experiments, interpreting results and translating findings into product recommendations.
  • Dashboarding experience in Looker (or a comparable BI tool) to build reporting and self-service analytics.
  • Experience using data to support product, business or operational decisions.
  • Ability to communicate analysis clearly and concisely through strong data visualisation and evidence-based recommendations.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with Product, Design, Engineering and Data Science.
  • Genuine independence and initiative — comfortable taking ambiguous product problems and driving them through to actionable outcomes.
  • Willingness to take ownership of operational work at scale, including tracking, observability and data quality, recognising these as essential parts of delivering product value.

Highly Appreciated

  • Good understanding of statistics, with confidence interpreting experiment results and supporting A/B test analysis.
  • Python or R for analysis, automation or modelling.
  • Curiosity about using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Codex to accelerate analysis, reporting and communication. Previous experience is welcome but not required.
  • Experience in games, live-service products or another fast-moving consumer product.

Role Scope

As a Senior Product Analyst, you will typically operate at the product-theme or feature level, providing analytical leadership across end-to-end solution delivery. You will identify data-driven opportunities, support cross-functional teams through analysis and coordination, and tackle problems that rarely have predefined solutions.

The role complements Product Management and Data Science rather than replacing either. The Analytics craft's core contribution is data-driven discovery, experimentation, exploration and recommendation, with a strong emphasis on product understanding, operational excellence, technical independence, stakeholder partnership and the ability to translate data into better product decisions.

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga.
