Title: Power BI-utvecklare
Description:
Vill du bli en del av vår samhällsviktiga och ständigt växande organisation? Vill du ta dig an energiutmaningen och vara med och jobba för ett lysande Sverige? Välkommen med din ansökan till vårt växande team.

Om tjänsten

I takt med att vår IT-division på Svenska kraftnät växer ökar även enhetens uppdrag och Data- och rapportplattformen är och kommer att bli en allt viktigare del i Svenska kraftnäts satsning inom dataområdet.

Vi söker en Power BI-utvecklare som vill vara med på Svenska kraftnäts datadrivna resa genom att omvandla data till värdefulla insikter och skapa beslutsstöd som verkligen gör skillnad i hela verksamheten.Här blir du en del av enheten Dataanalys och dataplattform, som ansvarar för att tillhandahålla plattformar för lagring, analys och delning av data för att möjliggöra en säker och effektiv användning av data och information på hela myndigheten. Enheten svarar på frågor och beställningar om strukturerad data, exempelvis datauttag och publicerade rapporter.

På enheten arbetar ett engagerat team på 20 medarbetare med kompetens inom dataanalys, backend- och frontendutveckling samt IT-specialister som ansvarar för applikationsdrift och support. Vi arbetar enligt agila principer tvärfunktionellt tillsammans med förvaltningsledare och produktägare med både förvaltning och vidareutveckling vilket ger dig möjlighet att samarbeta med experter i hela verksamheten och påverka utvecklingen framåt.

I rollen som BI-utvecklare ansvarar du, tillsammans med teamet, för att säkerställa att våra plattformar och verktyg för lagring, insamling, analys och delning av data fungerar samt vidareutvecklas både proaktivt och enligt verksamhetens behov.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som är strukturerad och har förmåga att se helheten med ett pragmatiskt förhållningssätt. Du trivs med att lösa komplexa problem och är lösningsorienterad samtidigt som du visar på flexibilitet och tålamod när utmaningar uppstår. Samarbete och relationsbyggande är en naturlig del av ditt arbetssätt – i din roll kommer du att möta hela verksamheten och stödja dem framåt genom ditt arbete.

Du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap, är noggrann och dokumenterar systematiskt ditt arbete. Vi ser att du har kompetenserna: strukturerad, relationsskapande, samarbetsorienterad och lösningsorienterad. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Skallkrav:

Du har en relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom Teknik, Systemvetenskap eller Datateknik, eller motsvarande utbildning och arbetslivserfarenhet som Svenska kraftnät bedömer likvärdigt.

Du har även:


Minst 5 års aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av Power BI-utveckling.
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift samt goda kunskaper i engelska.


Meriterande


Erfarenhet av att leda och driva användargrupper eller andra nätverk.
Erfarenhet av att utbilda andra, exempelvis inom Power BI.
Praktisk arbetslivserfarenhet av Power BI i on-prem-miljö.
Arbetslivserfarenhet av att arbeta med/mot datalagerlösningar.
Praktisk arbetslivserfarenhet av Linux och/eller Python.
Erfarenhet av att samarbeta med kompetenser inom infrastruktur.
Erfarenhet av agila arbetsmetoder och verktyg.
God kännedom om IT-säkerhet.


Bra att veta


Tjänsten är placerad i Sundbyberg.
Möjlighet till distansarbete upp till 50 % .
Sista ansökningsdag är den 4 september 2026. Vi använder urvalsfrågor istället för personligt brev.
Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning, provanställning kan bli aktuell.
Beredskap kan komma att bli aktuell framåt.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Stories have the power to make the ordinary extraordinary. They help us think bigger, see beyond ourselves, and deepen our connection with others.

As one of the world’s leading audiobook and e-book streaming platforms, Storytel brings unlimited listening to millions of users across 25 markets. We’re at the forefront of digital storytelling, driven by a vision to make the world a more empathetic and creative place.

Ready for your next chapter? We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join the team in Stockholm.

About The Team

We are proud of our ability to combine technical expertise with sound business sense. This translates to solutions that are not only effective in addressing current challenges but also sustainable long term. Our team is composed of Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers, fostering a collaborative environment that enables us to manage data end to end – from optimizing data pipelines to developing user-friendly models for analysis.

Our technology stack includes BigQuery (SQL), Looker, dbt™, and Google Cloud Platform, with opportunities to evaluate and introduce new technologies as we scale.

About The Role

As an Analytics Engineer, you'll work with developing data capabilities that power decisions across our global organization. You'll have significant technical and organizational impact, driving both immediate solutions and long-term strategic initiatives.

Examples Of Responsibilities


Develop data transformation steps and build a strong data modeling foundation for enabling self-service analytics across the company.
Build and maintain trusting, working relationships with business partners across domains and discover high-impact opportunities to enable self-service analytics in our semantic layer.
Strategically plan and deliver meaningful projects to increase data literacy at Storytel.
Lead the resolution of critical data issues, establishing monitoring systems and best practices to prevent future problems and improve data reliability.
Collaborate with data practitioners to understand their needs and requirements, breaking down complicated technical concepts to fit the audience.
Drive adoption of technical best practices across the data team, mentoring others and bringing in industry innovations that improve how we work.



We believe that you have


Experience with creating and maintaining semantic layers.
Experience in working with data (BI/Analytics/Data Engineering) specializing within Analytics Engineering.
Deep expertise in SQL and data modeling and extensive experience with modern data stack technologies (e.g., dbt™, Looker, BigQuery, or equivalent tools).
The ability to consistently deliver performant, accurate, and scalable solutions.
Experience mentoring junior engineers and driving team-wide technical improvements.
Proven ability to lead complex data projects, solve problems independently, and proactively improve products.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to various audiences.
The ability to thrive in a feedback culture and constantly strive to improve your own skills and knowledge.



Bonus If You Experience


Working with Python.
With data governance and access management.
With different data modeling schemas.
Working with international teams and global data operations.



Join a world of stories

At Storytel, we’re a team of creative story lovers who thrive on collaboration and new ideas. Our workplace is friendly, dynamic, and full of opportunities to experiment and make an impact. We believe in trust, flat hierarchies, and empowering you to grow with us.

Does this sound like your next story? Simply fill out the application form and share your CV or LinkedIn profile – no cover letter needed. Answer a few questions, and you’re all set.

Does this sound like you? If you feel like Storytel is a place where you could thrive, please submit your application in English and we will contact you as soon as possible.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Are you passionate about tracking and finding the best ways to build, develop, and maintain event tracking for one of Sweden’s largest sites and apps? Then here are some great news for you!

Hemnet is looking for an Implementation Specialist to ensure our tracking is seamless and that the data we collect is utilized to its full potential.

About The Role 🍏

In the role as an Implementation Specialist, you will be a key player in our journey to make Hemnet even more data-informed. As a part of the Analytics team closely collaborating with our product analysts you will act as a vital bridge between development, product teams, legal and other business units. Your mission is to ensure that user data is accurate, AI-ready, and that we understand the legal aspects of the things we track. It is also the roles’ responsibility to ensure that we track the right things, not everything.

With laser focus on the "back end" of analytics - ensuring data is clean, reliable, and well-modeled - you will play a crucial part in helping Hemnet continuously improve our experiences for our users.

What You’ll Do 💥


Establish tracking plans and frameworks to ensure multiple development teams at Hemnet track data consistently and accurately.
Develop and refine our technical foundation for tracking as well as how we work with tracking.
Build the foundation of Hemnet’s data structure, ensuring behavioral data is accessible and easy to use for all teams.
Ensure compliance: Work closely with the legal team to maintain a solid legal perspective on data collection, ensuring that we follow Swedish law and privacy regulations over time.


Who We Think You Are 🤩

To be successful in this role, we believe you have a technical and data-focused background with multiple years of experience working with tracking implementations, migrations and/or validations. As the bridge between tech and the analytics team, you excel at tailoring your communication for all stakeholders - ensuring that analytics requirements and needs are translated into tracking specifications for developers to understand and implement, leading to the data we collect being used in both business and product development.

Required Skills


Hands-on tracking expertise: You have proven experience setting up and managing tracking and data collection across both web and app.
Data privacy savvy: You understand the legal frameworks (GDPR, consent management, privacy laws) linked to collecting user data in digital environments.
Proficient in analytics tools: You feel right at home working in analytics and tracking platforms like Google Analytics or Amplitude.


Bonus


Product analytics experience: You go beyond standard traffic analysis, bringing a deep understanding of digital product analytics and the ability to act as a knowledgeable sparring partner for our Product Analysts.
Amplitude proficiency: You have hands-on experience working directly with Amplitude.
Technical collaboration skills: You’ve worked closely with tech teams on how data collection is implemented, keeping a strong focus on both data quality and site/app performance.


I am your new manager 👋

My name is Thomas Hanusek. I joined Hemnet about four years ago. Prior to that, I drove analytics for more than 20 years across different companies. My passion at work is really about seeing how Data & analytics can drive product and business development in the best way possible.

As a leader, I am a huge fan of seeing how a team can come together and, through their different skills, create magic. My aim is to be supportive and humble, and to create an environment where you feel trusted, challenged, and empowered to grow.

A Note on Inclusion 💚

At Hemnet, we believe that diversity in gender, sexual orientation, ability, neurodiversity, cultural background and life experience makes us stronger. We welcome applicants of all identities and backgrounds.

If you meet many but not all of the requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, a strong sense of purpose and the motivation to learn and grow, alongside your skills and experiences.

An Office-First Culture 🙏

Our office in central Stockholm is the true hub of our company culture. We are proudly an office-first team because we deeply value face-to-face collaboration and believe our best work happens when we are together. While we understand the need for occasional flexibility, we strongly prioritize in-person teamwork over remote work. Because our office is the center of our daily operations, it is essential that you are based in or near Stockholm.

Please note that we're unable to provide relocation assistance for this opportunity.

Hemnet is Sweden’s largest property platform. Since the start in 1998, we have been the natural meeting place for real estate agents, property sellers and buyers. Hemnet offers the majority of properties for sale on the market; the largest number of potential buyers; products through which sellers are able to influence the selling of their property - and products that give real estate agents the opportunity to strengthen their brand. We are one of Sweden’s largest sites and apps, and one of the most popular property platforms in the world based on population.

Title: Labor Demand Expert
Description:
Job Description



WHAT YOU WILL DO



As a Labor Demand Expert, you own the logic that translates store demand signals into labour hours. You build and continuously improve the global labour demand model, ensuring labour allocation is data‑driven, fair and aligned with both commercial and operational realities across store types and markets.



You will:



Own and develop the end‑to‑end labour demand model, translating demand signals into task frequencies and labour hours
Ensure the model reflects real store activity patterns and evolves with changes in customer behaviour, omnichannel flows and operating models
Define, document and maintain assumptions, scaling rules and calculation logic in a clear and structured way

Title: Quantitative Risk Analyst, Credit Risk Data Management [Assistant/Regular/Senior]
Description:
Job ID: 5814

We are looking for Quantitative Risk Analyst [Assistant/Regular/Senior] from all background and level to join our Risk Models Data and Strategy teams that is recognized for its professionalism, competence and capabilities.

Do you enjoy working with data analysis? Do you like solving problems and finding new and innovative solutions? Do you understand the principles of banking and are you able to apply this knowledge in your daily work?

If you have previous experience with Credit Risk models, then great! If you have a flair for data and a genuine interest in analysis, you are also welcome!

About Our Team

Meet the Credit Risk Data Management, a part of the Risk Models Data & Strategy organization in Risk Models. We have an ambitious development plan for development of IRB models and together with our colleagues in Nordea we’ll be part of creating the future of banking.

The Risk Models Data & Strategy department, is a department consisting of 6 team, each specialized in their own part of ensuring high quality data is supporting the bank capital foundation. We add value to Nordea and our customers by improving Nordea data quality, helping visualizing and create the understanding of our data so modelling teams can build great internal models used for Own Funds calculation and the for risk management.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Quantitative Risk Analyst, the specific role may vary based on qualifications, but you could i.e. play a valuable role in Data analytics, optimizing data flows, product management or as a data governance specialist. Your role could also include coordinating data related activities and ensuring proper communication within the teams and across other Risk Models areas.

Main responsibilities in this role:


Root-cause analysis for data quality issues, where we meticulously investigate and identify the underlying reasons for any discrepancies in our data. This is closely followed by data reconciliation, ensuring that our data sets are consistent and accurate across different sources.
We focus on optimizing data flows and algorithms to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our data processes.
Own and manage all data used in credit risk models across the end-to-end lifecycle, applying data product mindset to capture, enhance and realize value throughout credit risk models.
Identify and govern critical data elements though strong knowledge of credit risk models, regulatory expectation and capital.
Secure our Data Governance framework and processes with focus on effective Data Quality Controls, also ensuring documentation of Data Lineage toward all data providers and consumers for credit risk data.
Preparing reports and other documentation for senior management and external reporting is also an integral part of our role, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making.


You’ll join an international team with variety of backgrounds and skills. We believe that strong drive and passion for change are fundamental for delivering on our commitments. Bring your background and skills to our team, and you will have plenty of opportunities to collaborate, grow and develop.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you:


Have an adaptability to thrive in fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Are structured and able to coordinate several deliveries simultaneously.
Are self-driven and able to work independently but also enjoy collaboration with others.
Have strong analytical skills and keen attention to detail with the ability to analyse complex data and processes to derive meaningful insights.
Have good communication and presentations skills, are not afraid to speak up and can effectively convey business requirements to IT teams and facilitate collaboration between stakeholders.
Are curious and proactive, focus on solutions rather than problems and share our enthusiasm for developing and learning and constantly improving your skills and competences.


Your background and skills include:


Experience with Credit Risk modeling, capital reporting, and understanding regulatory requirements as BCBS239 and TRIM.
Knowledge of SQL, SAS, Snowflake, Python or similar.
Master’s degree in finance, economics, engineering, physics, mathematics or similar.
A strong focus on results, deliveries and deadlines.
Experience with Big Data would be an asset.
An interest in finance and technology.


What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 09/08/2026.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

Title: Total Rewards Analyst
Description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.


We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role

As Total Rewards Analyst, you'll be the analytical backbone of Legora's reward function — turning data into insight across compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility. You'll work directly within the Total Rewards team, reporting to the VP of Total Rewards, and collaborate closely with the Total Rewards Manager.

This is a role for someone who is energised by making sense of complex data, building robust processes, and making sure every part of our reward engine runs smoothly and accurately.

What You Will Do


Build and maintain reward reporting and dashboards covering compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility — enabling the team and leadership to make data-informed decisions.
Support compensation benchmarking cycles: gather and clean market data, model scenarios, and present findings clearly.
Analyse equity data to track grant activity, vesting milestones, and programme performance across regions.
Build and improve People operations processes across the reward function — creating workflows and documentation that reduce manual effort and increase accuracy.
Support the administration of benefits programmes across markets, coordinating with external vendors and ensuring data accuracy.
Support the mobility programme operationally — coordinating documentation, timelines, and third-party providers.
Help prepare materials for employee and manager communications on compensation, benefits, and equity topics, and contribute to reward-related compliance activities as needed.


Who You Are

You love digging into data to find patterns and build clarity out of complexity. You're a natural problem-solver with a keen eye for process, accuracy, and making things run better.

We Think You'll Thrive Here If You Have


3–5 years of experience in a People, Reward, Finance, or Operations analyst role — ideally in a high-growth or international environment.
Strong analytical skills with experience handling complex datasets; proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets is essential, and experience with HRIS or reward tools is a plus.
Familiarity with compensation frameworks, equity programmes, or benefits administration — even if not a specialist in all areas.
High attention to detail and comfort working with sensitive, confidential data.
A process-builder mindset: you don't just do the work, you look for ways to make the work better.
Clear and confident communicator, able to present data and findings simply to a range of stakeholders.


Why Legora

This is an exceptional opportunity to grow within a reward function that's building from the ground up. You'll gain broad exposure across every dimension of total rewards — compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility — while working alongside experienced people leaders in a company with real momentum.

We value clarity, humility, and impact. Your work will directly support the team that shapes how every Legora employee is rewarded. We're just getting started.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Designa, utveckla och underhålla data pipelines och ETL-processer.

Minst sex års arbetserfarenhet inom data science och dataanalys.
Flytande svenska och engelska både i tal och skrift.

Stark kunskap i SQL och Python.
Erfarenhet av molnplattformarna Azure, AWS eller GCP.

Erfarenhet inom data engineering.
Erfarenhet som IT-konsult.
Erfarenhet av plattformarna Databricks, Snowflake och Power BI.
Erfarenhet av maskininlärning och AI.
Erfarenhet av teknologoier och programmering inom Pyspark, Scala, R eller liknande.
Kunskap inom NLP.

Du är en analytisk och initiativtagande problemlösare. Du brinner för att lösa kundproblem och vill stötta dem på bästa möjliga sätt samtidigt som du utvecklas.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Bifoga ditt CV eller din LinkedIn-profil så kontaktar vi dig. Intervjuer kommer att hållas löpande, så vi uppmuntrar dig att ansöka redan idag!

Vi utför bakgrundskontroller av alla slutkandidater.

Tieto avböjer samtal från rekryteringsföretag.

Tieto skapar meningsfull teknologi som bidrar till att göra världen bättre. Vi är ett ledande techbolag med lång historia och närvaro i Norden men har också global kapacitet. Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Norrin is an AI integrator, enabling end-to-end Enterprise AI and data solutions that turn ambition into production and drive real productivity gains. We co-create the solutions, infrastructure, and adoption that make it stick. What brings us together is deep technical expertise, a creative engineering mindset, and a people-first culture. Norrin has strong roots in Finland while operating internationally across the Nordics, the United States, and APAC. Our presence across the Nordics has continued strengthening with BizOne recently joining the Norrin Group.

We’re looking for a Data Engineer to join our growing team in Stockholm. You might be a data enthusiast with a couple of years under your belt or already a more seasoned professional. What matters most to us is your willingness to keep learning, take ownership, and work on solutions that create clear business value.

In this role, you will work on a variety of cloud-based customer projects, designing and building modern data platforms and analytics solutions using Azure Data Platform services, Databricks, and AI-enabled tools. Your work may include data modelling, integrations, and architectural design, always in close collaboration with customers and internal experts. You will also be part of Norrin’s Data Engineering Guild, a community where knowledge is shared, skills are developed together, and people actively support each other’s growth.

What We’re Looking For


2-5 years of experience as a Data Engineer or in analytics solution development
Experience building Databricks and/or Fabric-based solutions in an Azure environment
Understanding of data warehousing, data modelling, and integrations
Good collaboration skills and a customer-oriented mindset
Curiosity and initiative to keep learning new things and stay up to date
Ability to communicate technical solutions clearly, also to non-technical stakeholders
Fluency in Swedish and English
Strong skills in SQL and Python/PySpark
Experience building data pipelines using Databricks, dbt, Microsoft Fabric or similar
Solid understanding of data security and privacy principles
Experience with dimensional modelling
Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD principles


Nice to have


Experience with Power BI and automated reporting
Experience with GenAI or machine learning, including MLOps
Understanding and/or experience with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake


Why Norrin? 

At Norrin, you'll join an international team of 220 professionals working across Finland, Sweden, Thailand, Vietnam, and the United States. We work with nordic enterprises that have the ambition to be the forerunners in data and AI across a wide range of industries, from industrial and finance to retail and energy. The diversity of projects, technologies, and business challenges keeps the work both meaningful and engaging. We never work alone but always together with clients and our colleagues.

We invest in continuous learning through training and certification opportunities, as well as our guild communities where knowledge is shared and built together. As a Microsoft and Databricks partner, we work with leading technologies and support you in continuously expanding your expertise. At Norrin, you'll have the opportunity to grow in a direction that matters to you. We believe that great work starts with a supportive environment. That's why we foster a culture built on openness, equality, and mutual respect, with psychological safety at its core. We're committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities in the tech industry.

Our hybrid working model combines flexibility with collaboration, giving you the freedom to work remotely while bringing people together when it creates the most value. To support your well-being, we also offer wellbeing benefits like insurance coverage and an annual wellness allowance. Depending on the role, our competitive compensation model offers a fixed salary model or a hybrid model including base salary and a performance-based bonus.

Could this be your next opportunity?

We’re excited to hear from you! Submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications on an ongoing basis and move forward as soon as we find the right match.

Title: Staff AI Product Analyst, Product Management | Sweden | Remote
Description:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the UK, Germany, Sweden or Spain.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Staff Product Analyst to join our growing Product Analytics team and serve as a strategic partner to Grafana’s AI organization. This role will support the teams building Grafana Assistant, our synchronous chat experience; Investigations, our asynchronous AI workflow for incident analysis; and AI observability solutions, including Agent Observability.

You will shape how the AI team measures success by defining KPIs, improving measurement practices, guiding experiment design and evaluation, and translating data into recommendations that influence product decisions.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and Data partners, with a primary focus on supporting the AI team, and report to the Product Analytics Manager

If you’re excited about building strong product analytics capabilities and using data to shape the future of AI-powered experiences at Grafana, we’d love to hear from you.

You Will


Partner cross functionally across Product to establish top-level KPIs, dashboards, and product roadmap planning
Define how success is measured for AI-powered product experiences, including adoption, engagement, quality, retention, and user outcomes
Guide the instrumentation of product data in collaboration with our Product Design, Product Management, and Engineering teams to enable reliable analysis of AI features and workflows.
Design, evaluate, and interpret experiments to assess the impact of new AI capabilities and inform product decisions.
Develop dbt models to transform and test our user behavior data in partnership with our Analytics Engineering team
Influence best practices for Product Analytics across teams and help define standards as the company scales
Contribute to defining the long-term vision and strategy for Product Analytics, balancing near-term needs with scalable, durable solutions.



You have


Experience partnering across product and engineering organizations, and familiarity with typical product KPIs and frameworks (e.g., DAU/MAU, funnels, A/B testing)
Experience defining and tracking success metrics for complex product areas, ideally including AI-powered features or workflows.
SQL: writing complex yet efficient SQL is a daily habit for you
Data Visualization: experience with any of the following tools: Tableau, Looker, Omni, Hex, or of course, Grafana!
Experience writing dbt models, implementing Product Analytics tooling (e.g., Heap, Pendo, Amplitude, FullStory), and code version control (git)
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to quickly prototype and iterate across analysis, data modeling, instrumentation, visualization and code development.
Excellent communication skills, able to explain technical topics to non-technical audiences, and maintain many of the essential cross-team and cross-functional relationships necessary for the team’s success



A plus if you have


Knowledge about observability
Familiarity with Airflow or Prefect - generating ad hoc ETL jobs



In Sweden, the Base compensation range for this role is SEK 775,444 - 930,533. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.


Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.
Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.



Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs


100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.



Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

Your focus will be on advancing analytics capabilities, optimizing data workflows, driving innovation in the cloud, and unlocking the full potential of the organization’s most valuable asset – data.

About The Role

The Data & Analytics Engineering department comprises specialized teams focused on Data Infrastructure Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Data Management.

As a Data Analytics Engineer, you'll play a central role in building and optimizing the organization's supporting analytics layer, collaborating across the bank. This role offers broad opportunities to grow and make a tangible impact!

We offer a hybrid working model with two common in-office days. While we value flexibility, we also prioritize collaboration, team-building, and enjoying fikas and after-work gatherings together!

Main Tasks


Design and implement efficient data models, focusing on analytics workflows and end-user usability.
Build robust and scalable data pipelines to support business intelligence and analytics needs.
Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, such as Risk, Finance, and IT, to ensure data solutions align with business needs.
Ensure data quality, security, and compliance throughout the analytics lifecycle.
Drive technical improvements, introducing modern tools and processes to enhance analytics capabilities.
Partner with other engineers to align transformation processes for analytics purposes.


We Are Looking For Someone Who

Enjoys working with data & analytics engineering, modern data practices, and creating insights that drive decisions. We believe you are a detail-oriented and proactive person who thrives in a high pace enviroment and enjoy learning new technologies. For This Role You’ll Need


Work experience in a similar role within data engineering or analytics engineering
An academic degree related to analytics engineering, data engineering, or similar fields.
Proficiency in ETL processes, designing analytics-ready datasets, and ensuring clean and usable data for stakeholders.
Proficiency in Databricks, dbt (SQL), python and related reporting tools and languages.
Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools.
Fluency in English is required, along with fluency in either Swedish or Norwegian.


It’s a Plus If You Have


Experience with Microsoft’s data stack (Azure, SQL, and other cloud services).
Experience working with on-prem solutions.

Title: Analytics Engineer II
Description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer II to join Spotify's Platform Central Data (PCD) squad, a cross-functional Data Engineering and Analytics Engineering team within the Platform Mission. You’ll help build and maintain trusted analytical models, metrics, and data products that power developer productivity, platform health, and leadership decision-making. Working closely with Data Engineers, Product, Engineering, and Platform partners, you’ll translate platform signals into reliable, well-modeled data assets that help Spotify ship faster and safer.

What You"ll Do


Build and maintain analytical data models using dbt (or similar SQL-based transformation frameworks) in BigQuery for a broad set of stakeholders
Build and operate reliable data pipelines using SQL, with a focus on testing, observability, and CI/CD
Help define and evolve key metrics for platform health, developer productivity, and ML/AI platform adoption
Partner with Data Engineers on upstream pipelines and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to scope and deliver insights
Improve data quality, performance, and cost efficiency across pipelines and models, including troubleshooting and backfills
Contribute to dashboards and self-serve data products that enable better decision-making across teams
Follow and contribute to data quality, testing, and documentation practices across the analytics layer
Participate in a fair support rotation for key datasets, pipelines, and analytical products


Who You Are


You have 2+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related field
You have strong SQL skills and experience with data modelling
You are experienced with dbt (or similar SQL-based transformation frameworks) and a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks SQL
You are familiar with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or Flyte
You care about data quality, reliability, and testability
You are comfortable working with BI/visualisation tools such as Looker or Tableau
You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners
You are able to prioritize and deliver in a fast-moving environment
You have experience with platform or developer productivity data, experimentation, or ML/AI metrics


Where You'll Be

This role is based in London or Stockholm.

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Title: Management Consultant - Data & Analytics
Description:
Your role




Our Data & Analytics (D&A) team combine broad business understanding with technical expertise to help our clients make better data-driven decisions.




Expect to participate in projects ranging from advisory services to hands-on development of D&A solutions. We help our clients define a strategy, organize their D&A capabilities, and implement data platforms and analytical solutions. The analytical work ranges from business intelligence to Machine Learning and Generative AI.




Together with an ambitious and multidisciplinary team of colleagues, you will help our clients understand their current situation, risks, and opportunities and advise how they can use technology to solve their business needs. The type of projects will be varied, and you will have access to experts throughout our international community of consultants.




Your professional and personal growth will be supported by a Development Manager. As you deepen your expertise and grow as a consultant, you will take on greater responsibilities in our client engagements and our internal business activities. Such as team development, employer branding, developing new offerings, pitching to clients, and other activities.




What We Are Looking For In Our New Colleagues




You may have a background as a developer and now want to combine technical work with more business‑focused and strategic responsibilities. Alternatively, you may work in Consulting, have a strong technical interest, and want to deepen your expertise within data and AI.




We Expect Candidates To Have




Experience in data collection and analysis, along with a general understanding of business processes.
Familiarity with Business Intelligence solutions and Generative AI development, as well as programming proficiency in Python and SQL.
Some experience with Database design, ETL, and Data Visualization is also desirable.
Experience with Microsoft´s Data & Analytics tools is a plus (Fabric, PowerBI, SQL Server, Data Factory, etc.)
Ability to balance analytical rigor with practical, implementable recommendations.
Structured communication, adapting style to managers and operational teams and an ability to establish credibility quickly in new environments.
A master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other relevant field.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint to support daily business activities.
Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, spoken and written.




What We Offer




BearingPoint is a great place to work. We can offer you the opportunity to work for a company with a global reach and a unique culture that allows everyone to reach their highest potential. We also offer team-specific competency development opportunities and employee benefits such as:

Professional and personal growth, supported by your Development Manager.
An international, dynamic, and inspiring work environment.
A steep learning curve in client-facing roles with a high impact on the business performance of our clients.
Competitive compensation and benefits package, including but not limited to an occupational pension, health insurance, wellness grants, expanded parental benefits, and more.
Competency development opportunities include our First 1000-day program and other Nordic & Firm-wide training and boot camps (Grow with BearingPoint).
An annual curriculum of various social events and sports activities.




What Now?




Send us your resume in either Swedish or English, and we´ll get back to you shortly. A cover letter is optional, and Interviews will be held continuously.




During the interview process, you will meet various colleagues from the team and conduct case interviews.




Want to find out more about the team? Meet some of our colleagues here (Meet our Sweden team), or read an article with our D&A team lead Marcus Ehrndal here.




As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be subject to background checks. These checks help us ensure a safe and trustworthy workplace and may include verification of identity, employment history, education, and any relevant criminal records, in accordance with applicable laws.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.

We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.

The Role

As an Analytics Engineer in the Analytics Foundation team, you help the whole company use data with confidence. You sit in a small team with real ownership: we shape how analytics engineering is done here, not only what gets built. You will make architectural decisions for data modelling and set the bar for quality, maintainability, and how we work. This is not a role where you only implement models from a backlog of “orders”; you partner with the business and with technical teams, surface trade-offs when needed, and help prioritise work that compounds.

We spend most of our time on larger initiatives that improve the platform and how people use data, rather than reacting to a constant stream of ad-hoc questions. The team has a high degree of autonomy over its agenda, little firefighting, and we have invested for years in automating repetitive work so we can focus on impact. You will work hands-on with modern data tooling and with AI-assisted workflows, including coding agents and agent-style automation where they genuinely speed up design, review, and deliver, while staying responsible for correctness, governance, and clarity for stakeholders.

You will develop and maintain core models, quality practices, and governance; support the warehouse and pipelines; and help teams get the most from BI and GTM tooling. Tools in our stack include Snowflake, dbt core, Hex, Prefect, Fivetran, and Hightouch (among others).

Key Responsibilities


Design, own, and evolve core data models and the modelling architecture; including how they connect to pipelines, freshness, and operational reliability in the warehouse.
Empower the organization to use and interpret data.
Partner with business and technical stakeholders from problem framing to shipped artefacts: clarify requirements, suggest better approaches when a request would not scale, and drive or co-drive cross-team initiatives that improve how data is used.
Collaborate closely with other data professionals; this includes giving actionable feedback in code reviews as well as actively supporting with data modeling
Combine subject matter expertise and a high level business understanding to contribute to the direction and strategy for Mentimeter in the realm of data modeling, AI-Analysis, BI-tooling and data activation in GTM-Tooling.
Develop, own and maintain data modeling standards and the data development experience
Improve how we work at scale: thoughtful automation and AI-assisted engineering (e.g. coding agents and repeatable workflows) with human accountability for correctness and compliance.
Maintain and grow how knowledge is surfaced, e.g in semantic models, a data catalog, or documentation



We Believe You Have


Roughly 4-7 years of relevant hands-on experience as an Analytics Engineer, Data Analyst, Data Scientist, BI Analyst, or similar (or equivalent depth if your path is non-linear).
Strong SQL and sound judgment in data modelling (grain, reusability, naming, and how metrics should behave).
Experience partnering across departments, including leading or co-leading cross-functional work that shipped something others use.
Strong business acumen with an understanding of sales, marketing, and product analytics.
Ability to map ambiguous stakeholder needs to clear, maintainable models and artefacts.
Experience with BI-tools and development of BI features
Knowledge of software collaboration using git.
Communication in English with both technical and non-technical audiences; interest in helping others grow their data skills.
Experience working with GDPR-sensitive data and collaborating with legal experts on compliance assessments.



It Is Beneficial If You Have


Hands-on experience with dbt (or similar)
Experience with a semantic or metrics layer
Experience using AI-assisted coding or coding agents in a disciplined way (reviews, tests, documentation), with clear judgment about automation vs verification for production data work.
Professional experience working in an agile environment



Not Required


Swedish is not required (daily work is carried out in English and the Mentimeter team currently boasts 50+ different nationalities).
A cover letter is not required as part of your application



📍 Location:

This is primarily an onsite role located at Mentimeter HQ in Stockholm, with a hybrid approach and ability to work from home up to twice per week.

Please note that we do not offer visa relocation sponsorship for this position.

💡Our Recruitment Process


Introduction interview
Competence interview, including a live case.
Culture interview
References & Offer



Compensation

At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you.

The salary range for this role is SEK 50,000–SEK 68,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact.

Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.

In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm.

What Mentimeter Can Offer

At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.

All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page

AI and Hiring at Mentimeter

At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.


AI does not screen or decide on candidates.

Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.

We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.

The Role

As an Analytics Engineer in the Analytics Foundation team, you help the whole company use data with confidence. You sit in a small team with real ownership: we shape how analytics engineering is done here, not only what gets built. You will make architectural decisions for data modelling and set the bar for quality, maintainability, and how we work. This is not a role where you only implement models from a backlog of “orders”; you partner with the business and with technical teams, surface trade-offs when needed, and help prioritise work that compounds.

We spend most of our time on larger initiatives that improve the platform and how people use data, rather than reacting to a constant stream of ad-hoc questions. The team has a high degree of autonomy over its agenda, little firefighting, and we have invested for years in automating repetitive work so we can focus on impact. You will work hands-on with modern data tooling and with AI-assisted workflows, including coding agents and agent-style automation where they genuinely speed up design, review, and deliver, while staying responsible for correctness, governance, and clarity for stakeholders.

You will develop and maintain core models, quality practices, and governance; support the warehouse and pipelines; and help teams get the most from BI and GTM tooling. Tools in our stack include Snowflake, dbt core, Hex, Prefect, Fivetran, and Hightouch (among others).

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, own, and evolve core data models and the modelling architecture; including how they connect to pipelines, freshness, and operational reliability in the warehouse.
  • Empower the organization to use and interpret data.
  • Partner with business and technical stakeholders from problem framing to shipped artefacts: clarify requirements, suggest better approaches when a request would not scale, and drive or co-drive cross-team initiatives that improve how data is used.
  • Collaborate closely with other data professionals; this includes giving actionable feedback in code reviews as well as actively supporting with data modeling
  • Combine subject matter expertise and a high level business understanding to contribute to the direction and strategy for Mentimeter in the realm of data modeling, AI-Analysis, BI-tooling and data activation in GTM-Tooling.
  • Develop, own and maintain data modeling standards and the data development experience
  • Improve how we work at scale: thoughtful automation and AI-assisted engineering (e.g. coding agents and repeatable workflows) with human accountability for correctness and compliance.
  • Maintain and grow how knowledge is surfaced, e.g in semantic models, a data catalog, or documentation


We Believe You Have

  • Roughly 4-7 years of relevant hands-on experience as an Analytics Engineer, Data Analyst, Data Scientist, BI Analyst, or similar (or equivalent depth if your path is non-linear).
  • Strong SQL and sound judgment in data modelling (grain, reusability, naming, and how metrics should behave).
  • Experience partnering across departments, including leading or co-leading cross-functional work that shipped something others use.
  • Strong business acumen with an understanding of sales, marketing, and product analytics.
  • Ability to map ambiguous stakeholder needs to clear, maintainable models and artefacts.
  • Experience with BI-tools and development of BI features
  • Knowledge of software collaboration using git.
  • Communication in English with both technical and non-technical audiences; interest in helping others grow their data skills.
  • Experience working with GDPR-sensitive data and collaborating with legal experts on compliance assessments.


It Is Beneficial If You Have

  • Hands-on experience with dbt (or similar)
  • Experience with a semantic or metrics layer
  • Experience using AI-assisted coding or coding agents in a disciplined way (reviews, tests, documentation), with clear judgment about automation vs verification for production data work.
  • Professional experience working in an agile environment


Not Required

  • Swedish is not required (daily work is carried out in English and the Mentimeter team currently boasts 50+ different nationalities).
  • A cover letter is not required as part of your application


📍 Location:

This is primarily an onsite role located at Mentimeter HQ in Stockholm, with a hybrid approach and ability to work from home up to twice per week.

Please note that we do not offer visa relocation sponsorship for this position.

💡Our Recruitment Process

  • Introduction interview
  • Competence interview, including a live case.
  • Culture interview
  • References & Offer


Compensation

At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you.

The salary range for this role is SEK 50,000–SEK 68,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact.

Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.

In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm.

At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla prissättning som skapar affärsnytta, stärker konkurrenskraften och bidrar till lönsam tillväxt? Nu söker vi en Pricing Specialist till K-Bygg.




Som Pricing Specialist på K-Bygg blir du en nyckelperson i arbetet med att utveckla, analysera och optimera vår prissättning över hela sortimentet. Du ansvarar för att skapa datadrivna, konkurrenskraftiga och lönsamma prisstrategier som stärker K-Byggs position som en ledande helhetsleverantör till byggproffs och hemmafixare.




Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med kategori- och inköpsteamet samt med försäljning, marknad och controlling. Du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt med prissättningsfrågor och bidrar med analyser, insikter och rekommendationer som stödjer affärens utveckling.




Rollen är placerad på K-Byggs huvudkontor och rapporterar till Head of Category Management Building.




I rollen kommer du bland annat att:



Analysera marknads- och konkurrentpriser för att säkerställa både konkurrenskraft och lönsamhet.
Utveckla och underhålla prisstrategier och prisstrukturer för K-Byggs produktkategorier, både för butik och e-handel.
Implementera prisjusteringar i linje med affärsstrategi, leverantörsvillkor och säsongsvariationer.
Arbeta aktivt med priselasticitet, marginalmål och prissättningsmodeller anpassade för olika kundsegment.
Säkerställa hög kvalitet på prisdata i K-Byggs system.
Utveckla rapporter och dashboards för uppföljning av prissättningsrelaterade nyckeltal.
Bidra till det strategiska arbetet med dynamisk prissättning och digital prisoptimering.



Du kommer även att arbeta med och följa upp KPI:er såsom:



Bruttomarginal per kategori.
Prisindex mot nyckelkonkurrenter.
Prisimage och kundens upplevelse av pris.
Datakvalitet i prissystem.



Hos oss får du en roll där du kombinerar analys, affärsförståelse och kommersiellt driv. Du får möjlighet att påverka hur vi arbetar med prissättning och bidra till att skapa tydligare beslutsunderlag, bättre lönsamhet och ett starkare kunderbjudande.



Kvalifikationer



Vi tror att du har en relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom exempelvis ekonomi, statistik, industriell ekonomi eller motsvarande. Det kan vara en högskoleutbildning, YH-utbildning eller motsvarande kunskaper förvärvade genom arbetslivserfarenhet.




Du har erfarenhet av prissättning, affärsanalys, kategoriarbete eller liknande, gärna inom retail, byggmaterialhandel eller annan närliggande bransch. Du är van att arbeta med större mängder data och har god förståelse för hur analys kan omsättas till konkreta affärsbeslut.




Vi ser gärna att du har:



Erfarenhet av arbete med prissättning, affärsanalys eller kategoriarbete.
God vana av att arbeta i större datasystem och analytiska verktyg.
Mycket goda kunskaper i Excel.
Erfarenhet av Power BI eller liknande BI-/analysverktyg.
Erfarenhet av ERP-system.
Förståelse för marginal, lönsamhet, priselasticitet och kommersiella samband.
God förmåga att hantera, strukturera och analysera stora mängder data.
Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av e-handel och prisstrategier online, men det är inget krav.



Som person tror vi att du är analytisk, noggrann och affärsdriven. Du har ett starkt sinne för detaljer, men kan samtidigt lyfta blicken och se hur prissättning påverkar kundvärde, lönsamhet och affär. Du är strukturerad, självgående och trivs i en roll där du får kombinera analys med praktisk affärsutveckling.




Du är också en god kommunikatör som har lätt för att samarbeta med olika delar av organisationen. Du trivs med att arbeta tvärfunktionellt och har förmåga att förklara komplexa samband på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt. Ett intresse för byggmaterial och kundernas behov ser vi som positivt.




Känner du igen dig i flera av punkterna ovan, men inte i alla? Då vill vi ändå gärna höra från dig. För oss är det viktigaste att hitta rätt person med rätt driv, nyfikenhet och vilja att utvecklas tillsammans med oss.




Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt kontakt från rekryteringsföretag, bemanningsföretag och försäljare av rekryteringstjänster i samband med denna rekrytering. Alla kontakter hänvisas till HR-avdelningen.

Title: Power BI Consultant
Description:
På B3 Indes förvandlar vi data till värdefulla insikter som driver förändring och innovation. Vi skapar lösningar inom AI, Business Intelligence, Data Science och Automation för att maximera värdet av data och stärka företags konkurrenskraft. Vår styrka ligger i att kombinera passion för AI och data med en stark laganda, där vi stöttar varandra och löser utmaningar tillsammans.

Rollen som konsult inom Power BI på B3:

Hos oss får du chansen att jobba med några av Sveriges mest spännande kunder och projekt. Vad innebär det? Jo, att du får:


Gräva i data och hitta insikter som inte bara hjälper våra kunder – utan kanske till och med gör världen lite bättre.
Göra företag mer datadrivna och smartare genom att guida dem i rätt riktning.
Utforma effektiva visualiseringar som våra kunder kan agera på.
Bygga och implementera avancerade lösningar – och faktiskt se dem göra skillnad!


Här handlar det inte bara om teknik – det handlar om att modellera, tillgängliggöra och visualisera data som kan skapa verklig förändring. Vi gillar att tänka stort, experimentera och lösa kluriga problem tillsammans. Och det bästa? Du får ett team av grymma kollegor att bolla idéer med, lära dig av och ha kul ihop med!

Det är din passion för data och analys som gör skillnaden. Utöver det ser vi gärna:


Har du en relevant universitetsutbildning? Toppen! Har du kanske skaffat motsvarande kunskaper genom arbetslivserfarenhet? Det funkar lika bra!
Minst 4 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet – vi letar efter någon som har hunnit samla på sig en del erfarenhet inom området.
Flytande svenska och engelska – eftersom båda språken används dagligen i arbetet.
Tidigare konsultroller är ett plus! Har du jobbat som konsult tidigare? Då är det en extra merit, men inget krav.


Men framför allt...

Har du djup erfarenhet av Power BI och DAX? Grymt – det är viktigt! Men vi lägger också stor vikt vid din förmåga att se helheten, skapa användbara lösningar men framför allt att du är nyfiken. Om du dessutom har koll på:


Någon av de vanligaste databaserna och molntjänsterna
Kanske har du också koll på någon av de andra vanligaste BI-verktygQen (ex; Qlik eller Tableau)
Snowflake och/eller Databricks
Informationsmodellering och Dimensionsmodellering
DevOps och Visual Studio.


Är det här ett stort plus!

Varför välja B3 Indes?

💡 Utveckling & karriär – Väx i en entreprenörsdriven miljö där din kompetens får ta plats.

🌿 Balans & välmående – Vi värnar om ditt välbefinnande med stöd för wellness och en flexibel vardag.

🚀 Energi & gemenskap – Här präglas kulturen av öppenhet, nyfikenhet och en passion för att skapa något större – tillsammans.

❤️ Vi bryr oss – på riktigt – Vi engagerar oss i samhällsfrågor och samarbetar med initiativ som Suicide Zero, My Dream Now och Pink Programming för att göra skillnad även utanför arbetslivet.

En arbetsplats som gör skillnad:

Vi är stolta över att ha utsetts till ett av Sveriges fem främsta karriärföretag 2025 – en utmärkelse som speglar vår energi, nyfikenhet och vårt engagemang för att skapa en inkluderande och inspirerande arbetsplats. Här värdesätts olika perspektiv och idéer, och vi tror att det är just det som gör oss starkare.

Hos oss får du friheten att styra över dina uppdrag, din arbetstid och din utveckling. Vi erbjuder konkurrenskraftiga löner, flexibilitet att forma din vardag och en sund balans mellan jobb och fritid. Och vi vet att gemenskap är minst lika viktigt som teknik – därför satsar vi på allt från konferensresor och sommarfester till sköna AW:s där vi kan släppa jobbet för en stund.

Om B3 Consulting Group

B3 Consulting Group är ett expansivt konsultbolag med cirka 1000 medarbetare. Vi brinner för innovation och hjälper Sveriges ledande företag och organisationer att skapa framtidens möjligheter genom digital transformation. B3 finns på tolv orter i Sverige samt i Polen, med huvudkontor i Stockholm. Bolaget grundades 2003, är noterat på Nasdaq Stockholm Small Cap och omsatte 1 141 MSEK 2023.

Vi är stolta över vår prisbelönta företagskultur, där olikheter, erfarenheter och gemensam energi värdesätts. Som ett etiskt och transparent bolag strävar vi efter att ha en positiv påverkan på samhället, människor och miljön. Vi är även engagerade i Women in Tech och initiativ för att stärka AI-utbildning för kvinnor. 2024 utsågs vi till Årets Employer Branding-företag, och vår HR-chef vann titeln Årets HR-chef.

Är du redo att bli en del av ett företag där din passion för AI och data kan göra skillnad? Läs mer om oss och våra möjligheter här!

Title: Advanced Data Analysis Engineer
Description:
Job Description

Coherent Corp is the global leader in photonics, designing and manufacturing advanced laser, optical, and materials technologies. Our innovations power semiconductor manufacturing, AI infrastructure, advanced communications, and precision industrial systems worldwide. With a global footprint and cutting-edge manufacturing and R&D, we’re shaping the future of high-tech industries.

In Sweden, our teams operate Sweden’s only full-scale indium phosphide wafer fabrication facility, where we design, manufacture, and test some of the world’s fastest optical chips under one roof, supporting AI infrastructure, data centres, and global communications networks worldwide.

The Role

We are seeking a Data Analysis Engineer to join our Product Verification Group in Järfälla. In this role, you will be responsible for analysing complex device characterization data to support product development, process optimisation and technical decision-making across our advanced optoelectronic technologies.

You Will Be Responsible For


Analysing device characterization data across multiple design, process and operating factors to support design optimisation and process understanding.
Performing statistical analysis of device performance, including the impact of process variation, measurement uncertainty and test noise.
Identifying trends and relationships within complex datasets and providing clear, actionable insights to engineering and design teams.
Developing and improving automated data processing and analysis workflows to enhance efficiency and scalability.
Presenting technical findings through graphical visualisations, reports and technical documentation to support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, including Chip Design, Wafer Fabrication Process Engineering, Operations, Quality & Reliability and Project Management.


About You

You are an analytical and curious problem solver who enjoys working with complex datasets and transforming information into meaningful insights. You are comfortable working across technical disciplines and communicating findings to a range of stakeholders.

You Will Also Have


A Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics or a related technical discipline.
Experience in data analysis, statistics, engineering data processing or a related field.
Strong knowledge of statistical analysis, data processing, automation and database technologies.
Experience analysing complex datasets and applying appropriate statistical and analytical methods.
An understanding of measurement variation, test uncertainty and noise analysis.
Experience with programming, scripting, databases or engineering analysis tools.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate assumptions, limitations and conclusions.
A structured approach to problem-solving, a strong sense of ownership and a continuous learning mindset.
Fluent English language skills; Swedish is considered a strong advantage.


We Offer


A dynamic and international working environment.
An appreciative and collaborative company culture.
Unique technical challenges supporting the products of tomorrow.
Competitive benefits and social programmes.


Ensure adherence to company's values (ICARE) in all aspects of your position:

🤝 Integrity – Create an Environment of Trust

✨ Collaboration – Innovate Through the Sharing of Ideas

🎯 Accountability – Own the Process and the Outcome

🌍 Respect – Recognize the Value in Everyone

🚀 Enthusiasm – Find a Sense of Purpose in Work

Application & Selection

Current employees who wish to apply should submit a cover letter detailing their interest in the position and how their skills and experience align with the requirements of the role.

At Coherent, recruitment is conducted on an ongoing basis. Candidates progressing to the final stage of the process will be required to complete alcohol and drug testing, background checks and reference checks as part of our standard recruitment procedures prior to employment.

If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the application process, please reach out to kris.cairns@coherent.com. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds.

About Us

Coherent is a global leader in lasers, engineered materials and networking components. We are a vertically integrated manufacturing company that develops innovative products for diversified applications in the industrial, optical communications, military, life sciences, semiconductor equipment, and consumer markets. Coherent provides a comprehensive career development platform within an environment that challenges employees to perform at their best, while rewarding excellence and hard-work through a competitive compensation program. It's an exciting opportunity to work for a company that offers stability, longevity and growth. Come Join Us!
