Title: Dataanalytiker til Capital Market Development
Description:
Er du dygtig til at gennemskue og skabe mening i data, og har du erfaring med programmering? Tiltaler komplekse finansielle produkter og markeder dig? Så har vi en spændende mulighed i vores afdeling CMD Data & Derivatives.

Vi søger en ny dataanalytiker til vores team Quantitative Market Data (QMD), som kommer til at spille en central rolle i opbygningen af et solidt datafundament og udviklingen af datadrevne løsninger til kapitalmarkedsområdet i Jyske Bank – herunder understøttelse af vores kommende AI-løsninger.

Bliv en del af et ambitiøst og stærkt fagligt miljø

Capital Market Development leverer løsninger og koncepter til bankens kapitalmarkedsområde, der understøtter handel med en bred portefølje af finansielle instrumenter - primært for store erhvervs- og institutionelle kunder. Området består af ca. 50 specialister fordelt i tre afdelinger.

Du vil blive en del af Quantitative Market Data (QMD), hvor du sammen med dygtige kolleger inden for både IT og analyse arbejder tæt på forretningen med data som omdrejningspunkt.

Som en del af vores AI-satsning arbejder vi med at bringe data og modeller i anvendelse i nye forretningsmæssige sammenhænge, hvor et godt datafundament er afgørende. Du får derfor mulighed for at være med helt fremme i udviklingen af nye datadrevne løsninger.

Arbejd med komplekse data – og skab konkrete resultater

Ansvarsområderne i QMD er centreret omkring data og dataunderstøttelse af processer. En vigtig del af rollen er at skabe struktur og sammenhæng i data gennem modellering, så vi kan arbejde ud fra et fælles og konsistent datagrundlag.

Som dataanalytiker vil du:



Sparre med brugere og interessenter om anvendelse af kapitalmarkedsdata
Udvikle løsninger selvstændigt og i tæt samarbejde med områdets IT-udviklere
Identificere og omsætte forretningsbehov til datadrevne løsninger
Bidrage til analyser, modeller og værktøjer – herunder datagrundlag til AI-anvendelser
Arbejde med data fra strukturering til færdig implementering



Opgaverne varierer, men har altid afsæt i data og en ambition om at skabe målbar værdi.

Om dig og dine kvalifikationer

Du har en relevant faglig baggrund – fx cand.oecon, cand.scient.oecon eller lignende – og motiveres af at arbejde med data i en kompleks forretning.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:



Har gode analytiske evner og arbejder struktureret
Har forståelse for værktøjer der anvendes til dataanalyse og formår at omsætte denne viden til forretningsmæssig værdi
Har erfaring med at bruge AI-værktøjer og er nysgerrig på at udvikle dine kompetencer yderligere
Har interesse for programmering (gerne erfaring med SQL, R eller lignende)
Kan omsætte komplekse behov til konkrete løsninger
Er samarbejdsorienteret og bidrager engageret i dit team
Kommunikerer klart og formidler komplekse emner enkelt



Erfaring med finansielle produkter er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Derfor skal du vælge os

Hos os bliver du en del af et team med høj faglighed, stor indflydelse og kort vej fra idé til implementering. Vi arbejder i et miljø med godt samarbejde, høj motivation og fokus på løbende udvikling – både fagligt og personligt.

Ansøgning

Vi oplever mangfoldighed som en fordel i vores opgaveløsning og i vores fællesskab. Derfor opfordrer vi alle til at søge.

Vi ser frem til at modtage dit CV og et motiveret skriv, hvor du beskriver dine færdigheder i forhold til jobbet og din bevæggrund for at søge hos os. Rekrutteringsprocessen varetages i samarbejde med HR Rekrutteringspartner Jens Trøst Poulsen.

Seneste ansøgningsfrist er d. 14. august 2026.

Title: Data Engineer
Place: Sønderborg, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Would you like to work for a company with solutions that contributes to Saab’s mission of keeping people and society safe?

Would you like to be a part of shaping the Future of Digital Engineering and building the Future of Engineering?

Engineering is evolving rapidly. Model Based Systems Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, connected engineering data, and digital collaboration are transforming how complex systems are designed and delivered.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to help build the data foundation that enables modern engineering. You will connect engineering data, improve digital workflows, and prepare the organization for AI enabled engineering.

Your role

You will:


Develop data pipelines and system integrations across engineering tools
Improve data quality, consistency, governance, and traceability
Support Digital Thread and MBSE initiatives
Prepare engineering data for AI and advanced analytics
Design scalable data models and dashboards
Identify opportunities to automate engineering processes
Collaborate with engineers, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver practical solutions



Your Profile

You have experience in one or more of the following areas:


Data Engineering
Software Engineering
Systems Engineering
Data Science
Computer Science
Information Technology



Experience with Python, SQL, APIs, cloud platforms, Power BI, graph databases, engineering lifecycle tools, or AI technologies is an advantage but not a requirement.

More important than your exact background is your ability to solve complex problems, connect information, and turn data into business value.

We Are Looking For Someone Who


Thinks analytically and works in a structured way
Enjoys collaborating across technical disciplines
Is curious about new technologies and continuous improvement
Can translate engineering challenges into digital solutions
Takes ownership and delivers pragmatic results



Why Join Us

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of engineering, data, and emerging technologies.

Your work will help accelerate Digital Engineering, strengthen MBSE adoption, improve engineering efficiency, and establish the foundation for future AI capabilities.

If you want to build solutions that will influence how engineering is performed in the years ahead, we would like to hear from you.

What can you expect from us?

Saab Danmark is a company that is growing and you will therefore experience a company that is dynamic and able to adapt. In the Saab group we have a saying” Business is done between people”, and this is also the environment you can expect here. We offer:


Initial learning process with mentorship and support
Good career and development opportunities in a professional company
A vibrant and international atmosphere with colleagues from all over the world
Benefits that support our employees’ wellbeing
A variety of social activities, lunch scheme, pension as well as flexible work conditions
Focus on our teams, good cooperation and giving our employees the ability to take ownership of their tasks.



Candidates must be able to obtain a security clearance by the Danish Defence Intelligence Service. This entails that candidates, as a minimum, have had residency within NATO/EU for the last 7 years.

About Saab Danmark A/S

Saab in Denmark is part of the Saab Group with headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden. At the same time, Saab Danmark is an independent legal company with a flat organisational structure. Our main business area is delivering integrated communication solutions to military markets in Denmark and abroad.

You can find further information about our integrated communication solution TactiCall, at www.saab.com/naval.

Title: Business Analyst - FP&A
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About The Role

We're seeking a driven Business Analyst to join our FP&A team - someone who’s eager to work directly with senior leadership and contribute to data-driven decisions from day one in a high-impact role that offers real visibility and room to grow.

Now a delisted, growth-equity backed business, OrderYOYO is entering an exciting new chapter – a clear testament to our bold growth ambitions and the fast paced, high-impact environment we are building.

In this role, you’ll gain broad exposure across the business by collaborating with Management, Commercial teams, Tech, and Product Owners. You'll play a key role in turning data into actionable insights with an analytical approach, including testing hypotheses, doing in-depth analysis and presenting findings for key stakeholders. As you grow, you’ll have the freedom to shape your path based on your strengths and interests.

Here’s a taste of what you’ll be doing:


Assist with scenario analysis to help inform strategic decisions made at the leadership level.
Assist with invoicing processes and mature existing logic towards a more automated process.
Structure and analyse raw data, translate business needs into data requirements, and collaborate with Tech on onboarding and integration.
Design and analyse commercial experiments (A/B tests, hypothesis-driven investigations) to test what works before scaling.
Apply modelling techniques in Python (classification, regression, clustering, segmentation) where they sharpen the answer to a commercial question.
Build and enhance Power BI reports using our Microsoft Fabric data platform, supporting both management and internal stakeholders.


What We Are Looking For In You


Experience in a commercial analytics, FP&A, consulting, or business analyst role - ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, or subscription business.
Strong Excel and Power BI skills. Comfortable building reports and analytical views on a modern data platform (Microsoft Fabric or equivalent).
Experience with experimentation and hypothesis testing (A/B tests, causal inference and OLS).
Working Python skills (pandas, scikit-learn). Able to build and interpret classification, regression, and clustering models for commercial questions - not building production pipelines.
Strong commercial instinct. Comfortable presenting findings to senior stakeholders and translating numbers into recommendations.
Structured problem-solving. Can take an open commercial question and decompose it into a testable hypothesis.
Interest in applied AI/ML - e.g. using LLMs to accelerate analytical workflows.


Why Join Us?


Direct exposure to decision-making at the highest level and learn how business challenges are tackled at the top level.
Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.
Expect personal development plans and ongoing training tailored to your growth.
A dynamic, supportive environment where critical thinking is encouraged and your voice matters.
Be part of a high-growth journey in a growth equity-backed company, where ambition meets opportunity - and your impact truly matters.


Great To Have (But Not Required)


Exposure to Power BI, SQL, DAX, Python, and/or Power Query.
ML & AI intuition, such as K-fold cross-validation, exploiting gradients and similar.
Familiarity with FP&A concepts: budgeting, variance analysis, forecasting cycles.
Experience or interest in working on cross-functional projects involving Tech/Product, Operations, Sales and Marketing


What we do at OrderYOYO

OrderYOYO is a provider of white-label online ordering, payment, marketing, and POS software solutions to independent local takeaway restaurants. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.

Who We Are At OrderYOYO

Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One team) are what makes us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

Please note interviews for this role will be conducted in September

  • Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.
  • Expect personal development plans and ongoing training tailored to your growth.
  • A dynamic, supportive environment where critical thinking is encouraged and your voice matters.
  • Be part of a high-growth journey in a growth equity-backed company, where ambition meets opportunity - and your impact truly matters.

Great To Have (But Not Required)

  • Exposure to Power BI, SQL, DAX, Python, and/or Power Query.
  • ML & AI intuition, such as K-fold cross-validation, exploiting gradients and similar.
  • Familiarity with FP&A concepts: budgeting, variance analysis, forecasting cycles.
  • Experience or interest in working on cross-functional projects involving Tech/Product, Operations, Sales and Marketing

What we do at OrderYOYO

OrderYOYO is a provider of white-label online ordering, payment, marketing, and POS software solutions to independent local takeaway restaurants. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.

Who We Are At OrderYOYO

Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One team) are what makes us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

Title: Advanced Analytics Specialist, Supply Chain Intelligence
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you passionate about driving high-impact projects in a global supply chain? Do you want to play a key role in delivering transformational initiatives that shape how Ambu scales, operates, and delivers value to patients worldwide?

Ambu is transforming – and this is your opportunity to shape how intelligence drives our supply chain.

We have recently evolved our analytics function into a Supply Chain Intelligence team within our Global Supply Chain organization, and we are seeking an Advanced Analytics Specialist to join us. The team’s ambition is clear: moving from describing what happened to knowing what to do next. You will play a central role in delivering this journey; building predictive and prescriptive models, enabling what-if scenarios and decision support, and strengthening the data foundation that underpins it all; while helping build a data-driven culture across the global supply chain.

At Ambu, we are on an ambitious growth journey - scaling our operations and capabilities to meet the rising global demand for our innovative medical solutions. As part of this journey, you will join a highly motivated team that values initiative, impact, and collaboration; and you will have a front-row seat in maturing how data and intelligence power our global supply chain.

The role

As an Advanced Analytics Specialist, your primary responsibility is to design, build, and deploy analytics solutions that move our global supply chain from descriptive dashboards to predictive and prescriptive intelligence. You will work across our five focus areas: data foundation, reporting & visibility, advanced analytics, decision support, and analytics enablement; with the greatest emphasis on advanced analytics and decision support.

This is a hands-on role where technical depth meets business-centric problem-solving. Working closely with the Advanced Analytics Manager, GSC, you will partner with stakeholders across corporate functions and manufacturing sites – bridging business and IT – to ensure that data becomes a strategic asset embedded in how Ambu’s supply chain makes decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced analytics & decision support (primary focus)


Develop, deploy, and maintain predictive and prescriptive models (e.g., forecasting, anomaly detection, optimization) that address concrete supply chain challenges across planning, operations, and distribution
Build what-if scenario and simulation capabilities that give leadership actionable decision support; not just reporting
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical problems, and analytical results into clear recommendations for stakeholders and leadership
Automate recurring analyses and workflows to free capacity across the organization for higher-value work
Take ownership of solutions end-to-end: from problem framing and data preparation to model deployment in collaboration with back-end IT, monitoring, and adoption


Data foundation, visibility & analytics enablement


Contribute to advancing our data foundation toward a single source of truth; improving data quality, governance, and data models in collaboration with IT
Develop and enhance Power BI dashboards and standard GSC reporting where they create genuine visibility and value
Support upskilling across the global supply chain through training, documentation, and self-service enablement; helping embed a data-driven culture
Stay curious about new technologies (AI, machine learning, modern analytics tooling) and proactively bring relevant opportunities into the team


Suggested candidate profile

Skills

Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be described on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this position if you have:


2–5 years of experience in analytics, data science, or business intelligence roles. You may have gained your experience in a consultancy, an industrial company, or a data-driven scale-up
Strong hands-on skills in SQL and Python (or R) for data preparation, analysis, and modelling
Solid experience with Power BI – including DAX and data modelling – and an eye for visualizations that drive decisions
Experience building predictive models (e.g., forecasting or machine learning) and bringing at least one into real operational use; you know the difference between a notebook and a solution people rely on
Strong business translation skills; you can turn a vague business question into an analytical approach, and an analytical result into a clear recommendation
A working understanding of supply chain processes (e.g., planning, manufacturing, logistics, or distribution); you don't need to be a supply chain expert, but you can speak the language of operations and understand the physical flows behind the data
Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills; you build trust quickly and collaborate effectively across functions and levels
A proactive, structured and independent way of working: you thrive in a maturing environment where you help build the way, not just follow it


It is an advantage if you have experience with the following:


Deeper experience within supply chain planning, S&OP, or distribution analytics
ERP data (e.g., Infor), cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Fabric), or optimization and simulation techniques
Experience in integrating new data (e.g., through API/EDI) into database and semantic models
Experience in training or upskilling non-technical colleagues
Exposure to a GxP-regulated industry


Please note that due to the upcoming summer holiday period, the recruitment process may take slightly longer than usual. We expect to begin the interview process at the beginning of August.

Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Do you have a strategic and analytical mindset? Do you possess a proactive attitude and thrive in a data-driven decision making environment? Do you fancy a career as a data scientist in Denmark’s largest retailer?

Then you might be our new colleague

We are looking for a business minded data scientist to be part of our Business Analysis team in Netto Finance, located at Netto HQ in Køge.

You and the team have the responsibility of driving strategic projects across business units utilizing and processing the huge amount of data available in Salling Group leading to insights that enable more informed business decision-making creating a difference for our customers.

Your Tasks And Responsibilities


Through data analyses create insights to support core retail and finance processes
Together with the team, design, develop and implement tools and models that utilize the data to create business impact in new ways
Ensure efficient data availability including tailor-build tools
Support the general data-driven transformation in Salling Group


Your Skills And Background

You have a Master’s degree within economics, IT or engineering (e.g. cand.scient, cand.oecon, cand.merc). Preferably, you have a couple of years’ of experience as a data scientist or in a similar role, where you have acquired the necessary skills to succeed as a data scientist.

Alternatively, you compensate for your lack of experience by being a top-performer and by having relevant experience in a student job during your studies. You have a natural interest in data and how it can be utilized to create business impact. Beside your passion for data, you have a strong business acumen enabling you to utilize the right data and making the best analysis for the problem at hand.

You have an analytical mindset, a structured way of working and is a real problem-solver. You have experience with extracting, cleaning and transforming data as well as data modelling creating measures and reports that fuel solid business decisions across Salling Group.

You have experience with programming/scripting languages such as R, Python, DAX and SQL.

As a person you are curious of nature and have an eagerness to take on a very steep learning-curve. You are proactive and have a ‘self-starter attitude’ and can independently focus, see opportunities and invite yourself to the table.

Fluency in Danish is an advantage.

We offer


An exciting career with a steep learning curve in an international company in continued growth, giving you extensive opportunity for both personal and professional growth
A diversified job with impact and responsibilities
Being part of a highly professional team in a dynamic environment offering you deep insights in retail
Competitive salary package and benefits


Are you the person for the job?

Send your application, resume and copy of your grades as soon as possible - and no later than August 14th 2026.

Please note that applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis and therefore the job application may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have proceeded with candidates to the screening or interview phase

Title: Finance Digital Analyst
Place: Dragør, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Om stillingen 

Vi søger en Finance Digital Analyst til Sunclass Airlines, som kombinerer stærke analytiske kompetencer med interesse for digitalisering og datadrevet økonomistyring.

Som Finance Digital Analyst bliver du en del af et dygtigt og engageret Finance team og får en central rolle med betydelig indflydelse på tværs af den bredere Finance funktion. I tæt samarbejde med forretningen, og det lokale Finance team, bidrager du til den fortsatte udvikling af økonomistyring og performance rapportering på tværs af vores forretningsområder.

Derudover, får du en central rolle i vores digitale transformationsrejse med fokus på udvikling og vedligeholdelse af automatiseringsløsninger. Dertil kommer forbedring af rapportering samt videreudvikling af Power BI og AI agenter i Finance funktionen. Formålet er at styrke datadrevet beslutningstagen og forbedre kvaliteten af finansiel indsigt.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

Som vores nye Finance Digital Analyst vil dine primære ansvarsområder være at:


Drive udviklingen af Power BI, datamodellering i DAX, semantiske modeller og rapportudvikling
Udvikle Power Automate-løsninger og automatisering af processer
Videreudvikle rapporterings- og budgetmodeller ved brug af Power Query, pivottabeller, komplekse formler og generel opbygning af finansielle modeller
Drive udviklingen af AI-værktøjer, f.eks. Copilot Studio, Claude Code eller prompt engineering, og AI-understøttelse af forskellige arbejdsprocesser
Samarbejde med stakeholders på tværs af Sunclass Airlines og koncernen for at øge transparens, performance management og finansielt overblik
Deltage i måneds- og årsrapportering
Arbejde med både historiske data, budgettering og forecasts
Løbende sikre, at processer fungerer effektivt og lever op til vores krav og procedurer
Være aktiv i automatiseringen og digitaliseringen i vores Finance Excellence-program


Hvem søger vi

Vi Ønsker, At Du Opfylder Følgende


Minimum bachelorgrad inden for finans, økonomi, IT, dataanalyse, ingeniørvidenskab eller et tilsvarende relevant område
Erfaring med datamodellering, DAX, semantiske modeller og rapportudvikling
Erfaring med udvikling og vedligeholdelse af Power Automate-flows samt automatisering af finansielle processer
Erfaring med Power Query, pivottabeller, komplekse formler og generel opbygning af finansielle modeller
Flydende i dansk, svensk eller norsk i både skrift og tale
Flydende engelsk i både skrift og tale


Som person er du en stærk teamplayer, der værdsætter åben kommunikation og bidrager til et positivt samarbejde på tværs af organisationen. Du arbejder analytisk og løsningsorienteret og har evnen til effektivt at håndtere og omsætte store datamængder til værdifulde indsigter. Samtidig har du en metodisk tilgang til dine opgaver og et skarpt øje for detaljen, hvilket sikrer høj kvalitet i dit arbejde. Du er resultatorienteret og fokuseret på at skabe værdi gennem dine opgaver, samtidig med at du arbejder struktureret, proaktivt og selvstændigt i et dynamisk miljø. Derudover motiveres du af at arbejde med økonomiske problemstillinger og at identificere og implementere forbedringer af digitale processer.

Vi tilbyder 

Vi tilbyder et spændende og udviklende arbejdsmiljø, hvor du har mulighed for at gøre karriere internt i koncernen. Du får en varieret hverdag med fart over feltet, hvor vidensdeling og samarbejde er i højsædet – dette på et nordisk plan, da vi arbejder på tværs af de nordiske lande for at sikre de bedste uger på året for vores kunder i alle lande. Vi elsker vores arbejde og glæder os til at byde dig velkommen på vores rejse i Sunclass Airlines og Nordic Leisure Travel Group.

Vi tilbyder desuden en række personalegoder som sundhedsforsikring, kantineordning og personalerabat på rejser.

Vores kontor i Københavns Lufthavn Syd i Dragør er med gratis parkering og bus lige udenfor døren.

Øvrigt

Stillingen er fast fuldtidsansættelse. Løn og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til funktionæroverenskomsten.

Ansøgningsfrist: 23. august 2026.

Start: Snarest muligt eller efter aftale.

Kontaktperson: Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Finance Manager Jesper Jensen på tlf: +45 20 21 21 74.

Da du skal arbejde i koncernens luftfartsselskab og skal have adgang til lufthavnens område, er det en forudsætning, at du gennemgår et udvidet baggrundscheck og kan opretholde denne godkendelse hos Politiet i Danmark.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning!

For at hjælpe os med at placere de rigtige personer i de rigtige roller tror vi på videnskabeligt baserede og retfærdige vurderingsmetoder. Derfor anvender vi, som en del af vores rekrutteringsproces, Alva Labs' testværktøjer. De hjælper os med at forbedre kvaliteten af vores ansættelser ved at identificere de kandidater, der med størst sandsynlighed vil trives og få succes i rollen.

Vil du vide mere om Alva Labs? Du kan finde yderligere information her: Alva Labs

Sunclass Airlines is part of the Nordic Leisure Travel Group (NLTG), which consists of the tour operators Spies in Denmark, Ving and Globetrotter in Sweden, Ving in Norway, Tjäreborg in Finland and the hotel company Resorts & Hotels. Sunclass Airlines flies the majority of the travel group's guests to our charter destinations and has over 1.000.000 travelers per year.

Read more about us at sunclassairlines.dk.

Title: Product Owner & Analytics Engineer
Description:
Vil du være med til at forme fremtidens dataplatform i en af Danmarks største energivirksomheder?

Har du evnen til at forstå forretningens behov, prioritere de vigtigste indsatser og omsætte dem til dataløsninger, der skaber værdi i praksis? Så er du måske vores nye Product Owner & Analytics Engineer.

En nøglerolle i udviklingen af OK's dataplatform
Du bliver en del af Data Engineering & BI, som har en central rolle i at gøre data til et strategisk aktiv på tværs af OK. Drive data- og analyseinitiativer fra idé til forretningsværdi.
Eje og prioritere backloggen for dit område.
Omsætte forretningsbehov til data products, KPI'er og analyser.
Udvikle genanvendelige datamodeller og forretningslogik.
Sikre høj anvendelse af data gennem stærke løsninger og tæt forretningsdialog.
Udfordre behov og skabe alignment mellem forretning, IT og Data.
Bidrage til udviklingen af OK's moderne dataplatform.

Title: Market Intelligence Analyst - Copenhagen
Description:
Are you driven by analysing, solving and communicating clear, actionable recommendations to business challenges? Would you like to translate industry, consumer, competitor and product data into insights within a global organisation?

Deliver insights and recommendations that influence decisions across a global business

As a Market Intelligence Analyst, you will join our Consumer & Market Intelligence team within Global Marketing in Copenhagen. Working with global and regional stakeholders across departments, you will play an important role in helping decision-makers understand market developments, consumer needs, product performance and competitor activity.

In your first months, you will gain a strong understanding of how ECCO builds collections, how data supports decision-making and how the team works within the agile Scrum framework. Over time, you will grow into a trusted partner to stakeholders and take ownership of recurring projects and analytical deliverables.

More Specifically, You Will


Generate industry, consumer, product and competitor insights using both quantitative and qualitative methods.
Translate data into clear recommendations, presentations and reports for stakeholders across the business.
Collaborate with colleagues globally to understand business challenges and identify opportunities.
Support key milestones in the collection and product development process through analysis, testing and market intelligence.
Contribute to developing and improving our analytical tools, reporting capabilities and data visualisation environment.


You will become part of a collaborative and curious team that values knowledge-sharing, continuous learning and open dialogue. Together, we support key business processes and strategic initiatives by transforming complex data into insights and recommendations that create business value. The role includes regular travel to ECCO HQ in Tønder, typically a couple of nights per month, where you will collaborate with Category and Design teams.

Use your analytical mindset to uncover meaningful insights

You enjoy exploring data, identifying patterns and connecting information to business opportunities. At the same time, you can communicate your findings in a way that is accessible and actionable for a wide range of stakeholders. You are curious, collaborative and motivated by learning and developing your expertise in a global environment.

To Succeed In The Role, We Imagine That You


Hold a bachelor's or master's degree in economics, business administration, social sciences or a related field.
Bring at least two years of relevant experience within analytics, market intelligence, consumer insights or a similar area.
Have a strong business acumen and analytical approach to problem-solving.
Are proficient in Excel and PowerPoint. Prior experience with data visualisation software (e.g. Power BI) and SQL (Snowflake) is an advantage but not required.
Communicate confidently in English, both verbally and in writing.
Build positive relationships with stakeholders and enjoy working across teams and functions.


Experience with market intelligence platforms, qualitative research or the fashion and footwear industry is advantageous, but not a requirement.

At ECCO, we know that great candidates may not meet every requirement listed. If this role excites you and you believe you can contribute, we would love to hear from you.

Join a team where curiosity, collaboration and growth go hand in hand

This is an opportunity to develop your analytical capabilities in a global company where insights help shape products, collections and strategic priorities. You will work with colleagues from different backgrounds and functions, gain exposure to key business processes and contribute to projects with visible impact across the organisation.

Ready to help shape the future with data-driven insights?

We review applications on an ongoing basis and the position is open until filled, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For questions about the role, feel free to reach out to Senior Manager, Consumer & Market Intelligence, Gabrina Tan, on gyt@ecco.com.

Please note that due to the summer holiday period, there might be a delay in response time, but rest assured that we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Are you curious, passionate and ready to make an impact? Then you’ll fit right in.

Title: BI Consultant
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Ambu is on an exciting digital transformation journey, investing heavily in its Enterprise Data Platform to strengthen data-driven decision-making across the business. As part of this journey, we are modernizing how data is managed, governed, and leveraged across our global organization.

We are looking for a BI Consultant to join our Data & Analytics team at our headquarters in Denmark. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing expertise with a passion for partnering with stakeholders to deliver meaningful business value through data and analytics.

The role

As a BI Consultant, you will work closely with business stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies to understand business challenges, define analytical requirements, and deliver reporting and analytics solutions that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

You will play a key role in ensuring the quality, consistency, and integrity of our enterprise data and reporting landscape while contributing to the continued development of our BI and analytics capabilities built on Microsoft Azure and Power BI.

This role requires a consultative mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include


Partnering with business stakeholders to understand requirements and identify opportunities to create value through data and analytics
Designing, developing, and maintaining reporting and analytics solutions using Power BI
Translating business requirements into scalable data models, dashboards, and analytical solutions
Contributing to the development and evolution of our Enterprise Data Platform and Data Warehouse
Ensuring the quality, consistency, and integrity of enterprise data and reporting solutions
Supporting data governance, data quality, and master data management initiative
Driving adoption of self-service analytics and promoting best practices across the organization
Collaborating closely with Data Engineers, Architects, and other members of the Data & Analytics team


Suggested candidate profile

Setting you up for success is one of our cornerstones. We imagine you have a relevant educational background within Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Technology, or a related field, combined with hands-on experience delivering Business Intelligence and analytics solutions in a modern data environment.

You are someone who enjoys solving business challenges through data and turning complex requirements into meaningful insights. You are equally comfortable discussing business objectives with stakeholders and diving into the technical details of data models, reporting solutions, and analytics.

As a person, you are proactive, curious, and collaborative. You take ownership, build strong relationships across the organization, and maintain high standards for quality, professionalism, and data integrity.

More Specifically, You Bring


Around 5 years of experience within Business Intelligence, Analytics, or Data Warehousing, preferably from an international business environment
Strong experience with Power BI, including semantic modelling, DAX, and dashboard development
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with enterprise data warehouses
Experience gathering and translating business requirements into technical solutions
Strong understanding of dimensional modelling and data warehousing principles
Experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies (Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, or Azure Data Lake) is considered an advantage
Understanding of Data Governance, Data Quality, and Master Data Management principles is beneficial
Familiarity with Agile ways of working is a plus


Please note that due to the upcoming summer holiday period, the recruitment process may take slightly longer than usual. We expect to begin the interview process in August.

Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Title: Business Analyst
Company: DBI The Danish Institute of Fire and Security Technology
Place: Hvidovre, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you skilled at analysing data and translating it into business-related insights for management? Do you enjoy working with Power BI, data models and business questions? Then you might be our new Business Analyst .

We offer a role where your analyses, reports and insights will help provide management and business areas with a stronger foundation for decision-making.

About The Position

Our new Business Analyst will be part of the Data and Analysis team, working with business data management and analysis. You will focus on preparing business-related analyses and reporting solutions for management and internal stakeholders, including customer engagement trends and broader business analysis

Your Tasks Would Be


Prepare business-related analyses that support management reporting and internal decision-making.
Work with SQL, Power BI models, Excel and other relevant data sources to support analyses and reporting.
Present findings, assumptions and limitations clearly within the team and in prepared reporting material.
Contribute to building, maintaining and improving Power BI reports and relevant BI files.
Help simplify dashboard logic, coding and design so reports are understandable, consistent and easy to use.
Compare data across systems when needed, for example Business Central, CRM, SQL sources and Power BI models.
Investigate differences between reports, systems and data sources when needed.
Support validation before reports, dashboards or analyses are shared more widely by checking whether figures are reliable.
Document report logic, data definitions, calculation assumptions and known data limitations.
Support a more structured and transparent reporting environment where analyses, reports and BI files can be maintained by others in the team.
Ad hoc analyses


Work collaboratively as a team to support each other in validating data, analyses and reporting tasks before they are published or shared more widely.

An exciting growth opportunity

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the further development of DBI’s Data and Analysis area. You will help reduce manual and ad hoc reporting, transform Excel-based processes into more structured reporting solutions, and improve the way data is documented, validated and used across the organisation.

You will be part of a small dynamic team with flexible working conditions

As part of our team, which consists of 2 business analysts and 2 students and the manager of the function, you will experience a collaborative and supportive environment. We value clear communication, curiosity, responsibility and mutual support.

We understand the importance of work-life balance and trust you to manage your own schedule, planning your working days in a way that aligns with both your professional responsibilities and personal needs. While enjoying this flexibility, maintaining team collaboration and meeting deadlines is crucial.

Being a team player is essential, as we rely on clear communication, knowledge sharing and support across tasks. You will work with complex data and different stakeholders, so it is important that you can ask relevant questions, handle uncertainty and follow up when clarification or validation is needed.

Your background

We imagine that you have the following background and competencies:


You hold a master’s degree in economics, data, business analytics, business intelligence or a similar relevant field.
You have at least two years of experience in data analysis, reporting, business intelligence or performance follow-up in a business context.
You have strong analytical skills and a natural ability to identify patterns, causes and inconsistencies in data.
You are curious and interested in understanding business needs and how analyses can support better decisions.
You take responsibility for the quality of your analyses and reports, and you communicate openly if something is wrong, unclear or at risk.
You are comfortable presenting and discussing your findings with management, stakeholders and your immediate leader.
You can explain data, assumptions and limitations clearly, also to people who are not data specialists.


Additionally, You Are


A fast and good learner, willing to embrace new technologies and adapt to new ways of working.
Experienced with Power BI and Excel.
Familiar with data models, measures and reporting logic.
Experienced with Power Query and DAX, or motivated to develop further in these areas.
Analytical, structured and focused on improving processes and reducing unnecessary manual work.
Good at documenting definitions, assumptions and calculation logic.


Experience with Business Central, CRM/Dataverse, SQL, Power BI Service, semantic models or cross-system data validation is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Professional English, both written and spoken, is required. Danish is an advantage, especially for stakeholder dialogue and understanding local business context, but it should not be a barrier if you have strong English communication skills and strong analytical capabilities.

DBI offers you

DBI’s most important asset is the knowledge and dedication of its employees, and we are willing to invest in that. DBI prioritises ongoing training and professional and personal development.

DBI is characterised by being a good and developing workplace where collaboration is flexible and informal. We have state-of-the-art offices and facilities, and you will enjoy good employee benefits, such as a pension scheme, dental insurance and health insurance.

We also have an active employee and art association, and our chefs prepare delicious meals for us daily.

The workplace

The workplace is DBI’s headquarters at Avedøre Holme in Hvidovre. The role is hybrid, with primary workplace at DBI’s headquarters.

Want to know more?

If you want to know more about the job, feel free to contact Head of Business Data Management and Analysis, Tina Shahsavar, at +45 21363303.

You apply for the position via the button on the right 'Apply for position'. We only receive applications through the recruitment system.

While enjoying this flexibility, maintaining team collaboration and meeting deadlines is crucial.

Being a team player is essential, as we rely on clear communication, knowledge sharing and support across tasks. You will work with complex data and different stakeholders, so it is important that you can ask relevant questions, handle uncertainty and follow up when clarification or validation is needed.

Your background

We imagine that you have the following background and competencies:

  • You hold a master’s degree in economics, data, business analytics, business intelligence or a similar relevant field.
  • You have at least two years of experience in data analysis, reporting, business intelligence or performance follow-up in a business context.
  • You have strong analytical skills and a natural ability to identify patterns, causes and inconsistencies in data.
  • You are curious and interested in understanding business needs and how analyses can support better decisions.
  • You take responsibility for the quality of your analyses and reports, and you communicate openly if something is wrong, unclear or at risk.
  • You are comfortable presenting and discussing your findings with management, stakeholders and your immediate leader.
  • You can explain data, assumptions and limitations clearly, also to people who are not data specialists.

Additionally, You Are

  • A fast and good learner, willing to embrace new technologies and adapt to new ways of working.
  • Experienced with Power BI and Excel.
  • Familiar with data models, measures and reporting logic.
  • Experienced with Power Query and DAX, or motivated to develop further in these areas.
  • Analytical, structured and focused on improving processes and reducing unnecessary manual work.
  • Good at documenting definitions, assumptions and calculation logic.

Experience with Business Central, CRM/Dataverse, SQL, Power BI Service, semantic models or cross-system data validation is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Professional English, both written and spoken, is required. Danish is an advantage, especially for stakeholder dialogue and understanding local business context, but it should not be a barrier if you have strong English communication skills and strong analytical capabilities.

DBI offers you

DBI’s most important asset is the knowledge and dedication of its employees, and we are willing to invest in that. DBI prioritises ongoing training and professional and personal development.

DBI is characterised by being a good and developing workplace where collaboration is flexible and informal. We have state-of-the-art offices and facilities, and you will enjoy good employee benefits, such as a pension scheme, dental insurance and health insurance.

We also have an active employee and art association, and our chefs prepare delicious meals for us daily.

The workplace

The workplace is DBI’s headquarters at Avedøre Holme in Hvidovre. The role is hybrid, with primary workplace at DBI’s headquarters.

Want to know more?

If you want to know more about the job, feel free to contact Head of Business Data Management and Analysis, Tina Shahsavar, at +45 21363303.

You apply for the position via the button on the right 'Apply for position'. We only receive applications through the recruitment system.

Title: Data Scientist/Engineer
Description:
Are you interested in developing innovative solutions that make Elopak’s data architecture better, faster, and more accessible every day? Do you want to develop predictive models that make our factories smarter? That is what data science at Elopak is all about! Interested? Keep reading!

How You Contribute In Your Role

You like to take the lead in developing, implementing, maintaining, supporting and rolling-out the manufacturing data architecture. You are the owner of the architecture and its technical components, like data warehouses, business intelligence applications, cloud components and digital twin applications.

With the data architecture as a basis, you work with great enthusiasm to develop innovations to support use cases in line with business requirements. Your analytic and predictive models will be used to further optimize the production process in order to improve quality, delivery and efficiency.

In order to continuously improve the capabilities in the area of data analytics and data science, you are an expert in collecting and analyzing business requirements and translating this into functional and technical requirements and effective solutions, as well as managing the change process around it.

You will be working closely together with the Production Competence Center, which is developing, maintaining and rolling-out Elopak’s Manufacturing Execution System, as well as with stakeholders in Production, Quality and IT departments.

What We Appreciate About You

In your role as a Data Scientist / Engineer you are forward leaning and analytical. You have a good dose of curiosity and you have the energy to learn a lot at a fast pace. You are ambitious and pro-active when it comes to working with large and complex data streams, and the technologies required for this. You are accurate, organized and able to work under pressure. Manufacturing operations is relying on your solution. You have a hands-on mentality and you enjoy to work within multi-disciplinary teams. You support and challenge your colleagues with data analysis and data science initiatives.

Job Requirements


A completed Bachelor / Master program in a quantitative discipline, preferably in IT technology / Data Science.
Excellent knowledge of data management, database technology, business intelligence and data science technologies.
Experience with Industry 4.0 / IIoT technology.
Ability to build relationships with internal stakeholders.
Good English skills, both written and verbal.
Ability to travel a few times a year to our other Elopak locations.


Our offer*

Our culture is informal and open, involving intensive collaboration with a lot of personal responsibility. There is room for your own ideas and critical feedback. You work with passionate colleagues who support and coach you where necessary. We understand that you perform at your best when you feel at home. That is why we inspire confidence, celebrate beautiful events together, and support you when things don’t go well.

You can also count on us for:


Salary range: €4,457 - €6,044 per month, depending on knowledge, skills, and experience.
Competitive salary based on experience;
25 days of vacation, with the option to buy/sell 5 additional days of vacation (based on 36 hours);
Pension scheme;
Flexible working hours and the option to work partly from home;
At Elopak, we offer a range of benefits to our employees. These include: Discounted sports membership, a healthy canteen, cycling plan, flexible working hours, laptop and phone, home workplace setup, group health insurance.
The above employment terms are based on Dutch employment conditions and may differ for positions based in Norway or Denmark.


Did you become curious?

Are you excited about the possibilities of data-driven working at Elopak? Don’t hesitate to apply or ask for more information! Send a message to Martin Leegwater Specialist Director Digitalization at martin.leegwater@elopak.com or call +31 115 682 235.

About Elopak

Elopak was founded in Norway in 1957 and is a leading, global supplier of sustainable packaging and filling equipment. We produce cartons for beverages such as milk and juice, as well non-food liquids for instance detergent and soap. The iconic Pure-Pak® carton is a natural choice and aims to leave the customer product unchanged and the world unharmed

The pack of 2,850 people around the world is guided by our vision; “Chosen by people, packaged by nature”. Reflecting the company promises of Empower, Unite and Accelerate, our people make sustainable packaging real with tangible impact on end-user consumption. Across borders, we are united in providing a natural and convenient alternative to plastic bottles.

Elopak was listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange (Oslo Børs) in 2021. We sell in excess of 14 billion cartons every year across more than 70 countries. Sustainability is at the core of everything we are and everything we do. Thus, we are a proud UN Global Compact participant and have been carbon neutral since 2016. For more information, go to www.elopak.com or follow us @Pure_Pak on Twitter and @Elopak on LinkedIn.

Title: BI Specialist - turn healthcare data into better care decisions
Description:
BI Specialist – turn healthcare data into better care decisions
Would you like to develop and deliver data-driven solutions for critical healthcare systems in Danish municipalities? As a BI Specialist, you'll work with the entire BI solution, from customer dialogue to implementation and support. Sounds exciting? Apply now!

The job
As a BI Specialist, you'll join the department responsible for the Cura BI solution. More than 30 municipalities use the solution to gain insights from elder care and social care data, budget and invoice home-care activities, and validate data sent to Statistics Denmark (DST). We're a small, close-knit team where you have real co-determination and influence over how our solutions develop.

As our new colleague in Columna Cura, you'll take on a broad role in the continued development of our SaaS-based BI solution, which is built on data from the Cura EHR system (an ERP-like system). You'll work with a complete Microsoft technology stack and engage with both backend and frontend. You can look forward to:


Taking co-responsibility for the continued development of the BI solution end to end, from requirements specification with customers to back- and frontend development, quality assurance, and implementation
Having dialogue with customers and colleagues about further development of solutions and requirements
Responding to customer enquiries and BI-related questions



You must be able to communicate in both Danish and English, spoken and written.

Joining the team
In our team, we work with only three releases a year. This gives you a predictable daily routine and the opportunity to delve deeply into our solutions. It's naturally busy at times, but the rhythm leaves room for both professional immersion and life outside of work. The team is part of Cura Projects & Service, where we ensure successful implementation projects and deliver services as needed. Read more about our Columna Cura portfolio here.

Your Qualifications
We're looking for a technical profile with experience from the BI world. You have a couple of years' experience in a similar position, and your educational background could be a master's degree in healthcare technology, Cand.Merc. (BI), IT Product Development, Information Science, or similar.

You have knowledge of the Microsoft technology stack, covering Microsoft SQL Server, T-SQL, and DAX. It's an advantage if you have worked with Targit before, but it's not a demand.

You're excited to take on a broad role covering both frontend and backend of our BI solutions, developing into a BI Swiss Army knife. With more than 10 years behind us, we've built a complex solution, so there's ample opportunity to dive into the technology and work with advanced BI challenges.

Healthcare domain knowledge is an advantage but not a requirement. However, a desire to work with healthcare data and build knowledge of the domain is essential to succeed in this role.

As a person, you are:


Thorough and detail-oriented - you don't leave things until they're properly worked through
Reliable and conscientious - people can count on things being done right, not just fast
Good at listening and building relationships, taking the time to understand what the customer actually needs before shaping the solution
Calm by nature and take things at your own pace, including when it comes to getting to grips with new and complex material
Motivated by making a real difference for others through good collaboration and a steady, persistent work effort



We don't expect you to master every part of this from day one. You'll be onboarded gradually, paired with experienced colleagues, and given time to grow into the full scope of the role. What matters most is your willingness to learn and your interest in the domain.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or EU country for the past seven years, as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus
At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks, from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables, and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. In addition, we offer several employee benefits, such as paid home internet, health insurance, and a company pension scheme.

Never stop developing
Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international, and proudly rooted in Denmark, with more than 1,100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there's room to be professional and personal. It's not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here
We'll be assessing applications on an ongoing basis, as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you're always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Rasmus Bach Andersen, Senior Project Manager.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
About the Company

Our client is a global, technology-driven systematic investment manager operating across all major liquid asset classes. With a strong culture of innovation and a scientific approach to investing, they combine cutting-edge data, research, and engineering to deliver consistent, high-quality returns.




The Role

We are looking for an exceptional Data Scientist to join a high-performing Commodities desk. Sitting at the intersection of Research, Trading, and Engineering, you will play a critical role in ensuring the firm leverages its data effectively to drive investment decisions.




What You'll Be Doing

Collaborating with the trading desk to design and implement robust data pipelines
Working alongside data engineers to onboard relevant datasets into the firm's infrastructure
Implementing data transformations to produce high-value datasets used directly in investment decisions
Writing clean, well-structured Python code to extract, clean, and aggregate data from a wide range of raw sources and formats
Managing the full end-to-end process of onboarding new datasets
Proactively identifying and solving data-related problems to minimise time to production
Experimenting with novel data extraction methods to continuously improve the firm's data toolkit




What We're Looking For

3+ years of experience as a Data Scientist or in a similar quantitative role; buy-side experience is a strong advantage
Postgraduate degree (MSc or PhD) in a quantitative discipline - Mathematics, Physics, Engineering or similar
Advanced Python skills, including strong proficiency with data handling libraries such as Pandas and NumPy
Experience working with both traditional and alternative financial datasets
A genuine interest in financial markets and data-driven analysis
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across Research, Trading, Engineering, and external vendors
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-performance environment




Why Apply?

This is a rare opportunity to join a world-class quantitative investment firm at the forefront of data-driven investing. The team offers a collaborative, intellectually rigorous environment where your work will have direct impact on the firm's investment performance.

Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med Power BI, datamodellering og visuel formidling – og vil du være med til at gøre data til et endnu stærkere beslutningsgrundlag i EIFO? I Danmarks Eksport- og Investeringsfond søger vi en nysgerrig og motiveret Data Analyst til en 12-måneders tidsbegrænset ansættelse, som vil være med til at udvikle rapportering, self service-løsninger og datadrevet beslutningsstøtte på tværs af organisationen.




I EIFO er vi i fuld gang med at løfte dataområdet, så indsigt bliver til konkrete resultater i forretningen. Vores Data-afdeling er relativt ny og i hastig udvikling, og vi indgår dagligt i fire tværfaglige teams på tværs af Data & Digitalisering. I dag er vi seks dygtige kolleger med erfaring inden for bl.a. datamodellering, produktkendskab, data engineering og rapportering – og vi fungerer som ejere af EIFO’s BI-løsning.




Vi deler viden, har et højt fagligt ambitionsniveau og en kultur præget af åbenhed, engagement og lysten til at bygge noget stærkt sammen.




Vi leder efter dig, der brænder for data, har blik for forretningens behov og kan omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til enkle og værdiskabende dataløsninger.




Din nye rolle og ansvarsområder

Som Data Analyst bliver du en vigtig del af arbejdet med at udbrede datadrevet beslutningsstøtte i EIFO. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med både Data-teamet og forretningen om rapportering, dashboards, semantiske modeller og self service-løsninger, der gør data lettere at anvende i hverdagen.




Du får mulighed for at arbejde med hele værdikæden fra forretningsbehov til færdig dataløsning.




I praksis betyder det, at du blandt andet skal:




1) Forstå og samarbejde – Arbejde tæt sammen med forretningen for at forstå behov, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og omsætte ønsker til konkrete dataløsninger. Bidrage til at definere KPI’er, begreber og succeskriterier, så løsningerne skaber reel værdi.




2) Modellere og udvikle – Udvikle og vedligeholde Power BI-rapporter, dashboards, målinger og semantiske modeller. Arbejde med DAX, datamodellering og dokumentation, så vores rapporteringsløsninger er robuste, forståelige og nemme at anvende.




3) Enable og formidle – Understøtte forretningen i at anvende data bedre gennem dialog, sparring, træning og løbende feedback. Hjælpe brugerne med at forstå datagrundlag, rapporter og mulighederne i self service, så data bliver en naturlig del af beslutninger og arbejdsgange.




Du vil få ansvar fra start, men også støtte fra erfarne kolleger i teamet. Rollen giver mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt og være med til at præge, hvordan vi arbejder med BI, self service og dataanvendelse i EIFO.




Hvem er du?

Vi ser for os en kollega, der har et godt analytisk fundament, interesse for forretningen og lyst til at udvikle sig sammen med os.




Vi forestiller os, at du kan se dig selv i følgende:

Har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for fx økonomi, IT, data, business analytics eller lignende.
Har 2–4 års erfaring som Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Business Analyst eller i en beslægtet rolle.
Har erfaring med Power BI og interesse for at bygge brugervenlige rapporter og dashboards.
Har kendskab til DAX, datamodellering og semantiske modeller.
Har forståelse for datakvalitet, dokumentation og fælles definitioner.
Er stærk til at formidle data og komplekse problemstillinger på en enkel og forståelig måde.
Har lyst til at undervise, facilitere workshops eller træne brugere i anvendelsen af rapporter, dashboards og self service-løsninger.
Kan arbejde tæt sammen med forretningen og skabe tryghed, ejerskab og adoption omkring nye dataløsninger.
Erfaring med Microsoft Fabric eller øvrige produkter i Fabric-suiten er en fordel, men ikke et krav.




Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra dag ét – vigtigst er, at du har drivkraft, læringslyst og et teknisk fundament, som vi kan bygge videre på sammen.




Et tydeligt formål og attraktive vilkår

I EIFO arbejder du for dansk erhvervslivs fremtid – og du får mulighed for at skabe reel værdi for virksomheder, der driver vækst, grøn omstilling og innovation.




Du får:

Et spændende og udfordrende job med et klart purpose og stor samfundsmæssig betydning
En arbejdsplads præget af forretningsfokus, enkelhed og tillid i en uhøjtidelig kontekst
Attraktive vilkår, fleksibilitet og plads til både ambition og balance i arbejdslivet
Engagerede og fagligt stærke kolleger i en mangfoldig og inkluderende kultur, hvor forskellighed ses som en styrke.




Er du klar til at tage næste skridt i din karriere?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV via ansøgningssystemet senest den 10. august 2026.




Som led i vores arbejde med inkluderende rekruttering beder vi dig venligst om ikke at inkludere billede, alder og civilstand i dit ansøgningsmateriale.




Vi behandler ansøgninger efter ansøgningsfristens udløb og forventer at gennemføre samtaler i forlængelse heraf.




Stillingen er en 12-måneders tidsbegrænset ansættelse med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.




Rekrutteringsforløbet består af to samtalerunder. I forbindelse med anden samtalerunde gennemføres personligheds- og logiske tests samt en mindre caseopgave. Referencer indhentes efter aftale i den afsluttende del af processen, og straffeattest skal fremvises ved ansættelse.




Vil du høre mere? Kontakt Product Owner, Rasmus Pallesen, på rasp@eifo.dk. Vi ønsker henvendelser pr. mail. Grundet sommerperioden kan der være længere svartid end normalt, og spørgsmål forventes besvaret i uge 32. Vi sætter pris på din forståelse og tålmodighed.




Hos EIFO tror vi på, at diversitet skaber bedre løsninger – derfor opfordrer vi alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge uanset alder, køn, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold.




Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!




Om Danmarks Eksport- og Investeringsfond (EIFO)

Danmarks Eksport- og Investeringsfond (EIFO) er danske virksomheders fælles indgang til risikovillig statslig finansiering. Vi har et samlet forretningsomfang på omkring 150 mia. kr. og har knap 500 medarbejdere. Med professionalisme og internationalt udsyn arbejder vi hver dag for at understøtte de erhvervssucceser, der kan gøre Danmark rigere på det, der gør en forskel. EIFO er Danmarks nationale erhvervsfremmende bank, investeringsfond og Danmarks officielle eksportkreditinstitut i én og samme finansielle institution.

Title: Business Analytics Consultant
Description:
Twoday er den førende digitale transformationspartner i Nordeuropa med en global tilstedeværelse. Med cirka 3.000 teknologer samarbejder vi med de mest beundrede private og offentlige organisationer for at levere banebrydende digitale løsninger. Vores dybe brancheekspertise omfatter Data & AI, softwareudvikling, digitale oplevelser og forretningsapplikationer. Vores team, der opererer i hele Norden og Litauen, genererede en omsætning på 280 millioner euro i 2023. Vi betjener over 8.000 kunder og understøtter deres digitale transformationsrejser.

Vil du være med på Danmarks stærkeste team af Business Analytics-konsulenter? Vil du arbejde med nogle af Danmark største virksomheder? Tænder du på at gøre komplekse problemstillinger til simple løsninger for kunderne? Så er twoday Data & AI det rigtige sted for dig! Vi søger nye Business Analytics-konsulenter til et af vores kontorer i Danmark.

Om stillingen

Som Business Analytics-konsulent vil du indgå i et stærkt team med en varierende hverdag – du vil få ansvar, frihed og faglig udvikling. Vores konsulenter besidder hver især stærke kompetencer, og du vil opleve kolleger, der er specialister på deres område.

Du vil sammen med vores kunder afklare de forretningsmæssige behov og derefter designe, udvikle og implementere løsningen. Alt efter kompleksitet og størrelse af løsningen arbejder du enten i et team eller som primær konsulent på løsningerne.

Vi holder faste firmadage, hvor sparring, idéudveksling og kollegialt sammenhold er i højsædet. Du vil opleve at blive udfordret, men du vil også få mulighed for at udfordre dine kolleger.

Fristet, men stadig i tvivl?


Turbo på det faglige! Hos twoday Data & AI er vores medarbejdere kendt for at have et skyhøjt fagligt niveau. Samtidig med at vi har det godt socialt.
Lækre kontorer! twoday Data & AI har lækre og moderne kontorer centralt placeret i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.
Tid til fordybelse! Vi har fire årlige fagdage, hvor idéudvikling, udvikling og sparring er i højsædet.
Uddannelse! Hos twoday Data & AI får du mulighed for efteruddannelse og certificeringer.
Attraktiv lønpakke! Vi tilbyder en attraktiv lønpakke med branchens bedste bonusordning.
Fantastisk kaffe! Hos twoday Data & AI har du adgang til fitness, frugt og fantastisk god kaffe.


Om dig

Du har flere års relevant erhvervserfaring og brænder for hele tiden at blive bedre. Du har en baggrund som BI- eller datakonsulent, controller i en større virksomhed eller noget lign. Du har erfaring med Azure Data Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks og/eller SQL Server. Endvidere har du kendskab til én eller flere front-end værktøjer såsom Power BI, Excel eller lign.

Du ved, at livet som konsulent er udfordrende og til tider meget krævende. Vores vigtigste aktiv er vores kunder og medarbejdere, og du er klar til at give, hvad der skal til, for at skabe et godt forhold både internt og eksternt samt at udvikle Business Intelligence-løsninger i verdensklasse.

Din uddannelse kan være cand.merc., cand.merc.dat eller cand.oecon – eller for den sags skyld noget helt fjerde. Det vigtigste er, at du brænder for Business Analytics og ønsker at gøre en forskel.

Dine kommunikative evner er i top, og du skriver og taler flydende dansk og engelsk.

Vi begejstrer med data – måske vil du være med?

Så send din ansøgning i dag, de vil løbende blive læst.

Der vil løbende blive indkaldt til indledende samtaler. Du ansøger ved at klikke på knappen nedenfor. Alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er Ann Brahe-Orlandi, Talent Acquisition Manager, klar til at hjælpe. Hun glæder sig til at høre fra dig på ann.brahe-orlandi@twoday.com.

Hvad kan vi tilbyde?

Twoday er placeret i moderne lokaler på 30 steder i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Finland og Litauen. Vi har et stærkt og unikt socialt miljø med højt engagerede medarbejdere. Hvis du er den kandidat, vi leder efter, vil du få en central rolle med spændende muligheder for at udvikle dig i en international og innovativ gruppe, med spændende produkter og tjenester inden for teknologi og software. Du vil også have fleksibiliteten til at "jumpe" og arbejde fra et af vores hovedkontorer i Oslo, Stockholm, København, Helsinki eller Vilnius til tider.

Title: Data Scientists for Big Data, IoT and AI projects
Description:
Stillingsbeskrivelse

Do you like working creatively with data analytics, big data, AI, visualisation, NoSQL and databases? Would you like to join an international organisation where we already work with data analytics and machine learning projects? Join BEUMER Group and exploit the chance to innovate, develop and test concepts for products and tools and most importantly, develop your own skill.

You will team up with colleagues, so you can share and grow your knowledge within the data science field. It also means focusing on using data from an already existing infrastructure where we collect data from more than 350 sites worldwide.

Join our Customer Diagnostics Center

You become part of our Data Analytics department, which is part of our Customer Diagnostics Center (CDC). In the CDC, which is part of our Customer Support division, we are tasked with making sure our installed base of systems around the globe are healthy and running smoothly.

Here, you join a well-established but agile team of highly sought for data scientists. You have the freedom to develop solutions across the organisation focusing on creativity and innovation on the conceptual stages of possible new products, services and tools.

In the CDC, you will find a multitude of skills and competences, and we enjoy an informal atmosphere where we combine our strengths to create brand new solutions for colleagues and customers. Moreover, you become part of a data analytics forum where we work closely with universities to expand our knowledge.

Create value through data across the organisation

Through a continuous dialogue with our business and product development, you will be responsible for defining new products, services and tools based on data and machine learning. We are a large organisation with several specialist fields, which means that we can enjoy the value of data analysis across disciplines.

Your Tasks Will Include


Initiating mining of existing data from material handling systems running in production, looking for possible bottlenecks, optimizations etc.
Processing, cleansing, and verifying the integrity of data used for analysis.
Participating in the maintenance of the existing data pipeline.
Participate in defining and evaluating new techniques for data collection and analysis.
Drive the rollout and extension of our data collection to all sites in the BEUMER Group.


We have a strong preference for open-source software and are working with platforms and tools such as Kubernetes, ArgoCD, MLFlow, vLLM, Elastic stack, Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, Numaflow, Python/Java/Golang, Jupyter notebooks and Opentelemetry. You will test and implement prototypes, e.g. for customer solutions or for your colleagues to provide them with the right tools to perfect their work. As such, you bridge the worlds of product development, subject specialists and technology to innovate the business.

Experience with data driven decision making, big data and concept development?

Role

Most important to this role is that you have a good all-round technical foundation, allowing you to implement software, configure tools, understand our domain and be a sounding board in the creative process. To do so, we also imagine that you:


Hold a master's degree or PhD as a computer scientist, engineer, physicist or similar.
Have a great understanding of and hands-on experience with using data analytics for system and concept development.
