Title: Revenue Operations Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Revenue Operations Analyst

United Fintech is building a global platform that connects financial institutions with modern, scalable technology solutions. Through acquisitions and partnerships, we bring together market-leading fintech products that serve banks, exchange groups, brokerages, and investment firms worldwide.
 
If you enjoy working with data and have a keen interest in commercial operations within a fast-paced fintech environment, then you might be what we are looking for to join our team in Copenhagen.
 
What You Will Contribute
 
We are looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team at United Fintech. 
 
United Fintech is scaling fast, and our commercial data needs to scale with it. We are looking for someone who does not just report what happened but helps the business understand why and what to do next.
 
You will be responsible for defining the analytical roadmap for our commercial departments, ensuring that data is not just reported but used as a competitive advantage to drive growth and efficiency. This means working across our commercial data infrastructure, spanning CRM, BI tooling, and the integrations that connect them, with a clear view of how systems speak to each other and how data flows across the customer journey. You will also be expected to continuously improve how the team operates, using AI tools and automation to make analytical workflows faster and more scalable.
 
This is a hands-on, highly operational role with real ownership and significant growth potential for someone looking to build expertise in revenue analytics, systems integration, and commercial data architecture within a fast-growing fintech environment.
 
Key responsibilities include:

Analytics and Insight - Translate commercial data into clear, decision-ready insight for leadership and commercial teams. Cover pipeline, churn, revenue trends, and ad hoc requests as they come.
Analytical Roadmap - Define the analytics agenda for our commercial departments. Identify where data is missing or misread and work proactively to close those gaps.
Systems and Data Integration - Own the data flow between CRM, BI tools, and the rest of the commercial stack. Fix problems at the source, not around them. This is the layer the team has been missing.
Workflow Optimisation – Spot manual and repetitive processes across the commercial data stack and build better alternatives. Use AI tools actively to automate analytical work, improve reporting turnaround, and free up capacity for higher-value tasks.
Data Architecture and Visualisation - Design and maintain the reporting structures that support commercial decision-making. Build scalable dashboards and contribute to our Tableau Next implementation.
Data Quality and Forecasting - Monitor CRM and other commercial data quality, identify issues, and support forecasting with structured analysis and materials for leadership review cycles.
Collaboration - Work with the RevOps team and commercial stakeholders to ensure data and insight serve real decisions. Contribute beyond your primary focus area as part of a small, high-ownership team.
 
 You will bring: 

2 to 4 years of experience in RevOps, Sales Ops, analytics, BI, or a technically oriented commercial role. A technical academic background is equally welcome.
Strong commercial understanding. Pipeline coverage, conversion rates, churn, ARR, and NRR are part of how you think.
Hands-on experience with BI tooling such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Proven experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot to optimise workflows and accelerate output, including data analysis, documentation, and process automation. Familiarity with workflow automation tools is a plus.
CRM experience is a requirement. You are comfortable working with CRM objects, fields, and data structures on the reporting and data side. Salesforce specifically is a strong bonus.
A systems thinker who understands how data moves between platforms and how to fix it upstream.
Structured, independent, and direct. You own your work and communicate findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
 
Location & Working Arrangements
This role is based in Copenhagen. The position is full-time and will be reporting to the Senior Revenue Operations Manager. 
You will join a three-person RevOps team and play a key role in building the analytics capability that supports commercial decision-making across United Fintech.
 
What We offer 

Key Role in Growth – Be instrumental in preparing us for the next stage of growth as we expand and integrate new businesses.
Collaborative Environment – Work alongside entrepreneurial minds and experts in the fintech sector, where teamwork and innovation are valued.
Opportunities for Development – Access personal and professional growth opportunities within a fast-paced, dynamic organisation.
Work-Life Balance – Flexibility to balance professional achievements with personal ambitions while contributing to a supportive and inclusive culture.
Engaging Culture – Participate in team-building activities, global events, and opportunities to connect with colleagues.
Lunch at our office in central Copenhagen K
 
Application Process
Please submit your CV by 20 of July. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so early submissions are encouraged. The first round of interviews is expected to take place end of July.
 
We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply and are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and supportive working environment. 
 
About United Fintech
Founded in 2020 and backed by the industry, United Fintech is a Digital Transformation Platform where global Financial Institutions and cutting-edge technology providers come together to unleash their full potential and enable the future of finance. United Fintech remains on the frontier of innovation by acquiring engineering-led fintechs within Capital Markets, Wholesale Banking, and Wealth Management under a central umbrella. In just over four years, the company has acquired six fintechs. United Fintech has received strategic investments from Barclays, BNP Paribas, Citi, Danske Bank and Standard Chartered and Danish Growth Capital.

Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

Excited to make a real impact while diving into the finance world? Are you passionate about turning data into actionable insights? As a BI Business Analyst, you will play a key role in empowering colleagues with business intelligence and driving data-driven decision-making across the organization.

This is more than just a job - it is an opportunity to develop valuable skills within BI and finance, collaborate across teams, and contribute to impactful projects within life sciences, renewable energy, and fundamental research.

We are involved in projects that will transform the way we live. With more than fifteen years of expertise and innovation, NKT Photonics a Hamamatsu Company strives to remain the market leader in everything we do.

Act as the go-to person for BI support of new insights and issue resolution
Transform raw data into meaningful insights using Power BI and Snowflake
Gather and prioritize requirements from finance and stakeholders
Develop and maintain dashboards with intuitive visualizations
Improve and modernize Power BI solutions
Automate manual finance processes
Ensure data models support business needs
Collaborate closely with IT and business teams
Manage tickets and resolve data issues
Stay up to date with Power BI and data storytelling best practices

Strong experience with Power BI and Snowflake

Experience with D365 is an advantage
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Strong communication skills in English

Group BI & Analytics

Are you curious about how data can create real business value? Do you enjoy working with people, understanding business challenges, and turning insights into solutions?

At BORG Automotive, we are looking for a BI Consultant to join our Group BI & Analytics team. Whether you are early in your career or already have some experience within BI, analytics, or reporting, this role offers the opportunity to building broad expertise within BI & Analytics and developing deeper technical and non-technical competencies.

The Role

As a BI Consultant, you will work with BI and analytics solutions, from understanding business needs and gathering requirements to supporting development, testing, and implementation. You will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and the BI & Analytics team, helping translate opportunities into scalable solutions that support better decision-making across BORG Automotive.

This combination of requirement gathering, solution development, analytics, and domain specialization gives you the opportunity to specialize within specific domains such as supply chain, production, commercial, or finance, while deepening both your technical and non-technical competencies within BI & Analytics.

Key Responsibilities


Clarify business requirements and translate them into valuable BI and analytics solution designs in collaboration with technical specialists.
Support development, testing, and rollout of dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions.
Train and support key users, ensuring relevant knowledge, guidance, and documentation are available to end users.
Take part in the team’s support responsibility through weekly rotating shifts, helping ensure stable and reliable BI services.
Promote data-driven decision-making by identifying opportunities where BI and analytics can improve processes, transparency, and business performance.
Contribute to governance, standardization, and continuous improvement of BI solutions.


Who You Are

Title: Lead Product Data Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Tech-first. Ego-free. User-obsessed. Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes. We automate tax tracking, surface deductions people didn't know they had, and give users the insights they need to make better financial decisions — all directly connected to the Danish tax authority. We're an independent company of around 50 people based in Copenhagen, with a 4.7-star rating and a simple mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.







The role




We need someone who owns product analytics — not just executes it. You'll set the direction for how Skatteguiden uses data to understand its users and make product decisions, and you'll be the person who raises the bar for what good analytics looks like here.




You'll work closely with product managers across our product teams and have real influence on what gets built and why. This isn't a support function. It's a lead role with ownership.







What you'll be working on




Own the product analytics function — define the strategy, set the standards, and drive adoption across product teams
Define and maintain core product metrics and KPIs across the organisation
Design and run experiments — from hypothesis to conclusion
Analyse user behaviour and funnels to identify growth opportunities and friction points
Build scalable dashboards and reporting in close collaboration with the data team
Translate findings into concrete recommendations for product leadership and senior stakeholders







What you bring




Strong SQL skills and experience with complex data modelling
Experience with Snowflake, dbt, Lightdash, Evidence or comparable tooling.
Solid product analytics experience — you've worked closely with product teams and understand what drives a digital product
Strong experimentation design and statistical analysis skills
A track record of owning a product analytics function, not just contributing to one
Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Self-directed and structured — you can take an ambiguous question and turn it into a sharp analysis







Nice to have




Experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse
Experience with Lightdash, Tableau, or comparable BI tools
Python for data processing and analysis







What we offer







Ownership of the product analytics function at one of Denmark's fastest-growing fintech companies
Direct influence on product direction and a seat at the table where decisions are made
A strong data team with high professional standards and a modern tech stack
The opportunity to build something — not inherit a finished function
Office first in Copenhagen — five minutes from Rådhuspladsen, lunch at Claus Meyer, dinner covered if the day runs long







Practical




Start: As soon as possible

Reports to: Head of Data & Operations Planning

Salary: Competitive and based on experience







Our Lean Recruitment Process




Screening call with Christian Payne, 30 min (online)
45-minute onsite meeting with hiring manager and product manager
1-hour onsite case session with hiring manager and team member, followed by a short conversation with Nikolai (CEO), 30 min

Title: Systems Developer, Business Intelligence, Lystrup
Description:
Would you like to play a key role in turning data into decisions that matter — building the dashboards and visual reporting layers that drive performance across a global defense and aerospace company? We are looking for a skilled and business-oriented BI developer to drive front-end BI delivery, serving stakeholders across the full value chain. In this hands-on position your output directly shapes how leaders and teams across Terma understand and act on business performance.




We are facing an exciting future with considerable growth and demanding changes, as we deliver advanced technologies and mission critical solutions for the defense and aerospace industry. Our systems provide security for people on land, at sea and in the air. Therefore, we are looking for a System Developer within Business Intelligence to become part of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology.




Your role in our team




As our new Systems Developer, you will design, build, and maintain Power BI solutions that translate complex business, operational, and financial data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders across our functions and business areas.




You will be the bridge between the business and the data, collaborating closely with stakeholders across the value chain – including sales, business development, project delivery, R&D, executive leadership and finance to evolve KPI frameworks, performance metrics, and business narratives into visual formats. Understanding what decisions need to be made and ensuring the right information is available at the right time. Your solutions will include everything from project performance reviews and pipeline reporting to financial performance management and executive dashboards.




You will join Financial Systems & BI, part of our Performance & Financial Insights function — a team dedicated to bringing structure, insight, and analytical depth to performance management across Terma. You and the BI team will collaborate closely with our IT data infrastructure team on the underlying data models and structures, ensuring the data feeding your reports is fit for purpose.




How you will make a meaningful contribution




Your key responsibilities include:




Designing and developing Power BI dashboards and reports that meet the analytical and reporting needs of stakeholders across sales, supply chain, R&D, and finance
Translating business requirements into robust, well-structured BI solutions — working with stakeholders across the value chain from initial scoping and design through to deployment and user adoption
Developing DAX measures and calculation logic in close collaboration with IT, turning underlying data into clear, business-ready insight in Power BI
Maintaining and continuously improving our front-end BI reporting — covering report quality, consistency, visual standards, and performance optimization
Acting as the go-to BI expert within Financial Systems & BI — advising stakeholders on what is possible, guiding self-service capabilities, and enabling broader data literacy across the organisation
Contributing to BI standards and best practices within Financial Systems & BI, ensuring consistency and scalability across all reporting output




Bring your world class expertise into play




You are fluent in English both in writing and verbal at a professional level. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement. Moreover, we are also looking for a new colleague with the following qualifications:




A degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Business Intelligence, or a similar field of study
Preferably between 3–6 years of hands-on experience developing Power BI solutions in a professional, business-facing context
Strong proficiency in DAX and SQL, with a structured approach to building robust measures and calculation logic in collaboration with the teams who maintain the underlying data models
Experience working as an internal BI resource serving multiple functions or business areas, with the ability to balance competing priorities and manage stakeholder expectations
Familiarity with data infrastructure concepts (data warehouses, semantic models, pipelines, star schema) and comfortable working closely with IT on data structure and sourcing
A structured, quality-conscious approach to development — you document your work, build for maintainability, and care about the end-user experience




As a person, you are curious, positive, precise, and genuinely interested in what the data is trying to say. You are comfortable moving between the technical and the human side of BI work — equally at home refining a DAX expression and discussing with a business partner what they actually need to see on a page. You take ownership of your deliverables and follow through from design to adoption. Being part of a fast-paced environment, you are able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and find the right balance between quality while at the same time delivering effective results and meeting deadlines as well as targets.




We are an international company representing world-class expertise, delivering complex and high-tech products. We value our colleagues and our meaningful contributions to securing people through advanced technology. You will also experience that we have a strong focus on your development, teaching you useful new competences and further strengthening current ones, both professionally and personally. Our company culture is autonomous and engaging, and we acknowledge the importance of flexibility in a great working environment.

When joining Terma, we promise that you will experience: Great people, challenging tasks, world-class expertise, and meaningful contribution in your daily work.

At Terma, we prioritize the well-being of our employees, ensuring they are well taken care of. Joining our team comes with a multitude of perks designed to enhance your social life, cultural experiences, and health.

International Environment: Explore great teamwork and professional sparring with colleagues around the world

Flexible Working Hours: Enjoy the opportunity to work flexibly and the option to work from home up to two days per week. Internet connection at home is paid for by Terma

Comprehensive Benefits Package: Receive a 10% paid pension along with a beneficial health care and insurance package. Enjoy discounts from various business partners

Social and Professional Events: We have an active staff association that arranges a variety of social activities and events to bring all of our colleagues together

This is a unique opportunity to shape Spirii's data infrastructure from an early stage — establishing standards for ingestion, orchestration, and data reliability as we scale.

Your Responsibilities

Pipeline & Ingestion


Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines that bring data from product backends, third-party services, and operational systems into Amazon Redshift.
Own ingestion reliability: monitoring, alerting, and incident response for pipeline failures.
Evaluate and improve orchestration tooling and scheduling.


Data Platform & Infrastructure


Evolve Spirii's data platform architecture: storage, compute, access control, and cost optimisation in Redshift.
Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code practices for data workflows (Terraform/CDK or similar).
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure and transformations.


Data Quality & Governance


Implement data quality checks, freshness monitoring, and anomaly detection across ingestion and transformation layers.
Work with Analytics Engineers and domain teams to define and enforce data contracts and schema standards.
Ensure GDPR-compliant data handling: PII identification, access control, and data retention policies.


Collaboration & Stakeholders


Partner with Engineering and Product teams to instrument events correctly at the source — schemas, identifiers, and change management.
Collaborate with Data team to ensure the analytics layer is built on reliable, well-modelled foundations.
Contribute to a strong data culture by creating and enhancing documentation, runbooks, data lineage, discoverability and incident response capabilities.


About You


You care deeply about data reliability and building pipelines that teams can depend on.
You're hands-on: you build, test, and ship pipelines and infrastructure improvements yourself.
You think of data pipelines as products — you care about uptime, observability, and the downstream consumers who depend on them.
You're pragmatic: you know when to engineer robustly and when to keep things lean.
You collaborate well across teams and communicate clearly about trade-offs and status.


Qualifications


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related role with a strong data focus.
Strong SQL skills and solid experience building production data pipelines.
Hands-on experience with a modern data warehouse (Redshift preferred; BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks also relevant).
Experience with orchestration tools (Apache Airflow or similar).
Proficiency in Python for data work (pipeline scripts, transformations, tooling).
Solid understanding of ELT/ETL concepts, including incremental loading, CDC, and idempotency.
Familiar with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or similar).
Familiar with data governance concepts: access control, PII handling, GDPR-minded practices.


Nice to Have


Experience with data observability tooling.
Experience with event/data contract patterns in product analytics (schemas, versioning, instrumentation).
Experience with finance data and/or subscription/transaction domains.
Experience with dbt (understanding of transformation layer and how it interfaces with pipelines).
Machine learning infrastructure experience is a plus, but not required for this role.


Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.


Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Title: Quantitative Developer - Python
Description:
Qube Research & Technologies (QRT) is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager, operating in all liquid asset classes across the world. We are a technology and data driven group implementing a scientific approach to investing. Combining data, research, technology, and trading expertise has shaped our collaborative mindset, which enables us to solve the most complex challenges. QRT’s culture of innovation continuously drives our ambition to deliver high quality returns for our investors.




You will join a quantitative development function that works closely with Researchers, Traders and Cloud Engineering teams to build applications, data pipelines and analytics that support research and trading workflows. The role combines software engineering, quantitative development and data engineering, with responsibility for developing production applications, supporting research infrastructure and integrating large scale datasets.




Your future role within QRT

Design, develop, deploy and maintain cloud native Python applications supporting research and trading workflows, including market data dashboards, risk analytics, profit and loss reporting, weather analytics and performance analysis
Develop quantitative tools including backtesting frameworks, optimisation tools, pricing libraries and ETL pipelines for integrating and validating alternative datasets
Build and maintain scalable data pipelines that support model development and production workflows
Monitor, support, debug and enhance existing research and trading infrastructure
Work closely with Researchers, Traders and Engineering teams to deliver production quality solutions that meet evolving business requirements




Your present skillset

At least three years of professional Python development experience
Strong knowledge of Python, including numerical libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Polars and Xarray
Strong quantitative mindset with an interest in working closely with trading and research functions
Experience developing user interfaces or an interest in building data visualisation applications such as Plotly, Dash or Streamlit is beneficial
Experience with AWS or another cloud platform together with infrastructure as code technologies (e.g. Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, RDS or AWS CDK is advantageous)
Good knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL together with object storage technologies
Experience developing ETL pipelines and working with large scale datasets
Strong understanding of software engineering practices including version control, automated testing, packaging and deployment
Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver production solutions
Experience with parallel or distributed computing is advantageous




QRT is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity as essential to our success. QRT empowers employees to work openly and respectfully to achieve collective success. In addition to professional achievement, we are offering initiatives and programs to enable employees achieve a healthy work-life balance.

Title: Marketing Automation & Data Specialist
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du arbejde med data, analyse og marketing automation i praksis? Hos Velliv får du mulighed for både at analysere store datamængder, udvikle nye datagrundlag og omsætte indsigter til automatiseret kommunikation for mere end 400.000 kunder.

Vi har bedt din kommende leder om at sætte ord på jobbet og opgaverneVi søger to nyuddannede Marketing Automation & Data Specialister, der vil være med til at udvikle vores datadrevne kundekommunikation. Du bliver en del af et dygtigt fagligt miljø i Marketing & Brand, hvor vi samarbejder tæt med forretningen, Data Warehouse og IT for at skabe relevante og værdiskabende kundeoplevelser.

I rollen får du ansvaret for at analysere store mængder data og omsætte indsigter til automatiserede kampagner og flows, der skaber mere relevant kommunikation til vores kunder. Du kommer ikke kun til at arbejde med eksisterende data. Du vil også være med til at udvikle og specificere nye datasæt, segmenteringer og dataprodukter på vores Snowflake-platform i samarbejde med Data Warehouse og IT.

Samtidig bliver du en nøglespiller i implementeringen af Adobe Campaign v8 og får dermed en mulighed for at arbejde med en moderne cloud-baseret marketingteknologi – og være med til at bygge setuppet rigtigt fra starten.

Dine primære opgaver bliver:


Analysere store datamængder og omsætte kundeindsigter til segmentering, målgrupper og relevante kundeoplevelser
Udvikle og vedligeholde datagrundlag til marketing- og kommunikationsaktiviteter
Udvikle og optimere automatiserede kampagner og flows
Rapportering og opfølgning på kampagner og aktiviteter
Bidrage til at sikre et solidt datagrundlag, herunder datakvalitet og struktur på tværs af systemer


Du har forudsætningerne og modet til mereDer er styrke i forskellighed. Vi bliver bedre af at bringe forskellige erfaringer, fagligheder og personligheder sammen. Derfor opfordrer vi til, at alle uanset baggrund sender en ansøgning. Vi vurderer dog, at der er nogle grundlæggende forudsætninger, som er vigtige for at lykkes i jobbet:


Er nyuddannet eller har op til 1-2 års erfaring
Har en relevant kandidatuddannelse inden for fx økonomi, data science, matematik, eller statistik
Er nysgerrig på databaser, datamodeller og moderne dataplatforme
Har interesse for data og programmering – gerne erfaring med SQL samt fx DAX eller Python
Trives med at arbejde analytisk og omsætte data til konkrete løsninger
Er nysgerrig og struktureret og har lyst til at lære


Sådan oplever en af dine nye kolleger afdelingen"Her får du hurtigt lov til at tage ansvar og gøre en forskel. Vi hjælper hinanden, sparrer på tværs og deler gerne vores viden, så alle bliver dygtigere. Vi er et hold med forskellige faglige profiler, og det giver både gode løsninger og en hverdag med god energi, højt humør og masser af samarbejde." // Alan Sonne Rasmussen, ansvarlig for Marketing Automation

Plads til at være menneske – plads til at være digVelliv er flere år i træk blevet kåret til at have branchens bedste medarbejderimage og har gennem flere år vundet prisen som Årets Pensionsselskab. Hos os bliver du mødt med åbne arme, og vi gør os umage for, at du kommer godt fra start og hurtigt falder til.

Du får en buddy, der hjælper dig i gang, og en leder, der bidrager med mening, udvikling og retning. Du har mulighed for at melde dig ind i ”Klub Velliv” og deltage i aktiviteter inden for sport, mad, hobby og kultur for medarbejdere og deres børn. I det hele taget kan du forvente en kultur, hvor vi lever vores tre kerneværdier: Optimisme, Ordentlighed og Omsorg.

I Velliv skal der være plads til at være menneske – plads til at være dig.

Vi holder samtaler løbendeSend dit CV og et par ord om dig selv og din baggrund i en kort ansøgning. Vi vil gerne høre fra dig senest den 15. august 2026, men vi holder samtaler løbende fra 3. august 2026, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte Emil Madsen eller Alan Sonne Rasmussen via e-mail: emil.madsen@velliv.dk eller alan.sonne.rasmussen@velliv.dk.

På grund af sommerferie, kan der forventes forlænget responstid ved henvendelser omkring dette job.

Title: Data Engineer
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Are you a Data Engineer with 2-7 years of experience ready to take the next step? And would you like to work directly with clients while keeping up to date with the newest technologies? Then read on & apply to become part of a dynamic young team of 60 data experts who help companies gain new insights using a wide palette of modern tools.


Contract: Full-time, permanent
Location: Central Copenhagen, near Vesterport Station



Work Assignments

The role requires you to be both a hands-on builder and a point of contact for our clients' data challenges. Specifically, you will:


Build robust data pipelines and models that streamline the ingestion, transformation, and delivery of data.
Implement and develop modern data platforms through DevOps & CI/CD practices.
Collaborate with our clients’ engineers, analysts, & business users to solve business issues and ensure lasting value.



You will learn from our many data engineers with 7-20 years of experience, while taking on a mentoring role for our less experienced consultants.

What You Bring To The Team

Ideally, you have:


2-7 years of experience working as a data engineer.
Proficiency in Python, SQL, APIs, and/or software development.
An analytical approach to problem-solving, with a strong interest in how to drive business improvement using data.
Clear communication skills and the curiosity to engage with clients on projects.
Experience with some of these technologies: Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, dbt, Azure, AWS, or GCP.
A relevant degree.
A current base near Copenhagen and fluency in Danish and/or English.



If you're excited about this role but you don’t tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Why Devoteam Data Driven?

You will join a fantastic team of talented, curious data experts in a collaborative and dynamic workplace. Beyond working with nice colleagues on impactful projects, we offer comprehensive benefits to support your growth:


Continuous Growth & Community: We invest in your talent and dedicate time for learning to ensure you have up-to-date certifications in our technologies.
Work-Life Balance: We prioritize your personal time. In addition to your six weeks of paid vacation, we offer the flexibility of taking unlimited unpaid time off.
Social Events: We offer a variety of social events throughout the year. Recently we have done Laser tag, Pottery, Disc Golf, Book Club, Curling, Board Game Night, Foosball Tournament, Ice Hockey, among many other things.



Our Impact

Below are a few examples of our work:


Migrated Novo Nordisk's global supply chain analytics solution from Alteryx-based workflows to a governed, cloud-native architecture using dbt, Snowflake, and Azure DevOps to support enterprise-scale analytics and collaboration.
Developed a comprehensive end-to-end data warehouse solution, featuring automated pipelines that structured dimensional data from diverse operational systems for unified analytics for a client.
Assessed the current data landscape in Novonesis and implemented a new self-service framework to enable business users to utilise the power of the modern data stack.



Application Process

Apply by uploading your CV no later than August 9th.

We expect to invite selected candidates for interviews between mid-August and mid-September 2026. Note that our recruitment team is off 18/7-9/8.

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

About Devoteam

Devoteam is a leading digital consultancy with a strong international presence, represented in 25 countries (primarily in Europe) with over 11,000 employees globally. In Denmark, our team comprises around 350 people and is spread across three business units - Data Driven (our unit), a ServiceNow unit, and a Management Consulting unit - each focused on different aspects of digital transformation.

Title: Analytikere til bekæmpelse af hvidvask og skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet
Description:
Kan du spotte usynlige mønstre i komplekse datasæt og omsætte brudstykker af informationer til skarpe analyseprodukter? Brænder du for datadrevet problemknusning, og vil du være med til at sætte retningen for vores tværgående kontrolindsatser? Så er du måske en af de analytikere, vi søger til Tværgående Analyse og Kontrol.




Vær med til at understøtte bekæmpelse af skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet

Fagområdet Særlig Kontrol i Skattestyrelsen bekæmper organiseret, systematisk og kompleks skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet, og i Tværgående Analyse og Kontrol har vi til opgave at understøtte fagområdets kernedrift og vores strategisk prioriterede områder med operationelle og taktiske analyser og kontroloplæg.




Derudover har vi ansvaret for at omsætte finansielle efterretninger fra Hvidvasksekretariatet (NSK) til konkrete og målbare kontrolindsatser samt indsamle, validere og visualisere data for at understøtte en data- og analysedrevet opgaveløsning.




Som analytiker i Eenheden får du en aarierede portefølje af analyse- og efterretningsopgaver, der

favner bredt og kan byde på alt fra

Taktisk analyse: Udpegning af kontrolegnede entiteter eller udarbejdelse af efterretnings- og sagsoverblik, der beskriver ”Hvem bør kontrolleres?”
Operationel analyse: Identificere og kortlægge tværgående overblik over netværk eller klynger i form af visualiseringer / netværksdiagrammer og netværksanalyser, der beskriver ”Hvad er omfanget, og hvad gør de involverede?”
Strategisk analyse (begrænset omfang): Udarbejde problem- eller kortlægningsanalyser som belyser ”Hvad udgør en risiko?”
Ad hoc-opgaver: Understøtte driften og enhedens øvrige opgaveportefølje.




Gennem opgaveløsningen kommer du til at få indflydelse på vores måde at arbejde mere databaseret med bekæmpelse af skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet og være med til at sætte retningen for vores tværgående kontrolindsatser. Du kommer til at samarbejde bredt både internt og eksternt, og du får mulighed for at deltage i både nationale og internationale myndighedsfællesfora.




Gode formidlingsevner, systemkendskab og erfaring med efterretningsanalyse

Med en bred portefølje af opgaver inden for analyse og efterretning søger vi analytikere, der i den grad kan omsætte brudstykker af information til skarpe analyseprodukter. Platforme som IBM i2 (Analyst Notebook), Palantir Gotham eller tilsvarende løsninger skal helst ikke være ukendt for dig. Har du erfaring med eller uddannelse i efterretningsanalyse er det et stort plus for os – det samme gælder teknisk kendskab til Python, R eller Excel VBA.




Derudover ser vi gerne, at du har en relevant uddannelse inden for analyse eller lignende. Har du arbejdet med analyse og efterretning i en anden offentlig myndighed eller indgået i samarbejder som ODIN, FOS, Al Capone eller NTE, er det en fordel og kompetencer med særlig relevans.




Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

er dygtig til formidling – både i forhold til at omsætte svært stof med målgruppen for øje, men også når analyser og data skal forklares
motiveres af et tæt samarbejde på tværs af forskellige faggrupper og ledelseslag
formår at omfavne ny teknologi: Du skal gerne synes, at det er sjovt at arbejde med nye metoder og måder at gå til opgaverne på
tager ansvar for helheden i enhedens ad hoc-opgaver, når det kræves – også når rutineopgaver i driften skal løses. Vi er sammen om opgaverne, og vi løfter i flok!




Tværgående Analyse og Kontrol – Særlig Kontrol – Din nye arbejdsplads

I vores enhed bliver du en del af et fagligt stærkt kontor med 20 kolleger, høj trivsel og et godt socialt sammenhold. Vi kan tilbyde et spændende job med stor samfundsmæssig betydning, hvor vi naturligvis sørger for et grundigt onboarding-forløb med intern undervisning, og du får mulighed for løbende at udvikle dig fagligt gennem mange forskellige opgaver.

Enheden er placeret i Hjørring, men der vil være mulighed for arbejdssted ved et af Særlig Kontrols øvrige kontorer i enten Aarhus eller Høje Taastrup. Da distanceledelse i forvejen er en integreret del af vores hverdag, skal du hvile i at samarbejde på tværs af geografisk afstand, ligesom der må forventes rejseaktivitet til fællesaktiviteter i Hjørring.




Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår

Send ansøgning med CV, uddannelsespapirer samt yderligere relevant materiale via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest mandag den 17. august 2026 kl. 12.




Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte funktionsleder Anders Melchiorsen på telefon 72 37 98 35 eller souschef Dorota Macdonald på telefon 72 37 01 56.

Vi forventer at holde første samtalerunde fredag den 21. august 2026 og anden samtalerunde fredag den 28. august 2026. Der vil som led i ansættelsessamtalerne indgå en analytisk case, der skal løses hjemmefra og derefter præsenteres til en samtale. Derudover forventer vi at gøre brug af en personanalyse i rekrutteringsforløbet.




Forud for ansættelsen indhenter vi referencer og straffeattest.




Hvis du går videre til ansættelse i rekrutteringsforløbet, skal du være opmærksom på, at vi foretager en undersøgelse af, om du har gæld, der er sendt til inddrivelse hos det offentlige. Vi undersøger ligeledes, om du har afgjorte kontrol- og/eller straffesager på skatte- og afgiftsområdet. Din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at vi ikke finder oplysninger om dig, der er uforenelige med en ansættelse i Skatte- og Vækstministeriets koncern.




Du skal være opmærksom på, at din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde denne sikkerhedsgodkendelse under din ansættelse i stillingen. Hvis du allerede er sikkerhedsgodkendt i en anden offentlig myndighed og bliver tilbudt stillingen, ønsker vi at overtage din sikkerhedsgodkendelse fra din nuværende arbejdsplads, hvis forudsætningerne for det er opfyldt.




Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet. Du bliver ansat i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner.

Arbejdsstedet kan være Parallelvej 11, 9800 Hjørring, Lyseng Allé 1, 8270 Højbjerg eller Engelholm Alle 1, 2630 Taastrup.




Skat er ikke enkelt. Derfor har vi brug for dig.

I Skattestyrelsen bliver du en del af et fagligt og mangfoldigt fællesskab, hvor du får ansvar, udvikler dig gennem komplekse opgaver og får tæt sparring med dygtige kolleger – alt sammen inden for fleksible rammer.

Skattestyrelsen lægger vægt på at understøtte fleksible arbejdsvilkår, og rammerne for arbejdstilrettelæggelsen drøftes mellem leder og medarbejder med udgangspunkt i den samlede opgaveløsning.

Din udvikling betyder meget for os, og hos os får du gode muligheder for læring og en karrierevej, der er fleksibel og tilpasset dig, uanset hvor i livet du befinder dig.

Vi samarbejder på tværs af generationer, uddannelser, baggrunde og landsdele om at løse vores kerneopgave. Vores opgaver kræver viden, ekspertise og fordybelse. Din læringskurve vil derfor være stejl, og du styrker din faglighed og opbygger kompetencer, der følger dig videre i dit arbejdsliv.

Skattestyrelsen spiller en vigtig rolle i samfundet ved at sørge for, at ingen betaler hverken for meget eller for lidt i skat. Det er ikke en enkel opgave, men den er vigtig, og vi er stolte af at sikre finansieringen af den offentlige sektor. Skat er alles ansvar – og så er det vores arbejde. Og det kan også blive dit.

Skattestyrelsen opfordrer alle kvalificerede uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Kan du spotte usynlige mønstre i komplekse datasæt og omsætte brudstykker af informationer til skarpe analyseprodukter? Brænder du for datadrevet problemknusning, og vil du være med til at sætte retningen for vores tværgående kontrolindsatser? Så er du måske en af de analytikere, vi søger til Tværgående Analyse og Kontrol.


Vær med til at understøtte bekæmpelse af skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet

Fagområdet Særlig Kontrol i Skattestyrelsen bekæmper organiseret, systematisk og kompleks skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet, og i Tværgående Analyse og Kontrol har vi til opgave at understøtte fagområdets kernedrift og vores strategisk prioriterede områder med operationelle og taktiske analyser og kontroloplæg.


Derudover har vi ansvaret for at omsætte finansielle efterretninger fra Hvidvasksekretariatet (NSK) til konkrete og målbare kontrolindsatser samt indsamle, validere og visualisere data for at understøtte en data- og analysedrevet opgaveløsning.


Som analytiker i Eenheden får du en aarierede portefølje af analyse- og efterretningsopgaver, der

favner bredt og kan byde på alt fra

  • Taktisk analyse: Udpegning af kontrolegnede entiteter eller udarbejdelse af efterretnings- og sagsoverblik, der beskriver ”Hvem bør kontrolleres?”
  • Operationel analyse: Identificere og kortlægge tværgående overblik over netværk eller klynger i form af visualiseringer / netværksdiagrammer og netværksanalyser, der beskriver ”Hvad er omfanget, og hvad gør de involverede?”
  • Strategisk analyse (begrænset omfang): Udarbejde problem- eller kortlægningsanalyser som belyser ”Hvad udgør en risiko?”
  • Ad hoc-opgaver: Understøtte driften og enhedens øvrige opgaveportefølje.


Gennem opgaveløsningen kommer du til at få indflydelse på vores måde at arbejde mere databaseret med bekæmpelse af skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet og være med til at sætte retningen for vores tværgående kontrolindsatser. Du kommer til at samarbejde bredt både internt og eksternt, og du får mulighed for at deltage i både nationale og internationale myndighedsfællesfora.


Gode formidlingsevner, systemkendskab og erfaring med efterretningsanalyse

Med en bred portefølje af opgaver inden for analyse og efterretning søger vi analytikere, der i den grad kan omsætte brudstykker af information til skarpe analyseprodukter. Platforme som IBM i2 (Analyst Notebook), Palantir Gotham eller tilsvarende løsninger skal helst ikke være ukendt for dig. Har du erfaring med eller uddannelse i efterretningsanalyse er det et stort plus for os – det samme gælder teknisk kendskab til Python, R eller Excel VBA.


Derudover ser vi gerne, at du har en relevant uddannelse inden for analyse eller lignende. Har du arbejdet med analyse og efterretning i en anden offentlig myndighed eller indgået i samarbejder som ODIN, FOS, Al Capone eller NTE, er det en fordel og kompetencer med særlig relevans.


Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • er dygtig til formidling – både i forhold til at omsætte svært stof med målgruppen for øje, men også når analyser og data skal forklares
  • motiveres af et tæt samarbejde på tværs af forskellige faggrupper og ledelseslag
  • formår at omfavne ny teknologi: Du skal gerne synes, at det er sjovt at arbejde med nye metoder og måder at gå til opgaverne på
  • tager ansvar for helheden i enhedens ad hoc-opgaver, når det kræves – også når rutineopgaver i driften skal løses. Vi er sammen om opgaverne, og vi løfter i flok!


Tværgående Analyse og Kontrol – Særlig Kontrol – Din nye arbejdsplads

I vores enhed bliver du en del af et fagligt stærkt kontor med 20 kolleger, høj trivsel og et godt socialt sammenhold. Description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

WPP’s Data & Technology Solutions is WPP’s unified global data products and technology team. You bring strong communication skills, an understanding of brand, adtech, and marketing data, and a commitment to engineering reliable, scalable pipelines. You’ll collaborate closely with teammates and product stakeholders to ensure our data infrastructure evolves with the business while actively leveraging modern development and testing technologies.

If you are ready to be at the forefront of the AdTech industry, shaping its future, and driving success for both our clients, we encourage you to apply and join our team.

Strong communication skills, you can effectively explain technical concepts to various audiences.
2+ years of experience in data engineering.
Solid experience with data wrangling in a language such as Python, Go, or Scala.
Proficiency in large scale processing engines and related ecosystems (Spark
Experience working with CI/CD, version control, and testing best practices.
Experience with cloud-based platforms like GCP, AWS, or Azure.
Experience working with infrastructure as code tools like Terraform.
Experience with containerization management tools like Kubernetes.

Strong communication skills, you can effectively explain technical concepts to various audiences.
2+ years of experience in data engineering.
Solid experience with data wrangling in a language such as Python, Go, or Scala.
Proficiency in large scale processing engines and related ecosystems (Spark
Experience working with CI/CD, version control, and testing best practices.
Experience with cloud-based platforms like GCP, AWS, or Azure.
Experience working with infrastructure as code tools like Terraform.
Experience with containerization management tools like Kubernetes.
A passion for data, technology, and computer languages.
Interest in leveraging AI coding assistants and prompt engineering to enhance productivity.


Nice to have:


Familiarity with AdTech- and/or MarTech data and terminology.
Experience with monorepo codebase.
Experience with data privacy engineering technologies and best practices in handling sensitive data.


Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

Title: Power BI Developer
Description:
Vil du omsætte data til værdifulde beslutningsgrundlag i en international koncern? Som Power BI Developer får du en central rolle i udviklingen af brugervenlige Power BI-løsninger, hvor du i tæt samarbejde med forretningen skaber rapporter og dashboards, der gør en reel forskel.




Få en nøglerolle i udviklingen af forretningsnære dataløsninger

Vores kunde er en international produktionsvirksomhed med en stærk markedsposition inden for byggesektoren. Virksomheden udvikler tekniske løsninger til professionelle kunder og arbejder målrettet med innovation, kvalitet og bæredygtighed.

Netop nu leder virksomheden efter en Power BI Developer, som kan sikre teknisk korrekt, letforståelig og ikke mindst brugbare data, der understøtter forretningen.




Du vil blandt andet få følgende ansvarsområder og arbejdsopgaver:

Udvikle og designe Power BI-rapporter og dashboards med fokus på datakvalitet og ensartethed på tværs af afdelinger
Vedligeholde og optimere eksisterende rapporter, herunder performance og datalogik
Oversætte forretningsbehov til konkrete rapportløsninger
Understøtte brugertræning og adoption af Power BI på tværs af organisationen
Bidrage til en datadrevet kultur ved at gøre indsigter tilgængelige og forståelige for forretningen
Arbejde med datamodeller og dataset i tæt samarbejde med kolleger på området




Du får base i Midtjylland, hvor du bliver en del af økonomi- og IT-afdelingen med rig mulighed for indflydelse på retningen.




Du gør data til værdifulde beslutningsgrundlag

Vi leder efter dig, som kommer med solid erfaring med Power BI. Du arbejder sikkert med rapportdesign, datavisualisering og udvikling af dashboards – alt sammen med fokus på at skabe intuitive løsninger for forretningen. Samtidig har du en god forståelse for datamodellering og relationer. Derudover har du et grundlæggende kendskab til SQL, Python og Copilot/AI.




Det vigtigste er dog, at du motiveres af at omsætte komplekse data til overskuelige og handlingsorienterede indsigter. Du har en analytisk og detaljeorienteret tilgang, men formår samtidig at gøre data forståelige og anvendelige for brugere uden teknisk baggrund.

Som person er du samarbejdsorienteret, nysgerrig og proaktiv. Derfor falder det dig naturligt at indgå i dialog om rapporteringsbehov, men også selv tage initiativ til at identificere hvilke data, der skaber værdi for forretningen.




Du har en relevant uddannelsesbaggrund inden for f.eks. økonomi, informationsteknologi, datavidenskab eller lignende, som er et godt supplement til din forretningsmæssige forståelse. Derudover behersker du både dansk og engelsk flydende i skrift og tale.

Title: Revenue Operations Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Revenue Operations Analyst

United Fintech is building a global platform that connects financial institutions with modern, scalable technology solutions. Through acquisitions and partnerships, we bring together market-leading fintech products that serve banks, exchange groups, brokerages, and investment firms worldwide.
 
If you enjoy working with data and have a keen interest in commercial operations within a fast-paced fintech environment, then you might be what we are looking for to join our team in Copenhagen.
 
What You Will Contribute
 
We are looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team at United Fintech. 
 
United Fintech is scaling fast, and our commercial data needs to scale with it. We are looking for someone who does not just report what happened but helps the business understand why and what to do next.
 
You will be responsible for defining the analytical roadmap for our commercial departments, ensuring that data is not just reported but used as a competitive advantage to drive growth and efficiency. This means working across our commercial data infrastructure, spanning CRM, BI tooling, and the integrations that connect them, with a clear view of how systems speak to each other and how data flows across the customer journey. You will also be expected to continuously improve how the team operates, using AI tools and automation to make analytical workflows faster and more scalable.
 
This is a hands-on, highly operational role with real ownership and significant growth potential for someone looking to build expertise in revenue analytics, systems integration, and commercial data architecture within a fast-growing fintech environment.
 
Key responsibilities include:

Analytical Roadmap - Define the analytics agenda for our commercial departments. Identify where data is missing or misread and work proactively to close those gaps.

Title: Bliv Data Analyst i EIFO – en 12-måneders tidsbegrænset stilling med fokus på data og beslutningskraft
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med Power BI, datamodellering og visuel formidling – og vil du være med til at gøre data til et endnu stærkere beslutningsgrundlag i EIFO? I Danmarks Eksport- og Investeringsfond søger vi en nysgerrig og motiveret Data Analyst til en 12-måneders tidsbegrænset ansættelse, som vil være med til at udvikle rapportering, self service-løsninger og datadrevet beslutningsstøtte på tværs af organisationen.




I EIFO er vi i fuld gang med at løfte dataområdet, så indsigt bliver til konkrete resultater i forretningen. Vores Data-afdeling er relativt ny og i hastig udvikling, og vi indgår dagligt i fire tværfaglige teams på tværs af Data & Digitalisering. I dag er vi seks dygtige kolleger med erfaring inden for bl.a. datamodellering, produktkendskab, data engineering og rapportering – og vi fungerer som ejere af EIFO’s BI-løsning.




Vi deler viden, har et højt fagligt ambitionsniveau og en kultur præget af åbenhed, engagement og lysten til at bygge noget stærkt sammen.




Vi leder efter dig, der brænder for data, har blik for forretningens behov og kan omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til enkle og værdiskabende dataløsninger.




Din nye rolle og ansvarsområder

Som Data Analyst bliver du en vigtig del af arbejdet med at udbrede datadrevet beslutningsstøtte i EIFO. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med både Data-teamet og forretningen om rapportering, dashboards, semantiske modeller og self service-løsninger, der gør data lettere at anvende i hverdagen.




Du får mulighed for at arbejde med hele værdikæden fra forretningsbehov til færdig dataløsning.




I praksis betyder det, at du blandt andet skal:




1) Forstå og samarbejde – Arbejde tæt sammen med forretningen for at forstå behov, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og omsætte ønsker til konkrete dataløsninger. Bidrage til at definere KPI’er, begreber og succeskriterier, så løsningerne skaber reel værdi.




2) Modellere og udvikle – Udvikle og vedligeholde Power BI-rapporter, dashboards, målinger og semantiske modeller. Arbejde med DAX, datamodellering og dokumentation, så vores rapporteringsløsninger er robuste, forståelige og nemme at anvende.




3) Enable og formidle – Understøtte forretningen i at anvende data bedre gennem dialog, sparring, træning og løbende feedback. Hjælpe brugerne med at forstå datagrundlag, rapporter og mulighederne i self service, så data bliver en naturlig del af beslutninger og arbejdsgange.




Du vil få ansvar fra start, men også støtte fra erfarne kolleger i teamet. Rollen giver mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt og være med til at præge, hvordan vi arbejder med BI, self service og dataanvendelse i EIFO.




Hvem er du?

Vi ser for os en kollega, der har et godt analytisk fundament, interesse for forretningen og lyst til at udvikle sig sammen med os.




Vi forestiller os, at du kan se dig selv i følgende:

Har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for fx økonomi, IT, data, business analytics eller lignende.
Har 2–4 års erfaring som Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Business Analyst eller i en beslægtet rolle.
Har erfaring med Power BI og interesse for at bygge brugervenlige rapporter og dashboards.
Har kendskab til DAX, datamodellering og semantiske modeller.
Har forståelse for datakvalitet, dokumentation og fælles definitioner.
Er stærk til at formidle data og komplekse problemstillinger på en enkel og forståelig måde.
Har lyst til at undervise, facilitere workshops eller træne brugere i anvendelsen af rapporter, dashboards og self service-løsninger.
Kan arbejde tæt sammen med forretningen og skabe tryghed, ejerskab og adoption omkring nye dataløsninger.
Erfaring med Microsoft Fabric eller øvrige produkter i Fabric-suiten er en fordel, men ikke et krav.




Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra dag ét – vigtigst er, at du har drivkraft, læringslyst og et teknisk fundament, som vi kan bygge videre på sammen.




Et tydeligt formål og attraktive vilkår

I EIFO arbejder du for dansk erhvervslivs fremtid – og du får mulighed for at skabe reel værdi for virksomheder, der driver vækst, grøn omstilling og innovation.




Du får:

Et spændende og udfordrende job med et klart purpose og stor samfundsmæssig betydning
En arbejdsplads præget af forretningsfokus, enkelhed og tillid i en uhøjtidelig kontekst
Attraktive vilkår, fleksibilitet og plads til både ambition og balance i arbejdslivet
Engagerede og fagligt stærke kolleger i en mangfoldig og inkluderende kultur, hvor forskellighed ses som en styrke.




Er du klar til at tage næste skridt i din karriere?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV via ansøgningssystemet senest den 10. august 2026.




Som led i vores arbejde med inkluderende rekruttering beder vi dig venligst om ikke at inkludere billede, alder og civilstand i dit ansøgningsmateriale.




Vi behandler ansøgninger efter ansøgningsfristens udløb og forventer at gennemføre samtaler i forlængelse heraf.




Stillingen er en 12-måneders tidsbegrænset ansættelse med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.




Rekrutteringsforløbet består af to samtalerunder. I forbindelse med anden samtalerunde gennemføres personligheds- og logiske tests samt en mindre caseopgave. Referencer indhentes efter aftale i den afsluttende del af processen, og straffeattest skal fremvises ved ansættelse.




Vil du høre mere? Kontakt Product Owner, Rasmus Pallesen, på rasp@eifo.dk. Vi ønsker henvendelser pr. mail. Grundet sommerperioden kan der være længere svartid end normalt, og spørgsmål forventes besvaret i uge 32. Vi sætter pris på din forståelse og tålmodighed.




Hos EIFO tror vi på, at diversitet skaber bedre løsninger – derfor opfordrer vi alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge uanset alder, køn, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold.




Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!




Om Danmarks Eksport- og Investeringsfond (EIFO)

Danmarks Eksport- og Investeringsfond (EIFO) er danske virksomheders fælles indgang til risikovillig statslig finansiering. Vi har et samlet forretningsomfang på omkring 150 mia. kr. og har knap 500 medarbejdere. Med professionalisme og internationalt udsyn arbejder vi hver dag for at understøtte de erhvervssucceser, der kan gøre Danmark rigere på det, der gør en forskel. EIFO er Danmarks nationale erhvervsfremmende bank, investeringsfond og Danmarks officielle eksportkreditinstitut i én og samme finansielle institution.

Title: BI Business Analyst I
Place: Birkerød, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Join us to Make an Impact

Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About The Job

Excited to make a real impact while diving into the finance world? Are you passionate about turning data into actionable insights? As a BI Business Analyst, you will play a key role in empowering colleagues with business intelligence and driving data-driven decision-making across the organization.

This is more than just a job - it is an opportunity to develop valuable skills within BI and finance, collaborate across teams, and contribute to impactful projects within life sciences, renewable energy, and fundamental research.

We are involved in projects that will transform the way we live. With more than fifteen years of expertise and innovation, NKT Photonics a Hamamatsu Company strives to remain the market leader in everything we do.

Responsibilities

As a BI Business Analyst, you will be transforming numbers into insights by working intensively within Power BI and Snowflake. You will play a key role in transforming the organization into a data-driven company creating value through insights.


Act as the go-to person for BI support of new insights and issue resolution
Transform raw data into meaningful insights using Power BI and Snowflake
Gather and prioritize requirements from finance and stakeholders
Develop and maintain dashboards with intuitive visualizations
Improve and modernize Power BI solutions
Automate manual finance processes
Ensure data models support business needs
Collaborate closely with IT and business teams
Manage tickets and resolve data issues
Stay up to date with Power BI and data storytelling best practices


In you, we hope to find


Strong experience with Power BI and Snowflake
Strong ability to define and implement KPIs that measure and drive performance across key business drivers
Experience with D365 is an advantage
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to translate data into insights
Experience with financial datasets
Strong communication skills in English


You are a proactive and hands-on team player who thrives in a collaborative environment, balancing business understanding with strong technical execution.

Our culture is positive, pragmatic, and focused on delivering both quick wins and long-term value. We collaborate closely across the BI team, Finance, and the wider organization to translate data and insights into tangible business impact. Within the BI team, we cover both frontend development in Power BI and backend development in dbt/Snowflake, working in close partnership with our colleagues in IT to ensure structured, reliable data from source systems.

Because collaboration is central to how we work, we primarily work from the office.

Keep your personal data safe

Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

Title: Power BI & Data Insights-konsulent
Description:
Vil du være med til at styrke en af landets førende advokatvirksomheder gennem data, indsigt analyser og moderne teknologiske løsninger?




Advokatbranchen er i hastig forandring. Klienter forventer større transparens, højere effektivitet og tydelig dokumentation for den værdi, der skabes, samtidig med at markedet bliver mere komplekst og konkurrencepræget. Det øger behovet for stærk ledelsesinformation, høj datakvalitet og evnen til at træffe beslutninger på et solidt, oplyst og datadrevet grundlag.

Data er derfor ikke længere blot et rapporteringsværktøj, men et centralt styringsparameter for forretningens udvikling, prioriteringer og performance.




Hos os spiller teknologi og data en stadig vigtigere rolle i udviklingen af forretningen. Vi søger derfor en Power BI & Data Insights-konsulent, der kan omsætte data til værdifulde indsigter, skabe stærke beslutningsgrundlag og bidrage til den fortsatte udvikling af vores BI-setup i tæt samspil med forretningen.




Du bliver en del af Commercial Client Management & Business Insights (CCM), hvor vi understøtter organisationen med analyser, rapportering og datadrevne indsigter, der styrker den strategiske retning og kommercielle udvikling.

Du får en central rolle i arbejdet med at videreudvikle vores Power BI-løsninger og datagrundlag, så ledelse og forretning får et skarpere stærkere grundlag for at prioritere og træffe beslutninger.




Dine opgaver

Udvikle, vedligeholde og optimere dashboards og rapporter i Power BI
Indsamle, strukturere og kvalitetssikre data fra flere datakilder
Udarbejde analyser og ledelsesrapportering, der understøtter forretningsmæssige og strategiske beslutninger
Identificere trends, mønstre og forbedringsmuligheder på baggrund af data
Omsætte forretningsbehov til relevante KPI’er, rapporteringsformater og visuelle dashboards
Videreudvikle datamodeller og BI-arkitektur i samarbejde med relevante interessenter
Understøtte en stærkere anvendelse af data som styringsparameter på tværs af organisationen
Løse ad hoc-opgaver og øvrige BI-relaterede opgaver af analytisk og driftsmæssig karakter




Din rolle

Du får en rolle med stor kontaktflade på tværs af organisationen, hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med både ledelse og forretningsområder. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du både kan arbejde analytisk i dybden og samtidig forstå de forretningsmæssige behov bag analyserne.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor faglig sparring, samarbejde og høj kvalitet er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Rollen passer til dig, der motiveres af at skabe overblik i komplekse sammenhænge og trives med at gøre data brugbare, relevante og handlingsorienterede.

Du kommer til at referere til Niklas Nikolaj Sørensen, Head of CCM.




Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for økonomi, business intelligence, dataanalyse, cand.merc. eller lignende. Du har sandsynligvis et til tre års erfaring fra en lignende rolle, hvor du har arbejdet hands-on med Power BI, databehandling og rapportering og motiveres af at omsætte komplekse data til enkle og anvendelige indsigter.

Du arbejder struktureret og kvalitetsbevidst og har sans for detaljen og den forretningsmæssige helhed. Samtidig er du god til at samarbejde med forskellige interessenter og kan formidle analyser og data på en måde, der skaber værdi for modtageren.




Vi lægger særligt vægt på

Solid erfaring med Power BI
Erfaring med udvikling af dashboards, rapporter og dataindsigter
God forståelse for dataanalyse, KPI’er og ledelsesrapportering
Rutineret bruger af Excel
Erfaring med Power Query, DAX, datamodellering og SQL er en fordel
Evne til at arbejde struktureret og selvstændigt med høj kvalitet
Interesse for at anvende data og teknologi til at udvikle forretningen
Gode samarbejdsevner og lyst til at arbejde på tværs af organisationen




Det kan du forvente hos os

Hos os bliver du del af en organisation, hvor data og teknologi spiller en stadig vigtigere rolle i udviklingen af forretningen. Du får mulighed for at arbejde tæt på ledelsen og bidrage til de analyser og beslutningsgrundlag, der understøtter virksomhedens strategiske retning.

Rollen kombinerer teknisk fordybelse med stor forretningsmæssig indsigt, og du får gode muligheder for både faglig udvikling og ansvar i takt med dine kompetencer.




Ansøgning

Vil du være med til at styrke vores arbejde med data, indsigt og forretningsunderstøttelse hører vi gerne fra dig.

Upload din ansøgning, dit CV og eventuelle referencer senest den 14. august 2026. Vi holder samtaler løbende.

Tiltrædelse er den 1. oktober eller efter aftale.




Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Niklas Nikolaj Sørensen, Head of CCM, på telefon 25 26 37 53.

Title: Data Engineer
Place: Sønderborg, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Would you like to work for a company with solutions that contributes to Saab’s mission of keeping people and society safe?

Would you like to be a part of shaping the Future of Digital Engineering and building the Future of Engineering?

Engineering is evolving rapidly. Model Based Systems Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, connected engineering data, and digital collaboration are transforming how complex systems are designed and delivered.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to help build the data foundation that enables modern engineering. You will connect engineering data, improve digital workflows, and prepare the organization for AI enabled engineering.

Your role

You will:


Develop data pipelines and system integrations across engineering tools
Improve data quality, consistency, governance, and traceability
Support Digital Thread and MBSE initiatives
Prepare engineering data for AI and advanced analytics
Design scalable data models and dashboards
Identify opportunities to automate engineering processes
Collaborate with engineers, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver practical solutions



Your Profile

You have experience in one or more of the following areas:


Data Engineering
Software Engineering
Systems Engineering
Data Science
Computer Science
Information Technology



Experience with Python, SQL, APIs, cloud platforms, Power BI, graph databases, engineering lifecycle tools, or AI technologies is an advantage but not a requirement.

More important than your exact background is your ability to solve complex problems, connect information, and turn data into business value.

We Are Looking For Someone Who


Thinks analytically and works in a structured way
Enjoys collaborating across technical disciplines
Is curious about new technologies and continuous improvement
Can translate engineering challenges into digital solutions
Takes ownership and delivers pragmatic results



Why Join Us

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of engineering, data, and emerging technologies.

Your work will help accelerate Digital Engineering, strengthen MBSE adoption, improve engineering efficiency, and establish the foundation for future AI capabilities.

If you want to build solutions that will influence how engineering is performed in the years ahead, we would like to hear from you.

What can you expect from us?

Saab Danmark is a company that is growing and you will therefore experience a company that is dynamic and able to adapt. In the Saab group we have a saying” Business is done between people”, and this is also the environment you can expect here. We offer:


Initial learning process with mentorship and support
Good career and development opportunities in a professional company
A vibrant and international atmosphere with colleagues from all over the world
Benefits that support our employees’ wellbeing
A variety of social activities, lunch scheme, pension as well as flexible work conditions
Focus on our teams, good cooperation and giving our employees the ability to take ownership of their tasks.



Candidates must be able to obtain a security clearance by the Danish Defence Intelligence Service. This entails that candidates, as a minimum, have had residency within NATO/EU for the last 7 years.

About Saab Danmark A/S

Saab in Denmark is part of the Saab Group with headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden. At the same time, Saab Danmark is an independent legal company with a flat organisational structure. Our main business area is delivering integrated communication solutions to military markets in Denmark and abroad.

You can find further information about our integrated communication solution TactiCall, at www.saab.com/naval.

Title: BI Consultant
Description:
Group BI & Analytics

Are you curious about how data can create real business value? Do you enjoy working with people, understanding business challenges, and turning insights into solutions?

At BORG Automotive, we are looking for a BI Consultant to join our Group BI & Analytics team. Whether you are early in your career or already have some experience within BI, analytics, or reporting, this role offers the opportunity to building broad expertise within BI & Analytics and developing deeper technical and non-technical competencies.

The Role

As a BI Consultant, you will work with BI and analytics solutions, from understanding business needs and gathering requirements to supporting development, testing, and implementation. You will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and the BI & Analytics team, helping translate opportunities into scalable solutions that support better decision-making across BORG Automotive.

This combination of requirement gathering, solution development, analytics, and domain specialization gives you the opportunity to specialize within specific domains such as supply chain, production, commercial, or finance, while deepening both your technical and non-technical competencies within BI & Analytics.

Key Responsibilities


Clarify business requirements and translate them into valuable BI and analytics solution designs in collaboration with technical specialists.
Support development, testing, and rollout of dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions.
Train and support key users, ensuring relevant knowledge, guidance, and documentation are available to end users.
Take part in the team’s support responsibility through weekly rotating shifts, helping ensure stable and reliable BI services.
Promote data-driven decision-making by identifying opportunities where BI and analytics can improve processes, transparency, and business performance.
Contribute to governance, standardization, and continuous improvement of BI solutions.


Who You Are

You are naturally curious and enjoy understanding how businesses operate. You are comfortable engaging with stakeholders and asking the right questions before jumping to solutions.

You Bring The Following Qualifications And Strengths


Have a relevant degree within Business, Economics, Engineering, IT, Data Analytics, or similar.
Enjoy combining business understanding with analytical thinking
Have strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Are structured and proactive in your approach.
Are motivated by learning and continuous development.
A problem solver who is persistent in turning needs into practical solutions
Help simplify data structures and processes through curiosity and active engagement with business stakeholders.


Experience with SQL, BI tools, reporting, analytics, or data modelling is an advantage, but the most important factor is a genuine interest in helping the business create value through data.

What We Offer


A role with significant interaction across functions, countries, and business areas.
The opportunity to build deep expertise within a selected business domain.
A strong learning environment focused on capability building and knowledge sharing.
Exposure to modern BI and analytics technologies and business-critical initiatives.
Clear opportunities to develop your skills, grow your expertise, and shape your future career path within BI & Analytics.


About Group BI & Analytics

Group BI & Analytics is a team of 8 employees responsible for enabling data-driven decision-making across BORG Automotive. We work closely with the business to transform data into trusted insights, scalable data products, and improved decision-making capabilities. Our mission is to help the organization turn data into business value through strong collaboration, governance, and analytics expertise.

We will process the applications ongoing, but due to summer holidays we will take the first look at candidates medio August.
