Title: BI Specialist - turn healthcare data into better care decisions
Description:
BI Specialist – turn healthcare data into better care decisions
Would you like to develop and deliver data-driven solutions for critical healthcare systems in Danish municipalities? As a BI Specialist, you'll work with the entire BI solution, from customer dialogue to implementation and support. Sounds exciting? Apply now!

The job
As a BI Specialist, you'll join the department responsible for the Cura BI solution. More than 30 municipalities use the solution to gain insights from elder care and social care data, budget and invoice home-care activities, and validate data sent to Statistics Denmark (DST). We're a small, close-knit team where you have real co-determination and influence over how our solutions develop.

As our new colleague in Columna Cura, you'll take on a broad role in the continued development of our SaaS-based BI solution, which is built on data from the Cura EHR system (an ERP-like system). You'll work with a complete Microsoft technology stack and engage with both backend and frontend. You can look forward to:


Taking co-responsibility for the continued development of the BI solution end to end, from requirements specification with customers to back- and frontend development, quality assurance, and implementation
Having dialogue with customers and colleagues about further development of solutions and requirements
Responding to customer enquiries and BI-related questions



You must be able to communicate in both Danish and English, spoken and written.

Joining the team
In our team, we work with only three releases a year. This gives you a predictable daily routine and the opportunity to delve deeply into our solutions. It's naturally busy at times, but the rhythm leaves room for both professional immersion and life outside of work. The team is part of Cura Projects & Service, where we ensure successful implementation projects and deliver services as needed. Read more about our Columna Cura portfolio here.

Your Qualifications
We're looking for a technical profile with experience from the BI world. You have a couple of years' experience in a similar position, and your educational background could be a master's degree in healthcare technology, Cand.Merc. (BI), IT Product Development, Information Science, or similar.

You have knowledge of the Microsoft technology stack, covering Microsoft SQL Server, T-SQL, and DAX. It's an advantage if you have worked with Targit before, but it's not a demand.

You're excited to take on a broad role covering both frontend and backend of our BI solutions, developing into a BI Swiss Army knife. With more than 10 years behind us, we've built a complex solution, so there's ample opportunity to dive into the technology and work with advanced BI challenges.

Healthcare domain knowledge is an advantage but not a requirement. However, a desire to work with healthcare data and build knowledge of the domain is essential to succeed in this role.

As a person, you are:


Thorough and detail-oriented - you don't leave things until they're properly worked through
Reliable and conscientious - people can count on things being done right, not just fast
Good at listening and building relationships, taking the time to understand what the customer actually needs before shaping the solution
Calm by nature and take things at your own pace, including when it comes to getting to grips with new and complex material
Motivated by making a real difference for others through good collaboration and a steady, persistent work effort



We don't expect you to master every part of this from day one. You'll be onboarded gradually, paired with experienced colleagues, and given time to grow into the full scope of the role. What matters most is your willingness to learn and your interest in the domain.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or EU country for the past seven years, as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus
At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks, from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables, and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. In addition, we offer several employee benefits, such as paid home internet, health insurance, and a company pension scheme.

Never stop developing
Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international, and proudly rooted in Denmark, with more than 1,100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there's room to be professional and personal. It's not just a place to work but a place to belong.

If you have any questions, you're always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Rasmus Bach Andersen, Senior Project Manager.

Title: Data Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About Us

Complir is the AI platform for the product compliance lifecycle, built for retailers, brands, and manufacturers selling physical consumer products across multiple markets.

We believe getting a physical product to market shouldn't mean fighting spreadsheets, PDFs, and supplier emails just to prove it's safe and legal to sell. Product compliance should be continuous, automatic, and understandable, not a bottleneck that slows launches down. We're building the AI infrastructure that makes that possible.

We work with many of the world's largest retailers and brands across fashion, furniture, cosmetics, toys, electronics and many other product categories. We're backed by Y Combinator, and a roster of investors who see what we see: Product compliance is the next major infrastructure category, and we're leading it.

About The Role

Every product you've ever bought, from a kid's toy dinosaur to your electric toothbrush, had to clear a wall of regulation before it reached you. That wall is written down somewhere: scattered across hundreds of government portals, PDFs, and legal databases, in dozens of languages, updated on no schedule anyone agreed to.

Your job is to turn that chaos into structured, queryable data our product can act on. You'll be the person who makes the world's product regulations machine-readable.

The data layer everything stands on

This is not a role where you write Python scripts in isolation. You'll understand, crawl, and monitor regulatory sources across hundreds of jurisdictions, parse raw legal text into a normalized requirement schema, and catch changes the day they land, so every label, Declaration of Conformity, and risk assessment we generate is provably current.

The interesting problems are everywhere: government portals that were last redesigned when fax machines were current, legal text that means different things in different translations, amendments that quietly rewrite three other acts, and the question of how you prove to an enterprise customer that your data was correct on the day they shipped. LLMs make structured extraction over legal text possible for the first time; making it reliable enough to stake a product launch on is the engineering problem you'll own.

You'll do this sitting next to the founders, our AI engineers, and our in-house compliance experts at our Copenhagen HQ. No layers, no ticket queues. When a source breaks or a regulation changes, the fix ships in hours, not sprints.

What You'll Actually Do


Build and operate the crawling and monitoring layer across hundreds of regulatory sources: government portals, legislative databases, and official gazettes in dozens of languages
Parse raw legal text (HTML, PDFs, scans) into a normalized requirement schema, using LLM-assisted extraction pipelines you design, evaluate, and harden
Build change detection that catches new acts, amendments, and repeals the day they land, and triggers the downstream updates our customers depend on
Own data quality end to end: provenance, versioning, and coverage metrics, so every requirement in the platform traces back to its primary source
Work with our regulatory experts to evolve the schema and taxonomy as coverage grows from the EU to new jurisdictions
Shape the architecture, tooling, and data culture as the team grows


You will love this job, if you are:


An engineer with several years building data pipelines, crawling infrastructure, or large-scale extraction systems
Experienced with (or seriously hungry to go deep on) LLM-assisted extraction: structured outputs, evals, and the failure modes of models reading dense text
Someone who treats data correctness as sacred: provenance, versioning, and "how do we know this is still true?" are your favorite questions
Unafraid of messy sources: broken HTML, scanned PDFs, and legal prose in languages you don't speak are puzzles, not blockers
Product-minded: You understand that a quality manager will stake a product launch on your pipeline's output
Bonus points if you have worked with regulatory data before
Comfortable with ambiguity and speed: Small team, fast decisions, no spec handed down from above
Excited to work on-site in Copenhagen with the whole team
A builder at heart


What You Get


Ownership of the regulatory data layer, the foundation the entire product stands on
Zero layers: You sit next to the founders, the AI team, and the compliance experts whose domain you're turning into data
Ground floor of a category-defining company, backed by Y Combinator and investors betting on product compliance becoming the next big thing
Competitive salary and equity
An office where the pastries are mandatory

Title: Product Owner & Analytics Engineer
Description:
Vil du være med til at forme fremtidens dataplatform i en af Danmarks største energivirksomheder?

Har du evnen til at forstå forretningens behov, prioritere de vigtigste indsatser og omsætte dem til dataløsninger, der skaber værdi i praksis? Så er du måske vores nye Product Owner & Analytics Engineer.

En nøglerolle i udviklingen af OK's dataplatform
Du bliver en del af Data Engineering & BI, som har en central rolle i at gøre data til et strategisk aktiv på tværs af OK. Vi er i gang med en ambitiøs transformation, hvor vi bygger en moderne dataplatform og udvikler nye måder at arbejde med data på – med fokus på skalerbarhed, kvalitet, genanvendelighed og forretningsværdi.

I rollen kombinerer du Product Ownership og Analytics Engineering. Du sætter retningen for dit område, prioriterer indsatserne og sikrer, at teamet arbejder med det, der skaber størst værdi. Samtidig arbejder du hands-on med datamodellering, forretningslogik og udviklingen af data products, der omsætter data til konkrete indsigter og løsninger for forretningen.

Du får en bred kontaktflade på tværs af organisationen og stor indflydelse på både prioriteringer, arbejdsformer og udviklingen af OK's dataplatform.

Vi søger en profil, der forener kompetencer fra både Product Owner- og BI-udviklerrollen. Du kan kombinere forretningsforståelse, produktledelse og analytiske kompetencer for at sikre, at data omsættes til løsninger, der bliver anvendt og skaber værdi.

Dine opgaver er at:

Drive data- og analyseinitiativer fra idé til forretningsværdi.
Eje og prioritere backloggen for dit område.
Omsætte forretningsbehov til data products, KPI'er og analyser.
Udvikle genanvendelige datamodeller og forretningslogik.
Sikre høj anvendelse af data gennem stærke løsninger og tæt forretningsdialog.
Udfordre behov og skabe alignment mellem forretning, IT og Data.
Bidrage til udviklingen af OK's moderne dataplatform.

Du balancerer forretning, teknologi og samarbejde
Du trives i krydsfeltet mellem forretning og teknologi og motiveres af at omsætte behov til løsninger, der skaber værdi. Du tager naturligt ejerskab, skaber fremdrift og formår at omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til konkrete initiativer. Samtidig bygger du stærke relationer, udfordrer konstruktivt og skaber tillid på tværs af organisationen.

Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med:

Product Ownership eller lignende roller med ansvar for prioritering, roadmap og backlog.
At omsætte forretningsbehov til data products, analyser og konkrete løsninger.
Stakeholder management og samarbejde på tværs af forretning og IT.
Datamodellering, forretningslogik og udvikling af genanvendelige dataløsninger.
At skabe værdi og adoption gennem datadrevne løsninger.
Datakvalitet, governance og dokumentation.

Vi ser også gerne, at du har erfaring med følgende teknologier og værktøjer:

Databricks
dbt
Power BI
SQL

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har erfaring med:

Microsoft SQL Server BI (SSIS, SSAS og SSRS)

Derfor skal du søge
Du bliver en del af et område i stor udvikling, hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på både vores dataplatform og den måde, vi arbejder med data på.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

En central rolle med stor indflydelse på OK's dataområde

Title: Data Scientists for Big Data, IoT and AI projects
Description:
Stillingsbeskrivelse

Do you like working creatively with data analytics, big data, AI, visualisation, NoSQL and databases? Would you like to join an international organisation where we already work with data analytics and machine learning projects? Join BEUMER Group and exploit the chance to innovate, develop and test concepts for products and tools and most importantly, develop your own skill.

You will team up with colleagues, so you can share and grow your knowledge within the data science field. It also means focusing on using data from an already existing infrastructure where we collect data from more than 350 sites worldwide.

Join our Customer Diagnostics Center

You become part of our Data Analytics department, which is part of our Customer Diagnostics Center (CDC). In the CDC, which is part of our Customer Support division, we are tasked with making sure our installed base of systems around the globe are healthy and running smoothly.

Here, you join a well-established but agile team of highly sought for data scientists. You have the freedom to develop solutions across the organisation focusing on creativity and innovation on the conceptual stages of possible new products, services and tools.

In the CDC, you will find a multitude of skills and competences, and we enjoy an informal atmosphere where we combine our strengths to create brand new solutions for colleagues and customers. Moreover, you become part of a data analytics forum where we work closely with universities to expand our knowledge.

Create value through data across the organisation

Through a continuous dialogue with our business and product development, you will be responsible for defining new products, services and tools based on data and machine learning. We are a large organisation with several specialist fields, which means that we can enjoy the value of data analysis across disciplines.

Your Tasks Will Include


Initiating mining of existing data from material handling systems running in production, looking for possible bottlenecks, optimizations etc.
Processing, cleansing, and verifying the integrity of data used for analysis.
Participating in the maintenance of the existing data pipeline.
Participate in defining and evaluating new techniques for data collection and analysis.
Drive the rollout and extension of our data collection to all sites in the BEUMER Group.


We have a strong preference for open-source software and are working with platforms and tools such as Kubernetes, ArgoCD, MLFlow, vLLM, Elastic stack, Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, Numaflow, Python/Java/Golang, Jupyter notebooks and Opentelemetry. You will test and implement prototypes, e.g. for customer solutions or for your colleagues to provide them with the right tools to perfect their work. As such, you bridge the worlds of product development, subject specialists and technology to innovate the business.

Experience with data driven decision making, big data and concept development?

Role

Most important to this role is that you have a good all-round technical foundation, allowing you to implement software, configure tools, understand our domain and be a sounding board in the creative process. To do so, we also imagine that you:


Hold a master's degree or PhD as a computer scientist, engineer, physicist or similar.
Have a great understanding of and hands-on experience with using data analytics for system and concept development.
Speak and write English fluently and it is a big plus if you understand Danish as well.


Personality-wise, you are a strong communicator who can work across the organisation and with customers. Your strength is within innovation and creative thinking, which shows itself in added value in the concept development process and tests.

Interested?

If you have any questions regarding this position, please do not hesitate to contact Head of Global Data Analytics Anders Lildballe at +45 30 17 93 48. Please apply online via beumergroup.com/career.

We look forward to meeting you.

BEUMER Group

Conveying, loading, palletising, packing, sortation and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a working culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

Title: Marketing Automation & Data Specialist
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du arbejde med data, analyse og marketing automation i praksis? Hos Velliv får du mulighed for både at analysere store datamængder, udvikle nye datagrundlag og omsætte indsigter til automatiseret kommunikation for mere end 400.000 kunder.

Vi har bedt din kommende leder om at sætte ord på jobbet og opgaverneVi søger to nyuddannede Marketing Automation & Data Specialister, der vil være med til at udvikle vores datadrevne kundekommunikation. Du bliver en del af et dygtigt fagligt miljø i Marketing & Brand, hvor vi samarbejder tæt med forretningen, Data Warehouse og IT for at skabe relevante og værdiskabende kundeoplevelser.

I rollen får du ansvaret for at analysere store mængder data og omsætte indsigter til automatiserede kampagner og flows, der skaber mere relevant kommunikation til vores kunder. Du kommer ikke kun til at arbejde med eksisterende data. Du vil også være med til at udvikle og specificere nye datasæt, segmenteringer og dataprodukter på vores Snowflake-platform i samarbejde med Data Warehouse og IT.

Samtidig bliver du en nøglespiller i implementeringen af Adobe Campaign v8 og får dermed en mulighed for at arbejde med en moderne cloud-baseret marketingteknologi – og være med til at bygge setuppet rigtigt fra starten.

Dine primære opgaver bliver:


Analysere store datamængder og omsætte kundeindsigter til segmentering, målgrupper og relevante kundeoplevelser
Udvikle og vedligeholde datagrundlag til marketing- og kommunikationsaktiviteter
Udvikle og optimere automatiserede kampagner og flows
Rapportering og opfølgning på kampagner og aktiviteter
Bidrage til at sikre et solidt datagrundlag, herunder datakvalitet og struktur på tværs af systemer


Du har forudsætningerne og modet til mereDer er styrke i forskellighed. Vi bliver bedre af at bringe forskellige erfaringer, fagligheder og personligheder sammen. Derfor opfordrer vi til, at alle uanset baggrund sender en ansøgning. Vi vurderer dog, at der er nogle grundlæggende forudsætninger, som er vigtige for at lykkes i jobbet:


Er nyuddannet eller har op til 1-2 års erfaring
Har en relevant kandidatuddannelse inden for fx økonomi, data science, matematik, eller statistik
Er nysgerrig på databaser, datamodeller og moderne dataplatforme
Har interesse for data og programmering – gerne erfaring med SQL samt fx DAX eller Python
Trives med at arbejde analytisk og omsætte data til konkrete løsninger
Er nysgerrig og struktureret og har lyst til at lære


Sådan oplever en af dine nye kolleger afdelingen"Her får du hurtigt lov til at tage ansvar og gøre en forskel. Vi hjælper hinanden, sparrer på tværs og deler gerne vores viden, så alle bliver dygtigere. Vi er et hold med forskellige faglige profiler, og det giver både gode løsninger og en hverdag med god energi, højt humør og masser af samarbejde." // Alan Sonne Rasmussen, ansvarlig for Marketing Automation

Plads til at være menneske – plads til at være digVelliv er flere år i træk blevet kåret til at have branchens bedste medarbejderimage og har gennem flere år vundet prisen som Årets Pensionsselskab. Hos os bliver du mødt med åbne arme, og vi gør os umage for, at du kommer godt fra start og hurtigt falder til.

Du får en buddy, der hjælper dig i gang, og en leder, der bidrager med mening, udvikling og retning. Du har mulighed for at melde dig ind i ”Klub Velliv” og deltage i aktiviteter inden for sport, mad, hobby og kultur for medarbejdere og deres børn. I det hele taget kan du forvente en kultur, hvor vi lever vores tre kerneværdier: Optimisme, Ordentlighed og Omsorg.

I Velliv skal der være plads til at være menneske – plads til at være dig.

Vi holder samtaler løbendeSend dit CV og et par ord om dig selv og din baggrund i en kort ansøgning. Vi vil gerne høre fra dig senest den 15. august 2026, men vi holder samtaler løbende fra 3. august 2026, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte Emil Madsen eller Alan Sonne Rasmussen via e-mail: emil.madsen@velliv.dk eller alan.sonne.rasmussen@velliv.dk.

På grund af sommerferie, kan der forventes forlænget responstid ved henvendelser omkring dette job.

Title: Commodity Insights Consultant
Description:
Are you motivated by working in a focused team that delivers analytics, insights, and decision support? Would you like to join a skilled group of consultants working with insights into commodity markets, macroeconomic conditions, cost structures, etc.? All with the purpose of creating leading Nordic private brands for our 27 million Nordic Consumers.

Right now, we are looking for a skilled Commodity Insights Consultant to join our Commodity Insights team.

Today, the team consists of two colleagues based in Copenhagen. We analyse major global commodity markets and FMCG cost structures to provide our procurement team with the best possible insight into the market. The goal of this work is simple: to ensure that our partners and consumers have access to the right quality products at the right price.

Our days are full of variety, where we can go from focusing on oat prices to toilet paper cost structures, and then from crude oil dynamics to fruit harvests in South America. To challenge ourselves and incorporate different viewpoints we priorities open dialogue in our team and across departments.

Our team operates with a high level of self-management and specialization within our area of expertise, continuously pushing ourselves and our colleagues to unlock deeper insights into markets and cost structures.

Your role as a member of the team

As a Commodity Insights Consultant, you will challenge the status quo through your knowledge and collaborative mindset, providing valuable analyses, insights and advice to our buyers on commodity price developments to ensure competitive prices.

You will work with a wide range of raw materials, as our portfolio of private label products covers everything from salmon to oatmeal and from cheese to toilet paper.

This is a highly self-managing role suited for a person who takes initiative, has a high level of ownership, thrives on challenging close stakeholders and is motivated by seeing their results implemented. Part of the role is also being part of projects with focus on developing our capabilities within pricing excellence and/or market insights.

Your Primary Tasks


Analysis and monitoring of the commodity market and providing recommendations
Preparation of decision support for our buyers - including sparring with buyers about purchase times, contract lengths, etc.
Participating as support for buyers on supplier meetings and on bi-weekly sourcing pricing meetings
Validate prices and price changes from our suppliers in cooperation with buyers
Development and maintenance of commodity models and factor price modelling to support buyers in their negotiations as well as development of cost avoidance and risk management strategies


Your Professional Qualifications


Higher education e.g. Master of Science in Economics (cand.merc. or cand.oecon). or other economic background
Minimum of 2-3+ years of experience within commodities analysis
Structured, analytical and methodical
Can convey complex knowledge to all levels of the organisation and present this in a simple and understandable way
Experienced in Excel
High level in English, written and oral
Experience within FMCG is an advantage, possibly from the supplier side, but not a prerequisite


Workstyle


You have solid analytical skills and can handle complex issues as well as large amounts of data
You are able to acquire new knowledge quickly and are able to understand and translate business needs into solutions in the form of for example, reports, analyses, decision advice, etc.
You see opportunities and think about continuous improvements using data to optimize and ensure our buyers the best possible basis for decision-making
You are motivated to acquire new skills and share knowledge with your colleagues
You can both work on your own and be part of a team where sparring is an important part of everyday life
You are a problem solver and you follow through until everything is completed


We Offer


Being part of creating leading Nordic private brands for 27 million Nordic Consumers
A job that gives you plenty of room to build your professional skills
A job in a company that supports you in your own personal development
An engaging and attractive workplace with a high level of well-being
Attractive pension plan and employee benefits
Working from home up to 2 days a week


About Us

At Coop Trading, our purpose is to make a better everyday through leading Nordic private brands for 27 million Nordic consumers. As a key player in the Nordic purchasing landscape, we represent Coop in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and SOK in Finland, negotiating Nordic agreements and innovating products for our Private Brands portfolio. This diverse portfolio encompasses both food and daily nonfood items within our private brands, Xtra, Coop, and Änglamark.

With over 130 dedicated professionals, 9 in Valencia, Spain, and a network of trusted partners across the Nordic region, Coop Trading is a dynamic, responsible, and ambitious workplace. We work to challenge the status quo delivering the best and most innovative private brand products.

Place of work: Skelbækgade at Vesterbro in Copenhagen.

Application deadline: No later than August 9th.

Start: October

For Further Information About The Position

Week 27, 31-32: Head of Procurement Michael Bjunes at +45 2777 2432

Week 29-30: Commodity Insights Consultant Graham Cross at +45 2777 2460

Part of the role is also being part of projects with focus on developing our capabilities within pricing excellence and/or market insights.

Your Primary Tasks

  • Analysis and monitoring of the commodity market and providing recommendations
  • Preparation of decision support for our buyers - including sparring with buyers about purchase times, contract lengths, etc.
  • Participating as support for buyers on supplier meetings and on bi-weekly sourcing pricing meetings
  • Validate prices and price changes from our suppliers in cooperation with buyers
  • Development and maintenance of commodity models and factor price modelling to support buyers in their negotiations as well as development of cost avoidance and risk management strategies

Your Professional Qualifications

  • Higher education e.g. Master of Science in Economics (cand.merc. or cand.oecon). or other economic background
  • Minimum of 2-3+ years of experience within commodities analysis
  • Structured, analytical and methodical
  • Can convey complex knowledge to all levels of the organisation and present this in a simple and understandable way
  • Experienced in Excel
  • High level in English, written and oral
  • Experience within FMCG is an advantage, possibly from the supplier side, but not a prerequisite

Workstyle

  • You have solid analytical skills and can handle complex issues as well as large amounts of data
  • You are able to acquire new knowledge quickly and are able to understand and translate business needs into solutions in the form of for example, reports, analyses, decision advice, etc.
  • You see opportunities and think about continuous improvements using data to optimize and ensure our buyers the best possible basis for decision-making
  • You are motivated to acquire new skills and share knowledge with your colleagues
  • You can both work on your own and be part of a team where sparring is an important part of everyday life
  • You are a problem solver and you follow through until everything is completed

We Offer

  • Being part of creating leading Nordic private brands for 27 million Nordic Consumers
  • A job that gives you plenty of room to build your professional skills
  • A job in a company that supports you in your own personal development
  • An engaging and attractive workplace with a high level of well-being
  • Attractive pension plan and employee benefits
  • Working from home up to 2 days a week

About Us

At Coop Trading, our purpose is to make a better everyday through leading Nordic private brands for 27 million Nordic consumers. As a key player in the Nordic purchasing landscape, we represent Coop in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and SOK in Finland, negotiating Nordic agreements and innovating products for our Private Brands portfolio. This diverse portfolio encompasses both food and daily nonfood items within our private brands, Xtra, Coop, and Änglamark.

With over 130 dedicated professionals, 9 in Valencia, Spain, and a network of trusted partners across the Nordic region, Coop Trading is a dynamic, responsible, and ambitious workplace. We work to challenge the status quo delivering the best and most innovative private brand products.

Place of work: Skelbækgade at Vesterbro in Copenhagen.

Application deadline: No later than August 9th.

Start: October

Title: Retail Performance Analyst
Description:
Retail Performance Analyst

Location:

Aarhus C, DK, 8000

Category: Retail

Job Type: Headquarter

At Søstrene Grene, we believe that great retail experiences are created when commercial insight, operational excellence, and a passion for people come together. We are now looking for a Retail Performance Analyst who will play a central role in supporting and developing the performance of our retail business.

As a trusted partner to Retail, you will help transform data and insights into actions that strengthen both business results and customer experiences. You will work closely with colleagues across the organization and serve as an important link between Retail and key support functions.

If you are driven by turning complexity into clarity, enjoy working with performance data, and thrive in a collaborative environment, this could be the role for you.

Key Responsibilities

You will be responsible for driving performance management across Retail and ensuring that strategic priorities are translated into tangible results.

More specifically, you will:


Drive retail performance
Analyse key operational and commercial KPIs to identify opportunities for growth and improvement.
Translate data and insights into clear recommendations and actions.
Support Retail leaders with performance insights and decision-making.
Ensure strong performance follow-up
Monitor and follow up on sales performance and key business metrics on a daily and weekly basis.
Conduct monthly KPI reviews and performance analyses.
Provide insights into store performance and financial results to support continuous improvement.
Support financial planning processes
Support forecasting, profitability analyses, and ongoing financial follow-up.
Help ensure a strong commercial focus across the organization.
Improve tools, processes, and ways of working
Develop and optimize performance management tools and frameworks.
Drive initiatives that improve operational efficiency and support an excellent customer experience.
Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
Collaborate across Søstrene Grene
Act as a trusted sparring partner for Retail leadership.
Build strong relationships across functions such as Real Estate, Store Design, Franchise, and other business areas.
Support strategic initiatives that strengthen our retail organization and future growth.

What We Hope You Bring

We imagine that you are analytical, commercially minded, and motivated by creating value through collaboration.

You likely have:


Experience working with business performance, financial follow-up, or commercial analysis.
Experience from a retail organization, either from headquarters or operations.
Strong analytical capabilities and experience translating data into meaningful actions.
Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance management.
A structured and proactive approach to driving projects and improvements.
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build relationships across different functions and levels.
Professional proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken, with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization.


Most importantly, you are curious, collaborative, and motivated by making a positive difference for both colleagues and customers.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will help create transparency around retail performance and enable better decisions across the business. Through strong partnerships, clear insights, and a focus on execution, you will contribute to the continued growth and development of Søstrene Grene's retail organization.

About Søstrene Grene's Culture

At Søstrene Grene, we strive to touch people’s hearts through a unique universe that embraces diversity and inclusion and creates a welcoming community for everyone, regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, or background.

We have a workplace where everyone is called “Sister,” regardless of gender. We share joys, strengthen one another, and laugh together. We call this the “Sister spirit,” and we warmly encourage everyone to apply and help create a vibrant and inclusive workplace.

Practical information

Location: Åboulevarden 21, 8000 Aarhus C

Working hours: 37 hours per week

Please upload your CV and application as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the position once we have found the right candidate.

If you have questions regarding the role, feel free to contact Niklas Holz, Head of Retail Performance & Experience, at niklas.holz@sostrenegrene.com.

We will be enjoying a summer break during weeks 29–31. We kindly ask for your patience, as responses can be expected again from week 32.

Please note that the email address is for job-related questions only, and all application documents must be uploaded via our recruitment system.

Title: Analytikere til bekæmpelse af hvidvask og skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet
Description:
Kan du spotte usynlige mønstre i komplekse datasæt og omsætte brudstykker af informationer til skarpe analyseprodukter? Brænder du for datadrevet problemknusning, og vil du være med til at sætte retningen for vores tværgående kontrolindsatser? Så er du måske en af de analytikere, vi søger til Tværgående Analyse og Kontrol.




Vær med til at understøtte bekæmpelse af skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet

Fagområdet Særlig Kontrol i Skattestyrelsen bekæmper organiseret, systematisk og kompleks skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet, og i Tværgående Analyse og Kontrol har vi til opgave at understøtte fagområdets kernedrift og vores strategisk prioriterede områder med operationelle og taktiske analyser og kontroloplæg.




Derudover har vi ansvaret for at omsætte finansielle efterretninger fra Hvidvasksekretariatet (NSK) til konkrete og målbare kontrolindsatser samt indsamle, validere og visualisere data for at understøtte en data- og analysedrevet opgaveløsning.




Som analytiker i Eenheden får du en aarierede portefølje af analyse- og efterretningsopgaver, der

favner bredt og kan byde på alt fra

Taktisk analyse: Udpegning af kontrolegnede entiteter eller udarbejdelse af efterretnings- og sagsoverblik, der beskriver ”Hvem bør kontrolleres?”
Operationel analyse: Identificere og kortlægge tværgående overblik over netværk eller klynger i form af visualiseringer / netværksdiagrammer og netværksanalyser, der beskriver ”Hvad er omfanget, og hvad gør de involverede?”
Strategisk analyse (begrænset omfang): Udarbejde problem- eller kortlægningsanalyser som belyser ”Hvad udgør en risiko?”
Ad hoc-opgaver: Understøtte driften og enhedens øvrige opgaveportefølje.




Gennem opgaveløsningen kommer du til at få indflydelse på vores måde at arbejde mere databaseret med bekæmpelse af skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet og være med til at sætte retningen for vores tværgående kontrolindsatser. Du kommer til at samarbejde bredt både internt og eksternt, og du får mulighed for at deltage i både nationale og internationale myndighedsfællesfora.




Gode formidlingsevner, systemkendskab og erfaring med efterretningsanalyse

Med en bred portefølje af opgaver inden for analyse og efterretning søger vi analytikere, der i den grad kan omsætte brudstykker af information til skarpe analyseprodukter. Platforme som IBM i2 (Analyst Notebook), Palantir Gotham eller tilsvarende løsninger skal helst ikke være ukendt for dig. Har du erfaring med eller uddannelse i efterretningsanalyse er det et stort plus for os – det samme gælder teknisk kendskab til Python, R eller Excel VBA.




Derudover ser vi gerne, at du har en relevant uddannelse inden for analyse eller lignende. Har du arbejdet med analyse og efterretning i en anden offentlig myndighed eller indgået i samarbejder som ODIN, FOS, Al Capone eller NTE, er det en fordel og kompetencer med særlig relevans.




Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

er dygtig til formidling – både i forhold til at omsætte svært stof med målgruppen for øje, men også når analyser og data skal forklares
motiveres af et tæt samarbejde på tværs af forskellige faggrupper og ledelseslag
formår at omfavne ny teknologi: Du skal gerne synes, at det er sjovt at arbejde med nye metoder og måder at gå til opgaverne på
tager ansvar for helheden i enhedens ad hoc-opgaver, når det kræves – også når rutineopgaver i driften skal løses. Vi er sammen om opgaverne, og vi løfter i flok!




Tværgående Analyse og Kontrol – Særlig Kontrol – Din nye arbejdsplads

I vores enhed bliver du en del af et fagligt stærkt kontor med 20 kolleger, høj trivsel og et godt socialt sammenhold. Vi kan tilbyde et spændende job med stor samfundsmæssig betydning, hvor vi naturligvis sørger for et grundigt onboarding-forløb med intern undervisning, og du får mulighed for løbende at udvikle dig fagligt gennem mange forskellige opgaver.

Enheden er placeret i Hjørring, men der vil være mulighed for arbejdssted ved et af Særlig Kontrols øvrige kontorer i enten Aarhus eller Høje Taastrup. Da distanceledelse i forvejen er en integreret del af vores hverdag, skal du hvile i at samarbejde på tværs af geografisk afstand, ligesom der må forventes rejseaktivitet til fællesaktiviteter i Hjørring.




Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår

Send ansøgning med CV, uddannelsespapirer samt yderligere relevant materiale via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest mandag den 17. august 2026 kl. 12.




Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte funktionsleder Anders Melchiorsen på telefon 72 37 98 35 eller souschef Dorota Macdonald på telefon 72 37 01 56.

Vi forventer at holde første samtalerunde fredag den 21. august 2026 og anden samtalerunde fredag den 28. august 2026. Der vil som led i ansættelsessamtalerne indgå en analytisk case, der skal løses hjemmefra og derefter præsenteres til en samtale. Derudover forventer vi at gøre brug af en personanalyse i rekrutteringsforløbet.




Forud for ansættelsen indhenter vi referencer og straffeattest.




Hvis du går videre til ansættelse i rekrutteringsforløbet, skal du være opmærksom på, at vi foretager en undersøgelse af, om du har gæld, der er sendt til inddrivelse hos det offentlige. Vi undersøger ligeledes, om du har afgjorte kontrol- og/eller straffesager på skatte- og afgiftsområdet. Din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at vi ikke finder oplysninger om dig, der er uforenelige med en ansættelse i Skatte- og Vækstministeriets koncern.




Du skal være opmærksom på, at din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde denne sikkerhedsgodkendelse under din ansættelse i stillingen. Hvis du allerede er sikkerhedsgodkendt i en anden offentlig myndighed og bliver tilbudt stillingen, ønsker vi at overtage din sikkerhedsgodkendelse fra din nuværende arbejdsplads, hvis forudsætningerne for det er opfyldt.




Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet. Du bliver ansat i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner.

Arbejdsstedet kan være Parallelvej 11, 9800 Hjørring, Lyseng Allé 1, 8270 Højbjerg eller Engelholm Alle 1, 2630 Taastrup.




Skat er ikke enkelt. Derfor har vi brug for dig.

I Skattestyrelsen bliver du en del af et fagligt og mangfoldigt fællesskab, hvor du får ansvar, udvikler dig gennem komplekse opgaver og får tæt sparring med dygtige kolleger – alt sammen inden for fleksible rammer.

Skattestyrelsen lægger vægt på at understøtte fleksible arbejdsvilkår, og rammerne for arbejdstilrettelæggelsen drøftes mellem leder og medarbejder med udgangspunkt i den samlede opgaveløsning.

Din udvikling betyder meget for os, og hos os får du gode muligheder for læring og en karrierevej, der er fleksibel og tilpasset dig, uanset hvor i livet du befinder dig.

Vi samarbejder på tværs af generationer, uddannelser, baggrunde og landsdele om at løse vores kerneopgave. Vores opgaver kræver viden, ekspertise og fordybelse. Din læringskurve vil derfor være stejl, og du styrker din faglighed og opbygger kompetencer, der følger dig videre i dit arbejdsliv.

Skattestyrelsen spiller en vigtig rolle i samfundet ved at sørge for, at ingen betaler hverken for meget eller for lidt i skat. Det er ikke en enkel opgave, men den er vigtig, og vi er stolte af at sikre finansieringen af den offentlige sektor. Skat er alles ansvar – og så er det vores arbejde. Og det kan også blive dit.

Skattestyrelsen opfordrer alle kvalificerede uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Vær med til at understøtte bekæmpelse af skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet

Derudover har vi ansvaret for at omsætte finansielle efterretninger fra Hvidvasksekretariatet (NSK) til konkrete og målbare kontrolindsatser samt indsamle, validere og visualisere data for at understøtte en data- og analysedrevet opgaveløsning.




Som analytiker i Eenheden får du en aarierede portefølje af analyse- og efterretningsopgaver, der

favner bredt og kan byde på alt fra

Taktisk analyse: Udpegning af kontrolegnede entiteter eller udarbejdelse af efterretnings- og sagsoverblik, der beskriver ”Hvem bør kontrolleres?”
Operationel analyse: Identificere og kortlægge tværgående overblik over netværk eller klynger i form af visualiseringer / netværksdiagrammer og netværksanalyser, der beskriver ”Hvad er omfanget, og hvad gør de involverede?”
Strategisk analyse (begrænset omfang): Udarbejde problem- eller kortlægningsanalyser som belyser ”Hvad udgør en risiko?”
Ad hoc-opgaver: Understøtte driften og enhedens øvrige opgaveportefølje.

Du kommer til at samarbejde bredt både internt og eksternt, og du får mulighed for at deltage i både nationale og internationale myndighedsfællesfora.




Gode formidlingsevner, systemkendskab og erfaring med efterretningsanalyse

Med en bred portefølje af opgaver inden for analyse og efterretning søger vi analytikere, der i den grad kan omsætte brudstykker af information til skarpe analyseprodukter. Platforme som IBM i2 (Analyst Notebook), Palantir Gotham eller tilsvarende løsninger skal helst ikke være ukendt for dig. Har du erfaring med eller uddannelse i efterretningsanalyse er det et stort plus for os – det samme gælder teknisk kendskab til Python, R eller Excel VBA.




Derudover ser vi gerne, at du har en relevant uddannelse inden for analyse eller lignende. Har du arbejdet med analyse og efterretning i en anden offentlig myndighed eller indgået i samarbejder som ODIN, FOS, Al Capone eller NTE, er det en fordel og kompetencer med særlig relevans.

motiveres af et tæt samarbejde på tværs af forskellige faggrupper og ledelseslag
formår at omfavne ny teknologi: Du skal gerne synes, at det er sjovt at arbejde med nye metoder og måder at gå til opgaverne på
tager ansvar for helheden i enhedens ad hoc-opgaver, når det kræves – også når rutineopgaver i driften skal løses. Vi er sammen om opgaverne, og vi løfter i flok!

Enheden er placeret i Hjørring, men der vil være mulighed for arbejdssted ved et af Særlig Kontrols øvrige kontorer i enten Aarhus eller Høje Taastrup. Derudover forventer vi at gøre brug af en personanalyse i rekrutteringsforløbet.

Din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at vi ikke finder oplysninger om dig, der er uforenelige med en ansættelse i Skatte- og Vækstministeriets koncern.

(DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet. Du bliver ansat i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner.
